data-upload-src / data-upload-keyEdit-flow preload: data-upload-src="<url>" puts the tile straight into .is-filled with that image, skipping the fake-upload timer. data-upload-key identifies the tile in the upload:change event (falls back to data-cp-asset).編輯態預填：data-upload-src="<url>" 讓格子直接帶圖進 .is-filled、跳過假上傳計時；data-upload-key 供 upload:change 事件辨識該格（沒有則退回 data-cp-asset）
upload:changeCustom event, bubbles, fired on every state change — detail: { key, filled, state }. Pages listen to this to update readiness gating; state (empty / uploading / processing / filled / optimizing / optimized) is what lets a page say which stage it is at, since filled alone only answers "usable or not".自訂事件，會冒泡，每次狀態變動都會發出——detail: { key, filled, state }。頁面監聽它來更新就緒判斷；state（empty／uploading／processing／filled／optimizing／optimized）讓頁面講得出「現在是哪一段」，光靠 filled 只回答得了「能不能用」
Keyboard鍵盤Empty tiles get role="button" + tabindex="0" (removed once filled — the two real <button> actions take over the tab stop); Enter/Space activate (Space doesn't scroll the page); focus ring is the site standard outline: 2px solid var(--ring); focus is handed back after upload/optimize/remove completes, but only for keyboard-triggered interactions. When a tile has no __title, the injected label depends on the mode (2026-08-07): image tiles fall back to cp.media.add (Add image), content-file tiles to cp.cfile.add (Add file) — a video or subtitle slot labelled “Add image” misleads screen-reader users. A page can name its own slot precisely (“Add the trailer”) with aria-label + data-i18n-aria-label; the component gives way.空狀態掛 role="button"＋tabindex="0"（填圖後拿掉，改由動作列兩顆真 <button> 進 tab 序）；Enter／Space 觸發同點擊（Space 不捲頁）；焦點環用站上標準 outline: 2px solid var(--ring)；上傳／優化／刪除完成後把焦點交還，僅限鍵盤觸發的互動。沒有 __title 時自動補的標籤依模式分兩種（2026-08-07）：圖片格用 cp.media.add（新增圖片）、內容檔格用 cp.cfile.add（新增檔案）——影音或字幕格套「新增圖片」會誤導螢幕閱讀器使用者。頁面要更精確的說法（「上傳預告片」）就自己寫 aria-label＋data-i18n-aria-label，元件會讓路
<div class="upload-assets upload-assets--fill" data-upload-reveal>
  <div class="upload-tile upload-tile--portrait" data-upload>
    <span class="upload-tile__flag">Hero</span>
    <span class="upload-tile__icon">…</span>
    <span class="upload-tile__title">Add image</span>
    <span class="upload-tile__hint">750 × 1125 · portrait</span>
  </div>
  …4 more, each `hidden` until the one before it is filled…
</div>

ds-components/upload-tile.css · interactive states enhanced by互動狀態由此增強 partials/upload-tile.js (opt-in per tile via（逐格以 [data-upload]) 開啟）

4.15b Bundle editor

🟠 molecule

Purpose

用途

Editor for co-creation reward bundles and presale plans (2026-08-03, D166 — same card, presale just turns off revenue-share). 2026-07-30: behavior extracted into a shared module, js/bundle-editor.js (window.ZtorBundleEditor.mount()) — now 4 consumers (create-project's "Reward bundles" step + its new "Pre-order plans" step, and project-detail's 方案與承諾 › 支持方案 + 預購方案 tabs) render the exact same card from one source instead of diverging implementations. 2026-08-03: new shares option (default true; presale mounts pass false) drops the revenue-share slots field entirely, drops the "Auto" sell-cap option (leaving only Unlimited/Limited — "Auto" is derived from the slot pool, which presale has none of), and changes isValid() to require a name plus either an item or a non-empty perk (co-creation instead requires a name plus either an item or slots > 0, since presale has no slots to serve as consideration). Everything else — name, one-line description, product picker, perks, discount, computed price — is identical between the two and shares the same cpp.bd.* copy keys. 2026-07-30 (third pass): the discount is a percentage (0–100%, .amount-field--suffix.amount-field--readonly unit %) rather than a dollar amount, and the expanded card's field order was reorganized input-to-output: name*, one-line description, included revenue-share slots + an auto/limited sell-cap toggle, a product-reference picker (.fc-pick → .fc-ref, no free-text items), free-text perks (.fc-perk), then a dedicated pricing block (.fc-pricing) at the very end. It's a read-only computed field (.amount-field--readonly) — slot count × per-slot price + item prices — plus the bundle-discount % that can only reduce the item portion, floored at the slot-share value (a slot's price can't be discounted away); the cap is likewise expressed as a percentage (maxPct()). Typing past what the items can absorb doesn't get silently clamped: the hint below the field turns red (.field__hint.fc-hint--over) and says what actually applied. The collapsed summary shows the struck-through original price (.fc-sum__was) whenever a discount is in effect, so the discount survives collapsing. The card's left-edge "incomplete" stripe has been removed by user decision — isValid() is unchanged and still drives the page-level coach marks and Continue gating, only the card's own visual cue is gone. 2026-07-30 (fifth pass, user decision): the expanded price moved to the head's top-right corner — a small label .fc-sum__tag ("Bundle price") plus an enlarged value .fc-sum__val (--fs-20), because the pricing block sits at the very bottom of the card, five field groups away from where a creator is actually editing slots or items. Actions moved from the head to the card foot in the expanded state — the head's top-right is now price-only; the foot holds a full-width clickable collapse handle .fc-collapse (with a chevron-up icon) and, below it, .fc-bundle__foot containing a solid .btn--destructive remove button (only shown when more than one card exists). The collapsed state is unchanged — actions stay as text links in the head. Card padding now matches create-product's .form-section--outlined rhythm (user-specified reference): --sp-24 instead of --sp-16/--sp-18, including the collapsed row so the name doesn't shift horizontally between states; field labels inside the body are --fs-14 with hints pulled tight underneath. 2026-09-18 (D292/D293) — the event variant's tickets became a ticket list (tier × quantity): tickets went from [tier id] to [{id, qty}] (legacy string arrays read as qty 1); several lines mean the bundle includes all of them at once (a family pass), no longer "fans pick one". The tier section moved from multi-select .radio-cards to a ticket-list table .bd-tbl--tix (checkbox | tier | price | .zstep quantity stepper, disabled until checked | subtotal, with a .bd-tbl__foot total). Full price = Σ(price × qty) + items, with the formula printed beside the total ([data-bd-calc-parts]; the "highest ticket" estimate is gone). The sell cap's hard ceiling = min over members of floor(remaining ÷ per-set usage) (memberCapMax()). One member is enough to be valid (tickets-only or items-only), so the items section reads "Optional". The collapsed row lists each line ("VIP × 2 · Floor × 1"), and per-date fan-out gives every date the same list. The two funding consumers are untouched. 2026-09-21 (D295/D296) — ticket member = allowed tiers × one quantity, fan picks a tier: tickets is now a single object { tierIds:[…], qty:n } (legacy [{id, qty}] / string arrays are read as tierIds = the ids, qty = the first line's); the "all included at once" per-row quantity model is retired. The table drops the per-row stepper and subtotal columns (checkbox | tier | price | left, 4 tracks) and gains one .bd-tix-qty stepper field below it ("Tickets per set"); the foot reads "K tiers allowed · n per set · list price from $X". Full price = lowest allowed tier price × n (one tier: that price × n), and every price readout — formula, list price, fans-pay, footer, collapsed row — is prefixed "from …" when more than one tier is allowed. The cap ceiling's ticket part = Σ over allowed tiers of floor(left ÷ n) (any tier with ≥ n left keeps the set sellable), then min with the item part. Collapsed row: "VIP／Floor (pick one) × 2 · 1 item"; one tier: "VIP × 2". Per-date fan-out copies the same { tierIds, qty } with that date's tier ids. Item rows in the event variant mark multi-option products "Options chosen by the fan at purchase" (D295: the option is the product's own attribute, not picked when bundling). defaultAllTiers mount option pre-checks every tier at qty 1 on Add (5.1.6.1 F20). 2026-09-21 (second pass) — split layout, layout:'split': the user reviewed docs/bundle-create-demo-2026-09-21.html and ruled 「make it production」. The event dialog is now .payout-dialog--xwide with the shell's own .payout-dialog__split: left column = three sections (Contents → Pricing & stock → Name & listing — renamed 2026-09-21 from “Contents / Pricing & quantity”, with a fixed Section tabs row under the dialog title that jumps to each — each a .bd-sec--stack), right column = the fan-facing Bundle preview card (sticky), footer = fans-pay (「from $Y」) + 「list $X · up to N sets」 + Cancel / Done. The two-step dialog is gone for this layout; the name is auto-suggested from the contents (「VIP／Floor (pick one) × 2 ＋ Tour tee」) and stops being overwritten once the creator edits it (nameTouched). Contents: the ticket table gains an 「under n」 note under Left when a checked tier can't fill a set (.bd-tbl__short), a plain-language sentence beneath the quantity stepper (insight-row: 「Fans pick one of VIP, Floor and get 2 tickets of it」 / 「Locked to VIP…」), the shop-item picker (.fc-pick) followed by an 「In this bundle」 table (.bd-tbl--items: name + option note | list price | stock | ✕; multi-option products read 「Options · Size, chosen by the fan」 and price 「from $X」 when option prices differ), perks as one textarea (one per line). Pricing & quantity: the list total is an itemised formula (.calc-list, one kv row per member with a 「how」 line, then the total), a discount toggle → % stepper + big selling-price readout + 「fans save $Z (12%)」, a Locked-sets row (lock-sets’ .lockset__sets, hint 「up to N sets (limited by tickets / item)」, red when over), a read-only Sellable-sets readout naming what limits it, and an unlimited / limited pair with a cap stepper. Name & listing: name*, description textarea, a 120px cover tile (.upload-tile-aside), and listing as a single kv 「Follows the event {name} (badge)」 — no three switches (D293/D294). Sold state (b.sold > 0, D292 rule 7): tiers, quantity, date mapping and items lock (.bd-tbl--locked, picker hidden, ✕ hidden, lock note), discount / locked sets / cap stay editable and the primary reads 「Save changes」. Cancel restores a snapshot taken on open (a fresh card is discarded). The funding consumers still pass layout:'sections' and are untouched. 2026-09-22 — copy hierarchy, plan A (three levels): the user reviewed docs/bundle-copy-hierarchy-lab-2026-09-22.html (all 67 text elements in the three sections audited one by one) and picked plan A, so a section now carries at most three text levels — section title (16) → field labels and sub-heads (14) → body copy (12: tables, hints, readout notes). Section sub-titles are gone everywhere (they could only paraphrase the title), a hint writes only what you need to decide (one sentence per field), a fact lives in exactly one place next to the control it belongs to, and a rule is shown rather than written. Concretely: the ticket table loses its foot and its rule hint — a checked tier that can't fill a set now greys out (new .bd-tbl__row--short) and carries the 「under n」 note as a .ztor-badge; the one plain-language sentence moved under the quantity stepper as an ordinary .field__hint (the .insight-row is gone); 「Allowed tiers」, 「In this bundle」, 「Full price」, 「Discount」, 「Limit」 and 「Listing」 labels retire because the header, total row, % suffix, option values and section title already say them; Sellable sets is promoted to the section's big readout (.bd-readout--big) and moved above Locked sets, with 「limited by …」 demoted to its hint — the ceiling is stated once, there, instead of three times; 「sets」 and 「groups」 collapse to one unit; the cover tile drops its CTA (the field label says it) and the perks hint folds into the placeholder. New: .bd-tbl__row--short and .bd-disc-grid (bottom-aligns the % stepper with the selling-price readout now that the discount label is gone). Applied to both consumers of this copy — the event dialog (layout:'split') and create-bundle.html; bundle-detail.html follows the same wording without rearranging.

共創回饋套組與預購方案的編輯器（2026-08-03，D166——同一張卡，預購只是關掉分潤）。2026-07-30：行為抽成共用模組 js/bundle-editor.js（window.ZtorBundleEditor.mount()）——現在共 4 個消費點（create-project「回饋套組」步驟＋新增的「預購方案」步驟、project-detail 方案與承諾 › 支持方案＋預購方案 兩個分頁）從同一個來源畫出同一張卡，不再是會慢慢分岔的實作。2026-08-03：新增 `shares` 選項（預設 true；預購掛載傳 `false`）整格關掉分潤名額欄位、拿掉販售上限的「自動」（只留不限量／限量——「自動」是從名額池推導的，預購沒有池子）、並把 `isValid()` 改成「有名稱 ＋（至少一件商品或一項有內容的權益）」（共創版是「有名稱 ＋（至少一件商品或名額數 > 0）」，因為預購沒有名額可以當對價）。其餘（名稱、一句話說明、商品挑選器、額外權益、優惠、算出來的價格）兩型完全相同、共用同一批 `cpp.bd.*` 文案。2026-07-30（第三批）：優惠欄位改百分比（0–100%，沿用既有 .amount-field--suffix.amount-field--readonly 做法，單位 %），不再是金額；展開態欄位順序同輪重排為「輸入到結果」：套組名稱＊、一句話說明、含分潤名額＋自動／限量販售上限切換、商品「引用」挑選器（.fc-pick→.fc-ref，不接受自由文字品項）、自由文字額外權益（.fc-perk），最後才是獨立的定價區塊（.fc-pricing）。價格為唯讀自動計算（.amount-field--readonly）——名額數 × 每名額單價 ＋ 商品定價加總——套組優惠只能折抵商品那一段，地板是股份總價（名額不可被折），上限同樣以百分比表達（maxPct()）。填超過商品能吸收的上限不會被默默截掉：欄位下方的提示會轉紅（.field__hint.fc-hint--over）並說出實際生效的折抵值。收合摘要列在有折扣生效時會顯示劃線原價（.fc-sum__was），折扣不會因收合而消失。卡片左緣的「未完成」色線已依使用者裁決移除——isValid() 判準沒變，仍驅動頁面教練提示與 Continue 擋關，消失的只是卡片自己的那條視覺表現。2026-07-30（第五批，使用者裁決）：展開態價格移到標題列右上角——小標 .fc-sum__tag（「套組價」）＋放大的金額 .fc-sum__val（--fs-20），因為定價區塊在卡片最後、隔著五組欄位，編輯名額或商品的當下看不到價格變成多少。動作同輪從標題列移到卡片底部——展開態標題列右上角只留價格；底部改放整條可點的收合把手 .fc-collapse（含 chevron-up 圖示）與下方的 .fc-bundle__foot（內含實色 .btn--destructive 移除鈕，僅多於一張卡時出現）。收合態不變，動作仍是標題列的文字連結。卡內間距同輪對齊建立商品頁 .form-section--outlined 的節奏（使用者指定參考對象）：內距由 --sp-16/--sp-18 改 --sp-24（含收合列，收合↔展開時名稱不左右位移）；卡內欄位 label 改 --fs-14、說明貼齊 label。2026-09-01 {活動名}（徽章）」——沒有三開關（D293／D294）。已售出態（b.sold > 0，D292 裁決七）：票種、張數、場次對應、商品全部鎖定（.bd-tbl--locked、搜尋框與 ✕ 收起、鎖定說明），折扣／鎖定套數／上限照常可改，主鈕寫「儲存變更」。取消＝還原打開時的快照（新卡直接丟掉）。募資兩個消費頁仍傳 layout:'sections'，不受影響。 2026-09-22 只寫做決定才需要的資訊、每欄最多一句；同一事實只出現一次、放在最靠近操作的地方；規則優先用畫面表達。落地：票券表去掉表尾與表下那句規則 hint——勾到的票種剩餘不足一組改成整列灰化（新增 .bd-tbl__row--short）＋「不足 n 張」.ztor-badge 徽章；唯一的語意句降成每組張數欄底下的一般 .field__hint（.insight-row 退場）；「允許票種」「已加入」「原價合計」「折扣」「限量」「上架」六個標籤退場（表頭、合計列、% 後綴、選項值、段標題已經各自承擔）；可售套數升成該段的大讀數（.bd-readout--big）並移到鎖定套數之前，「受…限制」降成它的 hint——上限這個事實從講三次收斂成只在這裡講一次；「套／組」統一成「組」；封面上傳格去掉 CTA（欄位標籤已經說了）、額外權益 hint 併進 placeholder。新增：.bd-tbl__row--short 與 .bd-disc-grid（拿掉「折扣」標籤後，% 步進器與售價讀數改底端對齊）。兩個消費點同步——建立活動第 6 步（layout:'split'）與 create-bundle.html；bundle-detail.html 跟上同一套用詞、不重排。

Sourcebundle-editor.css · js/bundle-editor.js
AnatomyBundle card (.card.fc-bundle) = head (.fc-bundle__head → .fc-sum summary row [__name + numbered .fc-bundle__index · __meta (hidden when expanded) · __price, whose content depends on state — collapsed: plain amount with struck-through original via .fc-sum__was when a discount applies; expanded (2026-07-30 fifth pass): right-aligned .fc-sum__tag label ("Bundle price") + optional .fc-sum__was + enlarged .fc-sum__val (--fs-20)] + .fc-sum__thumb leading 40px cover, taken from the bundle's first item — a bundle has no image of its own, and adding one would be a second thing to keep in sync with the product's — and a trailing .fc-sum__chev, one 32px toggle pinned top-right in both states, rotating rather than swapping icon, so that corner is always 「open/close this card」 (2026-08-18, per user). Tombstoned 2026-08-18: .fc-bundle__actions — the collapsed head's edit/remove text links. 「Edit」 retired because opening the card is editing it, so a link by that name gives one action two entrances; 「Remove」 moved to the expanded card's foot, since it deletes the whole bundle irreversibly and you should have to see the contents first) + body (.fc-bundle__body, hidden when .fc-bundle--collapsed), fields ordered input-to-output (2026-07-30 third pass): name*, one-line description, slots/availability .form-grid 2-col (.segmented auto/limited + .fc-slotnote/--over hint; the grid's own bottom margin is patched via .fc-bundle__body > .form-grid), product picker .fc-pick (__results popover → __opt/__opt-price/__empty) resolving to reference rows .fc-ref (__thumb 44px/__name/__meta), free-text perks .fc-perk, then a dedicated pricing block .fc-pricing at the very end (top border, extra top margin) — .fc-pricing__row 2-col (112px discount-% field + 176px .fc-pricing__out read-only computed price, tabular-nums at --fs-15) + a full-row .field__hint.fc-pricing__note (two lines: composition, then cap/over-limit). Full-width tall add button .fc-add (56px, add bundle); .fc-add-item (48px) is reused for "add perk" in this generation. 2026-07-30 (fifth pass): two exits at the card foot, expanded state only — a full-width clickable collapse handle .fc-collapse (a <button>, chevron-up icon + label, top border) followed by .fc-bundle__foot (right-aligned) holding a solid .btn.btn--destructive.btn--sm remove button, shown only when more than one bundle card exists (same condition the collapsed head's remove link already used). The card has no invalid-state visual — the former left-edge .fc-bundle--invalid stripe was removed 2026-07-30 by user decision; isValid() itself (name present, and either slots > 0 or ≥1 item) is unchanged and still drives page-level gating. Ticket rows (.bd-ticket), two fixes 2026-08-13 — a ticket row is an .fc-ref with a checkbox in front of the thumb, so it has to restate the grid: .fc-ref's 44px minmax(0,1fr) auto was written for thumb / copy / remove-button, and the ticket row landed one column off (checkbox in the 44px thumb slot, ticket thumb stretched across the flexible slot, name and price crushed into the trailing auto and jammed against the right edge). It now declares auto 44px minmax(0,1fr) — there is no remove button, since inclusion is what the checkbox says. Second, the divider now sits centred between rows: .fc-ref's rhythm is 8px padding top and bottom with a rule on the bottom edge, which assumes the container adds no gap of its own — but these rows are direct children of .field, whose gap: 6px lands after the rule, leaving every line 8px below one row and 14px above the next. .field:has(> .bd-ticket) zeroes that gap and hands the rhythm back to the rows' own padding, with 8px added at the top and bottom of the run so six rows read as a list rather than one slab welded to the label above and the hint below. Sections layout — layout: 'sections' (2026-08-13, event variant only) — the card becomes three numbered sections: ① what's in it (tickets / shop items / perks), ② how it sells (full price → discount → fans pay, computed on one line; sell cap), ③ how it looks (name*, one-liner, cover shrunk to a 120px slot beside them). The two funding consumers pass no layout and are untouched. The order is deliberately reversed: the default card asks for a name and a cover before anything is in the box, but the sentence in the creator's head is 「VIP ticket + tour tee, 4,800」 — contents first, then a name and a price. With the name last it can be auto-suggested from the contents (tier names + first item), turning a blank required field into a confirmation. The ticket picker takes three optional per-ticket fields — group (which date), kind (which tier), qty — and only lights up the matching affordance when they're supplied: grouping by date with a select-the-whole-date checkbox, a row of cross-date tier shortcuts, and collapse-to-chips (.bd-chosen) once something is picked. Measured on three dates × two tiers, the default card is 1,464px tall against a 944px viewport; the sections card settles around 1,065px and stops growing with the date count. Six sections, one decision each (2026-08-13, per user: 「reference create-product」) — dates / contents / pricing / quantity / info / cover. Three of them borrow create-product's existing answers: the discount became a .control-group toggle like Discount settings (most bundles aren't discounted, so a permanently-open discount field asks every bundle a question most of them don't have; the calc row is two terms until it's on, and turning it off clears the value so nothing invisible keeps affecting the price); quantity became an unlimited/limited pair of .radio-cards like Stock's edition (a 「blank means unlimited」 number field is a silent default — you can't read your own choice off it, and blank looks the same as 0); and 「Presentation」 split into 「Bundle info」 and 「Cover」 like Product info / Show it off, since a name and an image are two different things and pairing them made the image read as an appendage of the name field. Per-date mode lists what will actually be created (2026-08-13) — picking the mode card only said 「creates 3 bundles」 without saying which three. secPerHTML() replays commit()'s expansion and lists them per date, with a prompt instead of a blank when no tier is picked yet. A commit() bug went with it: it used to make one bundle for every date, so a date that doesn't sell the picked tier produced an empty bundle — dates with nothing to put in are now filtered out, which also makes the listing row-for-row identical to what gets created. Both blocks became tables (.bd-tbl, 2026-08-13, per user) — the listing was promoted out of the tier section into its own .bd-sec (「what will exist after I press Done」 is a different question from 「which tier does this bundle sell」), and it and 「dates it applies to」 both moved from reference rows (.fc-ref: thumb + name + one line of secondary text) to a column layout. A row's facts used to be strung into one sentence — 「$3800 · 150 tickets」 makes you parse prose to tell the price from the count, and rows didn't line up with each other; a column each, right-aligned with tabular-nums, lets you compare down the column. The identical ticket icon on every row was decoration and is gone (the section title already says these are tickets). Columns: dates = checkbox / tier / price / tickets, grouped per date (.bd-tbl__group, the group header carrying select-the-whole-date); listing = bundle name / tickets inside / ticket value, the name being the full expanded name (stem · date) that will actually appear in the list. The header follows the site-wide list convention set 2026-07-31 (no background band, no bottom rule, just --column-head-ink labels) — .restock-table__head's --muted band can't be copied here, since another dark band inside an L2 section would sink a level and contradict Q66. Row dividers use an adjacent-sibling selector, so the first row under a group header isn't ruled and the header can't read as some row's underline. Second table pass — an outside reference, narrowed (2026-08-13, user picked variant C; STYLE-DECISIONS Q68) — the reference put a tinted band behind the header, which collides with the 2026-07-31 ruling that list headers get no band. Three variants were built side by side (docs/bundle-table-demo.html) and the no-band one won, so that ruling stands unchanged. Three other things from the reference were adopted: a select-all checkbox in the header's first cell (data-bd-all, scoped to the tickets this table lists); the per-date group header now takes the same column template, putting its checkbox in the leading column aligned with every row's checkbox and dropping the 「select this date」 text label (position carries the meaning, so the markup gained an aria-label); and unselected rows now grey out entirely (.bd-tbl__row--off) in place of the orange left edge on selected ones (--on tombstoned). Both select-alls use indeterminate for a partial selection — with only checked, unchecking one date snaps the group box back to empty and reads as the user's own action being undone. That is a DOM property and cannot be written into an HTML string, so render() re-applies it via syncTriBoxes(). The table also gained a --border frame, matching how .bd-pick/.bd-calc handle L3. The reference's coloured status dot was not adopted — our tickets carry no field it could report. Two steps, no stepper (2026-08-13, per user) — step 1 answers what the bundle sells and how (tier / bundles-to-be-created / dates / shop items / perks / pricing / quantity), step 2 is what it looks like (info and cover). Those two were already last in the order, and the name is auto-suggested from the contents, so step 2 is a confirmation rather than a blank form. No stepper: a two-step progress bar would take a full band across the top of the dialog to say 「step n of 2」, which the section titles already answer; the footer carries the movement instead (step 1 shows Next, step 2 shows Back plus the real submit). The step lives on b.step, reset to 1 on both open and close so it never resumes where it was left, and switching steps renders with {top: true}, which drops the saved scroll position — the two steps hold different content, so restoring it would land somewhere unrelated. The gate is evaluated per step (gateOffFor()): step 1 checks only what step 1 can answer (a ticket is included, and the sell cap is within the ticket supply), since requiring the name there would block on a field that is not on screen; step 2 uses the full readyMiss(). Pricing became three stacked fields (2026-08-13, per user) — it used to be one horizontal equation (.bd-calc: list price − discount% on a single line), which crowded three figures onto one row with labels a size below their values, so it had to be read left to right. Now three .fields stack: bundle discount (the only input), list price, and fans-pay, the latter two as .field-readout — a disabled .input reads as 「you could have typed here」. The discount field also dropped amount-field--readonly, a modifier meant for read-only prefix fields that gives the unit a --card fill and pads 40px off the input's left edge. The final figure now has two homes (the section field and the footer result), so syncCard() updates both via querySelectorAll, while the struck-through list price is inserted against the footer one specifically. Tombstoned: .bd-calc and its columns. The sell cap cannot exceed the scarcest ticket (2026-08-13, per user) — selling one bundle deducts one of each ticket it contains, so how many bundles can exist is set by the ticket with the fewest left: ticketCapMax() takes the minimum, not the sum, and skips tickets with no quantity on record. The field gets a max, a line beneath it naming where the ceiling comes from ([data-bd-capmax]), and going over turns it red (.fc-hint--over), sets aria-invalid, and disables the primary. syncCard() keeps all of that in step as you type rather than re-rendering, which would drop the caret. Readiness chip dropped from the footer (2026-08-13, per user: 「not needed」) — the .readiness__chip that sat beside the primary action (hover for the list of what's missing) is gone; not-ready is said by the Done button's own disabled state. With both conditions met the chip only read 「Ready」, restating what the button already showed. readiness()/readyMiss() are untouched and still drive that disabled state; the five cpp.bd.ready.* strings are tombstoned. The footer price moved left in the same pass, in two goes: label and figure flush left, then the whole block out to the footer's left edge as its first child. Sharing the right-hand cluster with the primary action made those two lines read as the button's caption; split to the two ends, the left says what this bundle costs and the right asks whether to submit it. The remove button (only rendered past the first bundle) follows the price, with .bd-foot-actions's margin-left: auto pushing the primary to the right edge — the footer's justify-content: space-between only works for two children, and would strand a third in the middle. readiness.css keeps its create-product / create-auction / publish-work consumers. Final price pinned to the footer (2026-08-13, per user) — .bd-foot-price lives in payout-dialog__foot, so the price stays visible no matter which section you scroll to; a struck-through list price sits beside it when discounted (__was, removed by syncCard() when the discount goes to zero so it never mirrors the final figure). The pricing section keeps only the inputs, and the whole calc block disappears when the discount toggle is off — a framed box holding one number is an empty shell. Mode choice gets its own section (2026-08-13, per user) — the dates question (one bundle across all dates vs one per date) moved out from under the 「which tickets」 field label into its own .bd-sec with a title and a line of explanation, and the control switched from .filter-tabs to .segmented.radio-cards (two cards, each with a title and a sub). This mirrors create-product giving single-vs-multiple variations its own Variations section: a 「pick a mode and the fields below change」 choice is its own decision, and tucking it under a field label makes it read as that field's sub-setting. .filter-tabs is the vocabulary for narrowing a list, not for setting a mode. The 「creates N bundles」 copy moved into the option's .radio-card__sub at the same time, leaving the picker to say only which dates. Single-date events don't get this section. Popup, not inline (2026-08-13, per user) — the list holds only collapsed rows; clicking one, or Add, floats the editing card as a dialog (payout-modal + payout-dialog--wide; the three-section form is its own block, .bd-form, set on the dialog body — the dialog element carries no second component root, since .fc-bundle would drag its own card padding and bottom margin into the dialog's head/body/foot layout). Expanding in place shoved the already-built rows off screen and read as the list growing a head; floating it leaves the list where it was. --wide rather than --narrow because the date-grouped ticket picker needs about 500px before the group headers wrap. One dialog at a time; Esc and ✕ both close it, and a brand-new card with nothing filled in is discarded on close rather than leaving an 「Untitled bundle · nothing in it」 row behind. A new card also claims no row until it is committed, while existing ones keep theirs while being edited. The button says Done, not Cancel — the editor writes state live, so there is nothing to revert and Cancel would be a promise it cannot keep. scope is asked only on multi-date events: shared is one bundle across all dates, per picks tiers only and fans out into one bundle per date on commit. Two fixes rode along: ticketValue() puts the ticket into the full price (highest of the picked tickets — fans pick one, so the highest is the conservative read; before this a 「VIP + tee」 bundle priced the tee alone), and summaryMeta()'s 「N copies」 moved from the !SHARES test to WORK, since whether there is a work is what WORK governs — the event variant passes work:false and still read 「1 copy」.
Behavior / usageStyle + behavior, not style-only: js/bundle-editor.js exposes window.ZtorBundleEditor.mount({ list, addBtn, t, getPool|poolInput|pool, getPerSlot|perSlotInput|perSlot, initial, collapsedByDefault, shares, onChange }), returning { getBundles, setBundles, add, ensure, render, refresh, isValid, listPrice, finalPrice, maxDiscount, maxPct, perSlot, maxUnits, autoUnits, committedSlots, pool, num }. 2026-08-03 (D166): new shares option (boolean, default true; presale mounts pass false) — co-creation and presale plans are the same object, the only difference being presale carries no revenue share. With shares:false: the revenue-share slots field is not rendered at all; the sell-cap toggle drops "Auto" (which is derived from the slot pool) and offers only Unlimited (internal value unlimited) / Limited (co-creation's non-limited internal value is auto — the two generations deliberately use different strings so the state itself says whether a cap was derived or genuinely absent; every check is written as "is it limited", never "is it auto"); the price breakdown drops the slots line, leaving only the item total; and isValid() becomes "name present, and either at least one item or at least one non-empty perk" (co-creation requires a name plus either an item or slots > 0 — presale has no slots to serve as consideration, so a perk-only plan like "one livestream meet-and-greet" must still be valid). Everything else (name, one-line description, product picker, perks, discount %, computed price) is identical and shares the same cpp.bd.* copy. Spec source: documents/5.1.2.1-建立專案流程.md §5.3.2 F28/F29, decisions.md D166. The revenue-share slot pool is injectable three ways (a live getter, an input element to read, or a fixed number) so the same module serves a page where the pool changes live (create-project, reading #fd-slots) and a page where it's fixed (project-detail, a SLOT_POOL prototype constant derived from fund.goal ÷ 200). 2026-07-30: per-slot price is injectable the same three ways — create-project reads the funding step's read-only #fd-perslot (goal ÷ supporter slots), project-detail derives a fixed fund.goal ÷ 200 (prototype constant, no real per-slot-price field upstream yet). Pricing rule: list price = slots × per-slot price + sum of item prices. 2026-07-30 (third pass): the discount field is a percentage (0–100, .amount-field--suffix.amount-field--readonly) of the list price, not a dollar amount — final price = list price − min(discount% × list price, item total), so the discount can never eat into the slot-share value; its ceiling expressed as a percentage is maxPct() = floor(item total ÷ list price × 100) (a pure-reward card with 0 slots can discount to $0; a slots-only card with no items can't discount at all — maxPct() is 0). refresh() re-syncs every card in place (no re-render, no focus loss) whenever the injected pool or per-slot price changes externally. "Auto" sell-cap derives sellable units from the shared pool; "Limited" is a manual hard cap. Product references resolve against window.ZTOR_PRODUCTS via js/products-store.js; there is no free-text item entry in this generation. 2026-08-18 (per user): the head's top-right corner is now a permanent chevron toggle in both states, and the only other action — remove — lives at the expanded card's foot. This supersedes the 2026-07-30 rule that actions swapped between head and foot by state: a control that moves when the state changes has to be re-found every time it is used. Reuses .card, .field, .form-grid, .input, .amount-field, .amount-field--readonly, .segmented, .btn. Prototype: no persistence, no real inventory/order linkage.

4.16 Tag input

🟡 molecule

Creator-built / selectable tags (Create product Product tags, spec 5.1.5.2 §4.5). Composes .chip: picked / custom tags render as .chip--active.chip--removable inside a bordered field; a borderless entry adds new ones (Enter); an optional suggestion .chip-group offers existing tags. Reusable for project / fan tags later. 2026-09-11: the field is an input, so its surface follows .input — --ztu-film fill, 1px --border hairline via box-shadow, --radius, same focus ring; chips inside the field take the field's --radius (they are entered values, not pickable pills — Q111), while the suggestion row stays pill.

創作者自建／可選的標籤（建立商品的商品標籤，規格 5.1.5.2 §4.5）。組合 .chip：已選／自建標籤以 .chip--active.chip--removable 顯示在框內；無邊框輸入按 Enter 新增；選配的建議 .chip-group 提供既有標籤。日後可重用於項目／粉絲標籤。2026-09-11：欄位是輸入控件，表面跟 .input 走——--ztu-film 薄膜底、box-shadow 畫的 1px --border 髮線、--radius、同一種 focus 環；欄內的 chip 改吃欄位的 --radius（它們是已輸入的值，不是可點選的 pill——Q111），欄位外的建議列維持 pill。

4.16b Combobox

🟡 molecule

Multi-select search-to-add typeahead. Reuses the Tag input field (selected .chip--removable + borderless entry); focusing / typing opens a floating .combobox__menu of suggestions (grouped .combobox__opt = icon + name + meta), picking one adds it as a chip and drops it from the list. Differs from Tag input only in that suggestions live in a focus-triggered dropdown, not an always-visible chip row. First used by the pickup session modal's "add pickup items" (spec 5.1.5.12 §4 F2). New consumers (2026-08-09): Create-event's "Ticket type" field and "Add product" field both moved to this component — replacing a page-local dropdown-and-list pattern — with added products now shown as .chip-group + .chip--removable. The menu is a floating layer and shares the popover recipe with Dropdown menu: opaque --popover, 1px --ztu-glass-rim, --shadow-float (Q78; since 2026-09-16, was --card/--border).

多選 search-to-add typeahead。重用 Tag input 欄位（已選 .chip--removable ＋無框 entry）；focus／輸入時彈出浮層 .combobox__menu 建議（.combobox__opt＝icon＋名稱＋meta、可分組 .combobox__group），點選加入為 chip、已選項自建議移除。與 Tag input 差別只在建議改「focus 觸發下拉」而非常駐 chip-group。首用於建立取貨場次 modal 的「加入取貨項目」（spec 5.1.5.12 §4 F2）。新消費情境（2026-08-09）：建立活動的「票種」欄與「加入商品」欄都改用本元件——取代原本頁內自造的一套下拉候選樣式，已加入的商品改用 .chip-group ＋ .chip--removable 呈現。 下拉是浮層，配方同 Dropdown menu：實色 --popover、1px --ztu-glass-rim、--shadow-float（Q78；2026-09-16 起，舊值 --card／--border）。

4.17 Variant builder

🟠 organism

Shopify-style Variations for Create product (spec 5.1.5.2 §4.1④, physical only). A .segmented switches Single ↔ Multiple; in Multiple the builder shows option rows and every value combination becomes a priced & stocked row. Configured options collapse to a one-line summary; only the one being edited expands. 2026-07-21: values are one .input per value (edit in place) instead of chips — the common act is fixing a typo, which chips force you to delete and retype. The whole set sits inside a Nest, so its rows are layer 3 and carry depth with a 1px border rather than a third fill (Q24); the two "add" buttons use a dashed border, the established "nothing here yet, press to grow one" vocabulary. The Limited edition (§4.1⑤) adds the Total-quantity column via .variant-table--limited. Editable cells reuse .input. The table box hugs its content width and left-aligns (width:fit-content + max-width:100%) instead of stretching the form column, and the Variant column sizes to content (max-content, 110px floor) rather than a stretchy fr (2026-07-16). 2026-07-21: the Stock column is a read-only readout (.variant-cell--stock), not an .input — stock rises only through a logged restock; a variant under the low-stock threshold adds .variant-cell--stock-low and turns --destructive, so "which variant is running out" reads off the table at a glance.

建立商品的 Shopify 式多選項（規格 5.1.5.2 §4.1④，僅實體）。.segmented 切單一／多選項；多選項時顯示選項列，每個值的組合自動成為一列、各有價格與庫存。設定好的選項收成一行，只有正在編輯的那組展開。2026-07-21：值由 chip 膠囊改成「一個值一個 .input」、可就地改字——設定選項時最常做的是改一個字，chip 模式得先刪掉再重打。整組坐在 Nest 裡，所以這些列是第三層，依 Q24 用 1px 邊框而非再疊一階填色承擔層級；兩顆「新增」鈕用虛線邊框，是站上「這裡還沒有東西、按了會長出來」的既有語彙。限量版本（§4.1⑤）以 .variant-table--limited 多出上限欄。可編輯格重用 .input。2026-07-21：庫存欄改成唯讀讀數（.variant-cell--stock）——庫存只能靠留有紀錄的補貨增加；低於低庫存門檻的規格加 .variant-cell--stock-low 轉 --destructive，讓「哪一個規格快沒了」在表上一眼可見。

In edit state the cells that stay non-editable — the Stock readout .variant-cell--stock and any .variant-cell--ro — get the input's own left inset (--vt-input-pad-x, via .variant-table:has(.input)) so their text starts on the same line as the text inside the neighbouring inputs; the header row is untouched. Also a safety net: any .input / .amount-field left inside a view-state table renders as the same plain text.)

Specification

規格

Sourceradio-card.css + segmented.css
Anatomy.segmented.radio-cards > .segmented__btn (marker via ::after) > .radio-card__text (title + sub).
Behavior / usage2-up grid (gap 12); flat 1px --border card, no shadow (Q13 2026-07-16, aligned to Figma node 781-4386); active = small centered orange dot (no ring, no card outline); unselected shows no marker. Single-line cards (no .radio-card__sub) vertically center the text + dot; title+sub cards stay top-aligned. Optional .radio-cards--icon swaps the dot for a supplied .radio-card__icon; JS still reuses Segmented toggle. Hover (2026-08-09, per user) — every radio card lifts its background to color-mix(--foreground 6%, --accent) on hover. That fill used to be declared only inside --gate, leaving the plain cards with no hover feedback at all; they are the same component, the only difference being a lead icon. The orange dot stays gate-only: the gate has no persistent selection so its hover dot is the preview of what you'd pick, whereas a plain card already shows a dot on the selected one and a second dot under the cursor would read as "both are selected". align-items: stretch (2026-08-09 root-cause fix) — side-by-side cards used to come out different heights whenever one card's sub-copy wrapped to more lines than its neighbor (e.g. a 3-up "取票方式" row). Grid's own default for align-items is already stretch, but segmented.css's .segmented { align-items: center } (specificity 0,1,0) was never overridden: .segmented.radio-cards (0,2,0) is higher-specificity as a selector, but it never set align-items itself, so the browser fell through to the lower-specificity rule that did — turning the grid's stretch into center, so each card sized itself to its own content. Fixed by declaring align-items: stretch explicitly on .segmented.radio-cards.
Token usage--card, --border, --primary, --radius-md, --sp-8.

4.132 Check card

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

Multi-select pill card (Cosmos layout, Q71 定案 2026-08-25 — demo-eshop-styles.html :646-701). Two-column equal-width grid; each pill has a label on the left and a round marker on the right (+ unselected, tick selected). Sibling of Radio card but for the "pick several" case — they deliberately use two different selected-state answers (Q74): Radio card leaves the fill unchanged and only lights a small orange dot (one card lit at a time, a dot is enough); Check card tints the whole pill because several can be lit at once and needs a stronger "these are the picked ones" signal.

多選卡（Cosmos 版型，Q71 定案 2026-08-25——demo-eshop-styles.html :646-701）。兩欄等寬 grid，每張卡左邊文字、右邊一個圓形標記格（未選＋、已選勾）。與 Radio card 是姊妹元件，差在「可以選好幾個」——兩者刻意分開兩種已選畫法（Q74）：Radio card 底不變、只亮一個小橘點（一次只會亮一格，點就夠）；Check card 整格染橘，因為一次會亮好幾格，需要比橘點更強的「這些是選進來的」訊號。

Do & Don't

Amount field

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

A money input with a unit affix — normally a static read-only symbol ($ prefix, or a right-side % / months suffix). Built on Input, using an absolute-positioned prefix so it sits flush on the shadow-hairline field. The affix can also be an interactive unit toggle (the button + chevron shown below); that path shipped for the cash/POPCORN pricing unit, which was removed (spec 5.1.5.2 · D144), so no page uses the toggle today — the chrome is kept as a reusable capability. --suffix moves the affix to the right for units like % or months; --hero is a large, single-focus size for a modal's headline amount.

帶單位前綴的金額輸入——通常是唯讀靜態符號（$ 前綴，或右側 % / months 後綴）。建在 Input 上、用絕對定位前綴貼齊 shadow-hairline 欄位。前綴也可以是切換單位的互動鈕（下方展示的按鈕＋箭頭）；該路徑原為現金/POPCORN 定價單位而生，POPCORN 已移除（spec 5.1.5.2 · D144），目前沒有頁面使用切換鈕——保留這套 chrome 當可重用能力。--suffix 把前綴移到右側，給 % 或 months 這類單位；--hero 是彈窗主角級金額用的大尺寸。

Do該做

Don't別做

4.24 Data list

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

Row-divider list (icon chip + body + right amount), no per-row card — for dense record rows like earnings, payouts, products, projects. Use when rows of records need vertical density without a card per row. Avoid when ≥3 data columns need column alignment — use .ztor-table.

分隔線列表（icon chip + body + 右側金額），每列不包卡片 — 用於 earnings、payouts、products、projects 這類密集的紀錄列。當多列紀錄需要垂直節奏、又不想每列都包卡片時使用。需要 ≥3 個資料欄做欄對齊時別用 — 改用 .ztor-table。

.data-list__row--go（2026-09-11）——整列是入口（role="button"）：cursor pointer，hover／focus 只提亮行尾 __go 箭頭、列底不塗色。這種「一列一個設定、點了過去改」的列，欄目名放 __meta 在上、值放 __title 在下——值比欄目名重要。首個消費者：商品詳情總覽的「商品設定概覽」。

.data-list__row--disabled (2026-09-09) — the row stays in the list and stays readable, but can't be picked: only __row-main dims, so the status badge and any row link keep full strength (the badge is what explains why it can't be picked). First used by the Create bundle product picker: unlisted products stay listed and badged, can't be added to the bundle, and still link out to their detail page.

.data-list__row--disabled（2026-09-09）——這一列還在清單裡、看得見，但不能被選：只淡化 __row-main，右邊的狀態徽章與列上的連結維持原強度（不能被選的理由正是那顆徽章在說的話）。首個消費情境是建立組合的候選商品清單：已下架的商品照列、標徽章、不可加入，但仍點得進商品詳情。

Shared transaction-list renderer (components.js) — Earnings and Dashboard F3 use the SAME row. The status pill is per-call: Earnings shows it; Dashboard F3 passes hideStatus so the column is dropped (F3 lists settled income only, status is always settled — spec 5.1.1 §F3).

共用 transaction-list 渲染器（components.js）— Earnings 與儀表板 F3 用同一列。狀態徽章為 per-call：Earnings 顯示；儀表板 F3 傳 hideStatus 略去該欄（F3 只列已結算收入、狀態恆為 settled — 規格 5.1.1 §F3）。

Do該做

Don't別做
  • Re-introduce colored icon fills — the hooks are intentionally monochrome.

  • Wrap each row in its own card.
  • 把每一列各自包成一張卡片。

4.24b Review row

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

Flat, no-card wizard Review-step summary: field/section name + value with a right-side "Edit →" action, rows separated by hairline dividers — no card chrome. Normalizes create-event.html's .ce-review-row, register-ip.html's .ri-summary, and create-project.html's flattened Review .card blocks (that page's 2026-06-25 comment already flagged this exact consolidation: "全頁無卡片化…這批歸第三批 review-row 設計判斷"). Use for a wizard's Review step; avoid for record lists (use Data list) and avoid wrapping rows in their own card — flat is the point.

流程 Review 步驟的無卡片摘要列：欄位／區塊名＋值，右側「Edit →」動作，列間 hairline 分隔——無卡片外框。正規化自 create-event.html 的 .ce-review-row、register-ip.html 的 .ri-summary、create-project.html 扁平化的 Review .card（該頁 2026-06-25 註解已預告這次收斂：「全頁無卡片化…這批歸第三批 review-row 設計判斷」）。用於流程的 Review 步驟；紀錄清單改用 Data list，也別把列各自包卡片——扁平就是重點。

4.24c KV list

🟢 atom

Purpose

用途

Read-only key/value row: label left, value right, a hairline divider above every row but the first (--border-soft since Q72, 2026-08-25 — row dividers use the soft grey; the brighter --border is reserved for group dividers). For "look, don't touch" summaries — detail-page meta cards, status snapshots. If the value is editable, use Field system (.field / .input) instead; never dress this component up as a form. Unlike Review row it carries no per-row Edit action and no card chrome of its own — it expects to sit inside a Form section card.

唯讀鍵值列：鍵在左、值在右，除首列外每列上方一條 hairline 分隔線（Q72，2026-08-25 起用 --border-soft——列線走暗灰，較亮的 --border 留給組線；原本用 --border 與其他列式版面擺在同一張卡裡會出現兩種亮度的橫線）。用在「只看不改」的摘要——詳情頁 meta 卡、狀態快照。值若可編輯請改用 Field system（.field / .input），不要拿本元件偽裝成表單。與 Review row 的差別：本元件沒有逐列 Edit 動作、也不自帶卡片外框，預期放在 Form section 卡內。

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Mark the first visible row of a group .kv--lead when conditional rows above it may be [hidden] — a hidden row still counts as :first-child, so the automatic first-row rule fires on the wrong row.
  • 當上方有條件列可能被 [hidden] 隱藏時，把該組第一個「看得見」的列標 .kv--lead——被隱藏的列仍算 :first-child，自動首列規則會落在錯的列上。
  • Cap the value width yourself (max-width on .kv__v) when values can be long — the component sets no width ceiling.
  • 值可能很長時自行加寬度上限（在 .kv__v 上加 max-width）——本元件不預設寬度上限。
Don't別做
  • Don't put an input, switch, or button in .kv__v — an editable value belongs in a .field.
  • 別在 .kv__v 裡放 input、switch 或按鈕——可編輯的值屬於 .field。
  • Don't rely on the browser's default hidden behavior: .kv is display:flex, which beats it, so .kv[hidden] must zero display explicitly (the component already does — don't override it back).
  • 別依賴瀏覽器對 hidden 的預設行為：.kv 是 display:flex 會蓋過它，所以 .kv[hidden] 必須顯式歸零 display（元件已內建——別再覆寫回去）。

ds-components/kv-list.css

4.25 Table

🟠 organism

Header cells have neither a background nor a bottom rule (2026-07-31, two calls the same day) — a filled header inside a card reads as a second block, and the rule went next so every list header across the site matches (STYLE-DECISIONS Q41). Whitespace carries the separation; each tbody row keeps its own rule. Companion classes: .ztor-table-scroll (horizontal scroll wrapper; inside a .card the table drops its own frame so you do not get a box in a box), .ztor-table__nowrap (short-value columns; without it a two-character word breaks one glyph per line), .ztor-table__sub (second line under the main column for source / module / category — saves a whole column of width), .ztor-table--truncate (modifier: every cell stays on one line; the name cell takes the leftover width via max-width:0 + width:100% so overlong text is ellipsised instead of widening the table), .ztor-table__mediatext (wrapper for a two-line name inside .ztor-table__media). Always put the thumbnail inside the name cell via .ztor-table__media — a column of its own pays the 20px cell padding on both sides, leaving the image adrift in an empty column. Thumb is 40px with a --sp-12 gap; 40px equals the row's content height, so row height is unchanged.

表頭沒有底色、也沒有下框線（2026-07-31 同日兩段裁決）——在卡片裡填底色會讀成另一個區塊；下框線則是為了讓全站列表表頭一致（見 STYLE-DECISIONS Q41）。分隔改由留白承擔，tbody 每一列的分隔線不動。伴生類：.ztor-table-scroll（橫向捲動容器，坐在 .card 內時表格會取消自框、避免框中框）、.ztor-table__nowrap（短值欄不換行，否則兩個字的詞會被逐字斷成直行）、.ztor-table__sub（主欄位下的第二行，放來源／模組／分類這類歸屬資訊，省下一整欄寬度）、.ztor-table--truncate（modifier：整張表一律單行，主欄位用 max-width:0 ＋ width:100% 吃掉剩餘寬度，過長文字以點點點收掉而不把表格撐寬）、.ztor-table__mediatext（.ztor-table__media 內要放兩行文字時的包裝）。縮圖一律用 .ztor-table__media 併進名稱格、不要自成一欄——獨立欄會在圖兩側各吃一次 20px 內距，圖會浮在空欄中間。縮圖 40px、間距 --sp-12；40px 等於資料列的內容高，列高不變。

Purpose

用途

Self-framed data table (1px border + rounded surface) with muted header row, hairline row dividers, and check/cross/partial status cells. 2026-07-25 (Q29) converged the frame only to match variant-table (own border instead of shadow); spacing/type stay roomy (padding 16/20, header 13, body 14). Flush inside a .card the card frames it (table border suppressed); standalone/inset tables keep their own border. Use when ≥3 data columns need aligned comparison (Earnings transactions, feature-comparison grids); avoid for single icon+body+amount rows — use .data-list.

自帶 1px 邊框的資料表（圓角 surface），含淡化的 header 列、髮絲線列分隔，與 check／cross／partial 狀態格。2026-07-25（Q29）只收斂邊框對齊 variant-table（自帶邊框取代陰影）；間距／字級維持原樣較鬆（padding 16/20、表頭 13、內文 14）。直接坐進 .card（flush）時由卡出框、表格自身邊框取消；獨立／inset 表格保留自身邊框。當 ≥3 個資料欄需要對齊比較時使用（Earnings 交易、功能比較表）；單純 icon+body+金額的列別用 — 改用 .data-list。

Three rules carry the split. Weight — .ztor-table__row--ledger drops the whole row to --muted-foreground; a payout answers "why did my balance change", not "what did I earn". Badge shell — income states are filled tints, ledger states are outlined, so the income "Paid out" and the payout "Paid" never read as the same thing. Blanks — a column that does not apply to that family shows .tx-na's em dash, never −$0.00; a zero would read as "this one really was charged nothing". Pending rows append the date the money unlocks (.tx-status__when) because that is the question creators actually bring to this table.

三條規則撐起這個分工。份量——.ztor-table__row--ledger 把整列降到 --muted-foreground；提款回答的是「餘額為什麼變了」，不是「賺了多少」。徽章的殼——收入族填色、帳務異動族描邊，收入的「已撥款」與提款的「已付款」才不會讀成同一件事。留白——不適用於該族的欄位用 .tx-na 的破折號，不寫 −$0.00；填零會被讀成「這筆真的扣了 0 元」。待結算的列在徽章後面接可動用的日期（.tx-status__when），因為那是創作者拿到這張表真正要問的事。

ds-components/table.css

4.26 Product list

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

2026-09-04 (user ruling, “this spacing does not need to be this big”): the list thumbnail __image shrinks from 76×114 to 60×90 (width 60, height still derived from --img-portrait 2:3), so the row goes 154 → 130. The --sp-20 block padding stays — what made the row tall was the portrait poster, not the padding. Thumbnail columns follow: 84px ones (--eshop/--bundles/--auctions) become 68, 76px ones (--ip/--rented/events) become 60, each keeping its original gutter. --pickup keeps 76 — that column holds a __thumb (76px square QR icon chip), not the shrinking __image.

Borderless inventory table for E-Shop: product identity (image / thumb + title + meta) + category + price + status + stock + visibility switch + edit action, on row-divider layout. The E-Shop page swaps column layouts per panel via page-level modifiers — --eshop (Products: image / category / price / status / stock / visibility), --bundles (Bundles: image / members / bundle price / stock), --auctions (Auctions: image / category / bid / activity) — all layered on the same base grid. Below 760px the header hides and rows restack. 2026-07-31 user: .product-list__image turned portrait (76×94, width unchanged, height from --img-portrait) — real product photos now render uncropped instead of a square crop of the portrait original. Exceptions: 2026-08-05 (D176 / Q52): ratio value changed to 2 / 3 (76×114, row 154) and the events square exception was dropped — .product-list--events .product-list__image no longer overrides, so all eight list thumbnails now share one ratio with no exception. the pickup page's .product-list__thumb QR icon-chip is a different class and is unaffected. 2026-08-04 pinned section (.product-list__divider + .product-list__pin-mark, spec 5.1.5 F4 / D172) — rows pinned to the front of the fan-facing shop sit above a labelled divider carrying a n/10 count; membership is position, so dragging a row across the divider is what pins or unpins it. No fan-facing "featured" badge: the creator-side cue is the section plus a small pin glyph before the name, which is the only cue left whenever the divider is hidden. 2026-08-05: the divider now holds in every filter and search state (it used to collapse the moment either was active). Filtering only hides non-matching rows, so what stays on screen is still "pinned above, rest below" — the visibility test is therefore "can this view see any pinned row", not "is a filter active". None visible → the whole divider collapses, since a rule reading "pinned above" with nothing above it would lie. The count keeps reporting the panel-wide n/10 quota. The --empty invitation box, by contrast, shows in every filter state (pinning belongs to the list, not to the "All products" view, and "filter to live, then pick a few to feature" is a normal path) — with nothing pinned there are no two sections to divide, so nothing can be misread. Only its action link collapses when the current view holds no pinnable row (a draft-only filter), since it would otherwise be a button that does nothing. With nothing pinned yet the divider stays visible, switches to its --empty variant (a rounded 1px box instead of a single rule — with nothing above it, it invites rather than divides) and swaps to a prompt — "Pin items to the top." with the right-hand slot swapped from the n/10 count to a borderless .btn--ghost action (__divider-cta) — sitting exactly where the pinned section will appear. The link guides rather than acts: it scrolls the first pinnable row into the upper third, opens that row's action menu and rings the Pin entry with .dropdown__item.is-hinted (§4.26); choosing what to pin stays with the creator.

2026-09-04（使用者裁示「這個間距不需要這麼大就縮短」）：清單縮圖 __image 由 76×114 收成 60×90（寬度改 60，高度仍由 --img-portrait 2:3 推導），列高隨之由 154 變 130。上下留白維持 --sp-20——真正撐高列的是直式海報而不是留白。縮圖欄的欄寬跟著收：原本 84px 的（--eshop／--bundles／--auctions）收成 68、原本 76px 的（--ip／--rented／活動清單）收成 60，各自維持原來的 gutter。--pickup 維持 76——那一欄放的是 __thumb（76px 方形 QR 圖示晶片），不是會縮的 __image。

E-Shop 的無框庫存表：商品識別（圖／縮圖＋標題＋meta）＋分類＋價格＋狀態＋庫存＋可見度開關＋編輯動作，列分隔線版式。E-Shop 頁以頁面層修飾子按分頁切換欄位版型——--eshop（商品：圖／分類／價格／狀態／庫存／可見度）、--bundles（套組：圖／成員／套組價／庫存）、--auctions（競標：圖／分類／出價／動態）——都疊在同一 base grid 上。760px 以下表頭隱藏、列重新堆疊。2026-07-31 使用者：.product-list__image 改直式（76×94，寬度不變、高度由 --img-portrait 推導）——真實商品照不再被裁成方形。例外：2026-08-05（D176／Q52）：比例值改 2 / 3（76×114、列高 154），同時撤除活動的方形例外——.product-list--events .product-list__image 的覆寫已刪除，八支清單縮圖現在沒有例外、全部同一個比例；取貨頁的 .product-list__thumb QR icon chip 是不同 class，不受影響。

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Use Badge variants for status and Switch for visibility — no bespoke pills.
  • 狀態用 Badge 變體、可見度用 Switch — 不另刻 pill。
  • Extend columns with a page-level modifier (like --eshop), not by editing the base grid.
  • 用頁面層修飾子（如 --eshop）擴充欄位，不直接改基本 grid。
  • On --eshop, the whole row navigates to Edit on click (2026-07-23, same pattern as Orders/Creators rows) — resolve the destination from that row's own kebab "Edit" <a href>, don't duplicate the draft-vs-created branching logic in a second place.
  • --eshop 整列點擊導向編輯（2026-07-23，比照 Orders／Creators 列的既有模式）——導頁目的地讀該列 kebab「編輯」的 <a href>，別在別的地方另外複刻一份草稿／已建立的判斷邏輯。
Don't別做
  • Don't use it for transaction ledgers — use Table for dense numeric grids.
  • 交易流水帳別用 — 密集數字表格用 Table。
  • Don't put borders around rows — the system look is row-divider only.
  • 別給列加外框 — 系統樣貌只用列分隔線。
For developers — classes · tokens · code給工程師 — class · token · 程式碼

橫向捲動包層 .product-list-scroll（2026-08-06，八個消費頁全數套用）：清單列有 7–9 欄、最窄 830–1160px，而 app 外殼的 .main 是 overflow-x: hidden——視窗一窄，右側的「狀態」「操作」幾欄會被切掉而且捲不到，每一列的 ⋮ 在那個寬度區間整個點不到（既有的 ≤760px 堆疊版型只救得了手機，760px 到各變體最小寬之間是漏的，筆電常見的 1280–1440 就落在裡面）。做法沿用站上既有的表格橫捲；min-width: min-content 讓清單撐到欄寬加總那麼寬，欄數少、放得下的變體不會長出捲軸。上下的 padding-block 是給 :hover 浮起陰影讓位（overflow-x 一旦不是 visible，overflow-y 也會被算成 auto），用等量負外距抵銷、版面高度不變。

兩端固定欄（2026-09-11，使用者指示）：在 .product-list-scroll 內，握把（第一欄）與動作欄（最後一欄）position: sticky 各釘在左右緣，表頭同欄位跟著釘；中間的欄先依 minmax 縮到各自的最小寬，min-content 到底才長出捲軸，內容從動作欄底下滑過去、右側被遮住。≤760px 的堆疊版型另有自己的定位規則（動作欄 absolute），這一段以 @media (min-width: 761px) 圈開。在站上還沒設計更小螢幕的版型之前，每一張清單都先照這一套走。被遮那一側的內容漸變透明（同日第四版；前三版都失敗於同一件事：釘住的格自己沒有底、底下是會動的星空，凡是在格上畫東西——實色底、毛玻璃、漸進模糊——都是一塊看得見的方形，在容器上掛 mask 又把釘住的格一起 mask 掉）：mask 掛在中間每一格自己身上，一條 linear-gradient 由 partials/list-scroll.js 算好的變數定位——容器上的 --pls-lx／--pls-rx（淡出帶起點＝釘住格內緣＋scrollLeft；該側沒被遮就寫 ±99999px 推出視野＝關掉）與 --pls-fade（帶寬 --sp-56），每格自己的 --cell-x（在清單本體裡的 x，只在版面變時重量）；格的 mask 座標＝容器座標減 --cell-x，同一條 gradient 對每格都對。捲動只改容器上兩個變數，格的 mask 由瀏覽器重算。釘住的格、星空與列的 hover 玻璃都不在 mask 裡，真正淡掉的只有滑到底下的圖與字；同支 js 也依捲動位置在容器上寫 data-scrolled-left／data-scrolled-right，沒被遮的清單不掛 mask。釘選分隔列 __divider 整條 sticky 釘在左緣、寬度＝看得到的那一段（--pls-w＝容器 clientWidth，js 寫上），框的右緣永遠在視野裡、「立即釘選」永遠在右端（使用者：「這個要隨著寬度縮放，立即釘選要一直在右邊」）。橫捲拉桿 .product-list-scrollbar（使用者：「當有遮蔽時，下方要有一條拉吧，粗一點好拖動，上面要有點點矩陣紋理，像盲人點字」）：清單自己的捲軸在整張表最底下搆不到，js 在容器後面補一條只有橫向捲軸的代理容器（內容寬＝清單本體、兩邊 scrollLeft 互相同步），sticky 在頁面捲動容器底緣；只在放不下時出現。拉桿本體 20px 膠囊（首版 14，使用者：「再粗一點」）、::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb 鋪 5px 間距、--foreground 22% 的圓點，點只畫在透明 border 內縮出的 padding-box（上下 5＝兩整排、左右 10 避開圓弧）、橫向 background-repeat: round 不切半顆（首版 3px／全值、直接鋪滿，使用者兩輪：「點字不要這麼密、顏色不要這麼亮」「還是太亮，有些點點被切掉」）；不寫 scrollbar-width／scrollbar-color——Chrome 121 起標準屬性一有值就忽略 ::-webkit-scrollbar。

Every identity field and status axis gets its own column (was: identity crammed in one cell, two .status-axes badges sharing one Status cell). The fulfilment column carries both delivery and pickup values — shipping uses To ship / Shipped / Completed, on-site pickup uses Awaiting pickup (orders.status.pickup); a mixed order stacks the two badges, one per line (__ship is a left-aligned flex column; changed 2026-08-28 per user direction, and the column floor dropped 148 → 120 to match a single badge at its widest measured 118px, handing the freed 30px to the Contents column). The pickup badge is promoted from item-level meta to a fulfilment-axis value — reinterprets D111, see ASSUMPTIONS. Payment axis stays separate from fulfilment. The order # carries a tiny copy button (__copy); the orders list has no thumbnail column (removed 2026-07-23 per user directive). The Contents column (__line) shows one item per line in white at the standard cell size (fs-13), lines spaced apart, clamped to 4 lines with an ellipsis. The whole row is clickable to open the order (__row cursor:pointer; kebab & copy button stopPropagation, matching the creators list). ds-components/product-list.css

4.27 Project list

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

Borderless table list for the Projects page. Shares Product list's visual DNA (real image thumbnail, row-divider, accent hover) but with project columns and whole-row links to the detail page. Columns: image · project (type above name + one-line desc) · current goal (smaller bold percentage, compact progress bar, then amount on three separate lines) · time left · category (content type over family) · status · chevron. Only funding / pre-order campaigns have a goal and countdown; every other kind shows an em-dash in those two columns. Below 1180px the secondary columns (time / category) drop; below 760px rows restack. (2026-07-24: the to-do tip column was removed; the goal cell gained its reusable progress bar; type moved into the project identity stack.) 2026-07-31 user: .project-list__image turned portrait (76×94, same recipe as .product-list__image) — width unchanged, height derives from --img-portrait; row height grows from 116 to 134.

Projects 頁的無框表格列表。與 Product list 同一套視覺 DNA（真圖縮圖、列分隔線、accent hover），但欄位是項目專屬、整列連進明細頁。欄位：圖片 · 項目（類型／名稱／一行簡介）· 當前目標（第一排小一級粗體百分比、第二排細進度條、第三排實際金額）· 剩餘時間 · 類別（內容類型疊家族）· 狀態 · chevron。只有募資／預購項目有目標與倒數，其餘類型這兩欄顯示破折號。1180px 以下收掉次要欄（剩餘時間／類別），760px 以下列重新堆疊。（2026-07-24：移除待辦 tip 欄，當前目標加入可重用進度條；類型併入項目識別區。）2026-07-31 使用者：.project-list__image 改直式（76×94，與 .product-list__image 同一套推導）——寬度不變、高度由 --img-portrait 推導，列高從 116 長到 134。

Do & Don't

Do該做
  • Keep the whole row as one <a> — the chevron is a hint, not the only target.
  • 整列維持單一 <a> — chevron 是提示，不是唯一點擊目標。
  • Show an em-dash in goal / time for kinds without a campaign, don't invent numbers.
  • 沒有募資的類型，目標／倒數顯示破折號，不要編造數字。
Don't別做
  • Don't nest buttons or other links inside the row link — the whole row is one target.
  • 別在列連結內塞按鈕或其他連結 — 整列是單一點擊目標。
  • Don't fork the row layout per page — extend with modifiers.
  • 別為單頁另刻列版式 — 用修飾子擴充。

Why the shell has a fixed height

為什麼殼層要釘選高度

The active tab's orange underline sits on the bottom edge of .tabs__item. Only when the tabs stretch the full 58px does that underline land at the very bottom of the shell instead of floating mid-height — hence the fixed height plus align-items: stretch.

active tab 的橘色底線貼在 .tabs__item 下緣。只有讓 tabs 撐滿整個 58px，底線才會落在殼層最底部、而不是浮在中間——所以是固定高度加 align-items: stretch。

Not part of this component

Sticky pinning depends on each page's scroll container height and stacking, so it stays in the page's own <style>: E-Shop pins both layers (status row at top: 74px = 58px shell + 16px collapsed margin); Projects does not pin.

4.32 Empty card

🟡 molecule

In-card empty state for a loaded-but-no-data view (spec 5.1.1 §F2–F8「其他狀態 · 無資料」): muted icon + short title + one line of guidance + optional CTA. Differs from empty-stub (full-page "route not built"). On the dashboard it's toggled against the data view via <html data-data-state="empty"> (Cheat Codes) using .dash-empty-only / .dash-data-only.

卡片內的空狀態（已載入但沒資料；規格 5.1.1 §F2–F8「其他狀態 · 無資料」）：淡化 icon + 短標題 + 一行引導 + 選配 CTA。與 empty-stub（整頁「路由未建置」）不同。儀表板透過 <html data-data-state="empty">（Cheat Codes）以 .dash-empty-only / .dash-data-only 與資料視圖互切。

The empty state never sits on a card fill. A card's background says "there is a set of things here" — with nothing inside, that fill draws a solid block around the emptiness, making the loudest cell on the page the one with no content. The rule lives in the component layer, so call sites need no change: a card whose only children are empty states (and optionally an .info-banner explaining why it is empty) loses its background, border and padding. A card that also carries a heading or real content keeps its fill — there the background frames that section, not the empty state.

空狀態不吃卡片底色。卡片的底色是在說「這裡有一組東西」；裡面沒有東西時，那塊底色反而替「什麼都沒有」畫出一個實心方塊，讓版面上最顯眼的一格內容是零。規則寫在元件層、呼叫點不必改：一張卡的子元素只有空狀態（外加選配的 .info-banner 說明為什麼是空的）時，底色、外框與內距一併取消。卡片同時有標題列或真的內容時維持底色——那時候底色框的是那個區塊，不是空狀態。

4.133 Card group

🔵 atom

Purpose

用途

The three-piece toolkit for grouping information inside one card (Q71 定案 2026-08-25). When a card holds more than one cluster of information, the question is "how independent does this cluster need to be" — three levels, weakest to strongest: Level 1 (default, this component) — a sub-heading or a divider line, no new fill layer. Level 2 — a 1px-bordered box, reuse Control row's .control-group, not redefined here. Level 3 — a whole new fill layer, reuse Nest, not redefined here. This component only owns Level 1 plus the whole-card heading one rung above it (.card-head).

卡片裡面分組的三件組（Q71 定案 2026-08-25）。一張卡裡有多組資訊時，判準是「這塊需要多強的獨立性」，由弱到強三級：第 1 級（預設，本元件）——次級標題或分隔線，不加填色層。第 2 級——1px 線框圈起來，沿用 Control row 的 .control-group，本元件不重複定義。第 3 級——整層新填色，沿用 Nest，本元件不重複定義。本元件只負責第 1 級，以及比子組再高一階、服務整張卡的大標（.card-head）。

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Start with a title or divider (Level 1) before reaching for a border or a fill.
  • 先試小標或分隔線（第 1 級），再考慮線框或填色。
  • Use .card-head only for the whole card's own heading, not for a sub-group inside it.
  • .card-head 只給整張卡自己的大標用，不是給卡內某個子組用。
Don't別做
  • Don't invent a fourth grouping level or a grey "down" fill — Level 3's fill direction is fixed to Nest's "always up" rule (Q66).
  • 別自創第四種分組級別或往暗的灰填色——第 3 級的填色方向固定跟 Nest 的「只往亮疊」規則（Q66）。
  • Don't stack .group-divider and a Level-2 border on the same boundary — pick one strength per boundary.
  • 同一條界線別同時疊 .group-divider 與第 2 級線框——一條界線只選一種強度。

Specification

規格

Sourcecard-group.css
Anatomy.card/.ztor-card (parent, supplies --card-pad) > .group-title (+ optional .group-desc) > one group's content (.control-group/.radio-list/.segmented/.kv…) > .group-divider > next group. Whole-card heading variant: .card.card-head > .card-head__title (+ .card-head__desc) > .card-head__rule. Standalone row helpers: .attr-value / .attr-link.
Behavior / usageSpacing ladder (2026-08-25 定案，two rounds of "make the gap bigger"): row-to-row inside one group 14+14 (each content type's own rhythm); sub-heading → content 32px combined (heading gives 18px, content types with their own 14px top-margin merge to 32; content with none or a different top-margin overrides with the direct-sibling selector); group-divider 32px above and below (64 total + a line); card-head 24px above the title, 32px below the rule. The line and the plain whitespace are deliberately on different tracks — a line signals "new group", whitespace is pure breathing room, they don't stack. .group-divider and .card-head__rule bleed to the parent's outer edge via margin: … calc(-1 * var(--card-pad, var(--sp-20))), falling back to 20px if the parent never set --card-pad.
Token usage--sp-4/--sp-18/--sp-24/--sp-32, --border, --fs-12/--fs-13/--fs-16, --foreground/--foreground-muted/--muted-foreground.

Anatomy: .pager container + .btn.btn--ghost.btn--sm page buttons (current = aria-current="page", solid fill) + .pager__ellipsis. Tokens: --primary/--primary-foreground · --muted-foreground · --sp-*.

結構：.pager 容器 + .btn.btn--ghost.btn--sm 頁碼（目前頁 aria-current="page" 實色底）+ .pager__ellipsis。Token：--primary/--primary-foreground·--muted-foreground·--sp-*。

Behavior lives in js/pager.js (2026-08-10, lifted out of partials/finance-overview.js once a page that doesn't load that partial needed pagination too). window.ztorPager.mount(getRows, size, nav) returns render(page) — call it again after the caller re-renders its rows. The caller supplies a getter for the rows currently being paginated, the page size, and a .pager container; the module only decides which rows are visible and never owns the data. A single page draws no page numbers: a lone "1" carries no information.

行為住在 js/pager.js（2026-08-10 自 partials/finance-overview.js 抽出——有一頁不載那支 partial 卻也要分頁，留在原處就得複製一份）。window.ztorPager.mount(getRows, size, nav) 回傳 render(page)，呼叫端重畫資料後再呼叫一次即可。呼叫端給的是「目前要分頁的列」的 getter、每頁筆數與 .pager 容器；模組只決定哪幾列看得見，不接管資料。只有一頁時不畫頁碼列——一顆孤零零的「1」不提供任何資訊。

Evidence: earnings-sony (projects table 8/page, withdrawal history 6/page); earnings + earnings-sony content-earnings post report (5/page).

Evidence／使用頁：earnings-sony（項目表 8/頁、提領歷史 6/頁）；earnings 與 earnings-sony 的內容收益·貼文報告明細（5/頁）。

4.34 KPI

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

Flat metric tile: one uppercase label, one big display value, and a semantic delta or neutral meta line. Use for dashboard summary rows, earnings tabs, and page-header metric strips where one number per tile is the point. Avoid when the value needs a trend chart — use the Chart organism.

扁平的指標 tile：一個大寫 label、一個大型 display 數值，加上一條帶語意的 delta 或中性的 meta 行。用於 dashboard 摘要列、earnings tab、頁首指標帶等「每個 tile 一個數字」的情境。數值需要趨勢圖時別用 — 改用 Chart organism。

.kpi[hidden] explicitly resets display — the component is flex, which beats the UA default for [hidden]. Added 2026-07-30; before that, anywhere setting el.hidden on a KPI failed to hide it (e.g. event detail hiding metrics that do not apply to the event type).

.kpi[hidden] 已顯式歸零 display——元件本身是 flex，會蓋過瀏覽器對 [hidden] 的預設。2026-07-30 補上；在此之前凡是用 el.hidden 收 KPI 的地方都藏不掉（例如活動詳情要收起不適用於該活動類型的指標）。

4.37b Detail overview（三欄骨架）

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

Three-column skeleton for a detail page's Overview tab. Each column answers one question, which is what decides where a block goes — not how wide the page happens to be: left (narrow) = the numbers (KPIs stacked vertically), middle (wide) = where this thing has got to (release tracking, status card, progress), right = what this is + what needs you (identity facts, plans, next step, notifications — the user's rule: anything that notifies goes in the right column). Not .bento: bento lays out row by row, this is three independent columns that do not align across.

詳情頁「總覽」分頁的三欄骨架。三欄各自回答一個問題，這是分欄的依據，不是為了填滿寬度：左（窄）＝數字（KPI 直排）、中（寬）＝進行到哪（上架追蹤／狀態卡／進度摘要）、右＝是什麼 ＋ 要你動手（識別事實、方案、下一步、通知——使用者裁示「有通知的就往右放一欄」）。不用 .bento：bento 是一列一列往下鋪，這裡要的是三根各自往下長、彼此不對列的柱子。

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Place span modifiers on direct children (e.g. .kpi.bento--span-3).
  • 把 span 修飾子放在直接子元素上（例如 .kpi.bento--span-3）。
  • Keep span numbers summing to 12 per row.
  • 讓每列的 span 數字加總為 12。
  • Add --top when two cards in a row differ a lot in content length.
  • 一排裡兩張卡內容量差很多時，加上 --top。
  • Try __stack first — levelling the two columns beats leaving a gap.
  • 先想能不能用 __stack 疊欄 — 高度收齊比留白好。
Don't別做
  • Expect modifiers below 900px — they collapse to one column.
  • 期待修飾子在 900px 以下生效 — 它們會收成單欄。
  • Use span values outside the active set.
  • 使用啟用範圍外的 span 值。
  • Make --top the default — equal heights read tidier for same-weight cards.
  • 把 --top 當預設 — 同量級的卡等高比較整齊。

.bento__stack--fillThe stack itself fills the row height (height:100%), but the cards inside keep their natural heights — leftover space stays at the bottom. The earlier rule that gave the last card flex:1 to absorb that space was removed on 2026-08-31: the card it stretched holds one label, one number and a footnote, and pulling it taller opens a void between the number and the footnote that reads as content failing to load rather than as a bigger card. Mutually exclusive with --top, which lets each column keep its natural height.這一疊本身佔滿整列高度（height:100%），但疊裡的卡各自維持自然高度，多出來的空間留在最下面。原本「讓最後一張卡吃掉剩餘高度」（flex:1）那條已於 2026-08-31 撤掉：被撐開的那張卡只有一個標籤、一個數字與一行註腳，拉高之後數字與註腳中間空出一大片，讀起來像內容沒載完，而不是「這張卡比較大」。與 --top 互斥，那條讓每欄各自保留自然高度。

4.40 NavigationMenu

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

The canonical topbar nav item: either a plain link (no dropdown) or a group trigger that opens a mega-dropdown of icon + title + sub options. This is the single nav system — the shipped .app-topbar uses it, and the Header composes it. Use a group trigger when a section exposes several destinations (IP Bank / E-Shop / Fans); use a plain link for a single destination (Dashboard / Earnings).

標準的 topbar nav 項目:可以是純連結(無下拉),或是會展開「icon＋標題＋子標」mega-dropdown 的群組 trigger。這是**唯一**的 nav 系統 —— 出貨的 .app-topbar 用它,Header 組成它。一個區段要露出多個去處時用群組 trigger(IP Bank／E-Shop／Fans);單一去處用純連結(Dashboard／Earnings)。

Admin-layer variant (spec §4.1 / D086): on the Creator-Management roster the Tier-1 items render locked (.app-topbar__link--locked) behind a "Creator Management" marker; inside a creator workspace a back-to-roster icon (.app-topbar__back) sits BEFORE the logo, with a "Managing <creator>" chip (.app-topbar__context). Styling lives in shared.css; injected by sidebar.js per the active creator.

Admin 層變體（spec §4.1／D086）：Creator 管理名冊上，Tier 1 各項以鎖定態呈現（.app-topbar__link--locked），前面是「Creator Management」標記；進入某 creator 工作區後，logo 之前出現返回名冊 icon（.app-topbar__back）＋「管理中 <creator>」chip（.app-topbar__context）。樣式住 shared.css、由 sidebar.js 依活躍 creator 注入。

4.41 Header (app topbar)

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

Canonical 64px sticky app topbar — brand logo left, semantic nav with a sliding highlight pill + mega-dropdown groups, and a right action cluster (theme · search · notifications · avatar). This is the real shipped topbar (.app-topbar, injected by sidebar.js); the markup below is a static mirror. It is the single persistent topbar on every product page, injected by sidebar.js at #sidebar/#topbar. Nav order follows the sitemap; mega-dropdowns group IP Bank / E-Shop / Fans sub-routes. Avoid a second nav bar — promote new global actions into __actions. D220 (2026-08-24) retired the shell language toggle; D221 (same day) revised D220 and brought it back; D222 (same day) withdrew D221's split into two independent states — the account-menu dropdown carries an expandable "Default language" row (see the account-dropdown demo under NavigationMenu). Language is a single concept with three entry points: settings.html, this account menu, and login.html — all three change the same value, which is both the interface language and the language new content is written in.

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Keep the rail read-only — it is the "what you should know before you change something" column, visible from every tab.
  • 右欄保持唯讀——它是「改東西前要先知道」的欄位，在任何分頁都看得到。
  • Let .detail-main keep its min-width: 0 so a wide table or long string can't blow the grid open.
  • 保留 .detail-main 的 min-width: 0，寬表格或長字串才不會把 grid 撐破。
Don't別做
  • Don't add per-card margin inside the rail — spacing is owned by the rail's gap, and Form section's sibling margin-top is deliberately zeroed here so the gap isn't doubled.
  • 別在右欄的卡上自行加 margin——間距由右欄的 gap 決定，Form section 相鄰卡的 margin-top 已在此刻意歸零，避免間距變成兩倍。
  • Don't document "which cards go in the rail" here — that's a Pillar 5 pattern decision, and duplicating it splits the source of truth.
  • 別在這裡寫「右欄該放哪些卡」——那是 Pillar 5 的 pattern 決策，寫兩份會讓真相分岔。

The consumer's tab-switching logic decides when to apply it; the component never inspects the current tab. Sourcepage-intro.css
AnatomyOptional crumb (with optional back button) + title + lede (supporting copy, optional help link) + optional action cluster + optional page footnote.
Behavior / usageDefault / with actions; mobile title resolves to 32px; eyebrow pattern is retired. Back button (2026-08-02) — the 10 detail pages put .page-crumb__back (a .btn.btn--icon-circle.btn--sm wrapping chevron-left) as the first child of the crumb and add .page-crumb--back, which switches the crumb row to flex so the button sits on the baseline row. It is a real <a> pointing at the crumb's parent level, not history.back(): arriving from a bookmark or shared link leaves no history to pop, and a link keeps cmd-click / copy-address working. Two deviations from the plain atom are deliberate and scoped to this consumer: the crumb's a { color: inherit } would otherwise paint the glyph brand-orange and draw a hover underline under the SVG, so .page-crumb .page-crumb__back restores the standard --muted-foreground → --foreground icon-button pairing; and it runs frameless (background: transparent; border: 0, 2026-08-02 user ruling) — dropping only the frame would leave the atom's --muted fill, which shows as a grey disc in dark mode and disappears entirely against the light-mode white page, so the same button would look like two different things per theme. At rest it is just the chevron; the circle returns on hover via the atom's --accent background. The gap to the first crumb is --sp-16 rather than --sp-10 for the same reason: with no visible edge, the empty box around the glyph stops reading as space. Hidden under html[data-embed] (shared.css) because the detail-sheet overlay already carries its own "Back to X" — two back controls in one view force the user to work out which one goes where, and the crumb's is a full-page navigation that would swap the iframe while the overlay stays open. The action cluster is for controls that change data only (2026-07-31 ruling) and wraps (flex-wrap: wrap) if a wide control is placed there. Contextual help goes in .page-intro__lede as .page-intro__help — an inline accent link after the last sentence; it cannot be nested inside __sub because applyI18n replaces that node's innerHTML on language switch. .page-note is the page-level footnote (bookend to .page-crumb) for whole-page disclaimers. Top alignment + stacked sub (2026-08-31 user ruling) — .page-intro__lead aligns its children to flex-start, not flex-end: the 2:3 key visual is taller than the text block, so baseline alignment pushed the badges and title down and left a gap above them. .page-intro__sub--stack puts each <span> child of the sub on its own line, for consumers whose sub carries two different kinds of fact (when vs. where) — run together on one line, a long venue name decides the wrap point and the reader has to regroup the sentence. Each line opens with a .ztor-icon naming its kind (calendar / map-pin), styled inline at 15px the same way .data-list__meta .ztor-icon is — the icon is the shortest possible label for that line, cheaper than repeating the words "Starts" and "Venue".

4.126 Stack

⚪ utility

Purpose

用途

The one rule for vertical space between sibling blocks: the container owns the gap, children never add margins. Before this existed every page solved it its own way (.mt-16, inline margins, a local gap), so some places stuck together and others drifted apart — the same role with three answers. Child margins also break on the first/last item and on conditionally hidden blocks: a hidden block leaves its margin behind, a gap does not. Default --sp-18; --tight is --sp-12 for小 blocks that belong to one thought, --loose is --sp-24 for sections that genuinely part ways. Override per case with --stack-gap on the container, never on the children. Not for horizontal layout, and not for form fields — those keep the 16px .field rhythm settled in Q6.

同層區塊之間的垂直間距只有一條規則：間距由容器承擔（gap），子元素不各自加 margin。這支元件出現之前每一頁各自解（.mt-16、inline margin、自己的 gap），結果有的地方黏在一起、有的地方鬆掉，同一個角色三種答案。子元素加 margin 還會在「第一個／最後一個」與條件隱藏的區塊上出錯——被隱藏的那一塊仍把 margin 留在原地，gap 不會。預設 --sp-18；--tight（--sp-12）給同一件事的小塊，--loose（--sp-24）給語意分家的大段落。個案覆寫在容器上寫 --stack-gap，不要改子元素。不用於橫向排列；表單欄位之間也不用（那是 .field 的 16px 節奏，Q6 已裁決）。

Segmented variant (--segmented, 2026-08-10)

分段變體 （--segmented，2026-08-10）

One segment per step, so the seams land exactly on the step boundaries. Solid = done, tinted = the step you are on, empty = not reached. Set --steps (how many steps are visible) and --at (current step, 1-based) alongside --progress (the completed share). Without the modifier the track stays one continuous bar, so existing consumers are untouched. The optional __state line under each name spells the status out — a bar length alone cannot say which step is finished.

一步一段，縫的位置就是步驟分界。實色＝已完成、淡色＝你在這一步、空的＝還沒到。用法是在容器上設 --steps（看得到幾步）與 --at（現在第幾步，1 起算），--progress 仍是已完成的比例。沒加這個修飾類的消費頁維持一條連續長條、行為不變。名稱下方選配的 __state 把狀態直接寫出來——光靠一條軌道的長度說不出「哪一步做完了」。
