AnatomyTrack + gradient fill (width = --progress) + step labels.
Label statesdefault / --done (clickable) / --current. Since 2026-08-10 the label is a flex box with its own padding so the hit area matches what looks clickable; --done and --current take an --accent hover, future steps do not. [hidden] is restored explicitly because display:flex beats the UA rule.
--anystepOptional; every step reachable (2026-08-10, per user: "these steps should all be clickable") — by default only --done and --current get pointer + hover, because the default click handler only allows going back to a completed or current step and moving forward goes through Next; a future step that looks pressable but isn't is worse than one that plainly isn't. Adding --anystep declares that the consuming page's click handler accepts a jump to any step, so the clickable affordance opens up for all labels. Both halves are required: the class alone gives you "looks pressable, does nothing"; the handler alone gives you "works, but nobody can tell". Skipped steps are already [hidden] and unaffected. First consumer: create-event.
Track3px (was 6px until 2026-08-10). --segmented splits it into one segment per step using --steps; --at marks the current segment. Current segment is neutral, not a diluted brand tint (2026-08-10, per user: "the translucent colour looks broken on step 1") — it used to be --primary at 28%, which over the dark track (#161718) mixes to a muddy brown that reads as an orange that failed to render, most visibly on step 1 where it is the only thing on the track. It is now color-mix(--foreground-muted 45%, transparent), so hue belongs to "done" alone and brightness only answers "where am I". The fill no longer animates on --segmented (2026-08-10, per user: "a bit of orange shows up on step 1") — the continuous track animates its width because the transition itself carries meaning (sliding from 40% to 60%); on a segmented track the fill only ever rests on a segment boundary, so the 350ms in between briefly paints a "half-filled segment" that never actually exists. It was most visible stepping back to step 1 (0% complete): a sliver of orange lingered at the track's left edge as the fill animated down to nothing, reading as a rendering glitch. transition: none and border-radius: 0 (the track's own pill radius + overflow:hidden already round both ends; a second rounding on a near-zero-width box draws a hairline at 2× DPR).
Label / track alignment2026-08-10, per user ("the step titles don't line up with the bar") — the base label row is space-between: first label flush left, last flush right, the rest sharing the slack, each as wide as its own text. The track is equal segments. Two different divisions can never agree. --segmented therefore lays its labels out on grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--steps), minmax(0,1fr)): one cell per segment, so the text starts exactly at the segment's edge and the hover fill covers exactly that segment. Non-segmented consumers keep space-between. Hover range corrected 2026-08-10 (per user: "the hover range looks broken") — the first attempt kept the base inline padding and cancelled it with an equal negative margin. The text lined up, but the hover box then ran 8px past its segment on each side, so the fill and the segment above it disagreed and the highlight read as half a column off. The negative margin is gone: the grid cell is already one segment wide, the label fills it, and the hover fill lands exactly on that segment (measured at 1440px, 5 steps: every label box matches its segment's x and width to 0px). Inline padding stays (2026-08-10, per user: "it needs left padding") — alignment is the box's job, guaranteed by the grid; the text then uses that padding to keep 8px off the box edge, or it would sit flush against the hover fill and read as cramped. Box flush to the segment, text breathing inside the box: the two do not conflict. Vertical padding is unchanged, so the hit area keeps its height (45px).
Token usage--gradient-brand, --muted, --fs-12, --muted-foreground/muted.

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

Focused create-flow template without the app topbar: a floating frosted top-bar capsule (back + title, Stepper, save status), body content, and a bottom action bar that is a same-colour mask laid over the content.

無 app topbar 的專注建立流程模板：浮起的磨砂頂列膠囊（返回＋標題、Stepper、儲存狀態）、內容 body、疊在內容上的同色遮色片底部動作列。

2026-09-23 — top bar and footer redesign (UI-CHANGES 74). The top bar now looks like the events list toolbar (List toolbar): one floating capsule with rounded corners — the same glass fill, 24px blur, 1px --border, --shadow-card + --shadow-edge-top and --radius-xl. The capsule is drawn by .wizard__top::before and fills that element's content box, so when the header gets a second row (create-bundle's section tabs) the same capsule wraps both rows. The ring around it is fully transparent: content scrolling up shows around the capsule and blurs through it. The footer is no longer a separate surface. The content sheet runs to the bottom of the viewport (no bottom radius, no drop shadow), and the footer is laid over it as a mask in the sheet's own colour and dot pattern (background: inherit + background-attachment: fixed), with a 56px fade on its top edge. The sheet reserves the footer's height as padding-bottom, which partials/wizard-chrome.js measures into --wizard-foot-h.

2026-09-23 頂列與底列改版 （UI-CHANGES 七十四）：頂列改成跟活動清單工作列（List toolbar）同一種樣子——一顆浮起的圓角膠囊，材質照抄（玻璃底、24px 模糊、1px --border、--shadow-card＋--shadow-edge-top、--radius-xl）。膠囊由 .wizard__top::before 畫、大小＝它的內容框，所以頂列多一排（建立組合包的分節分頁）時同一顆膠囊包住兩排。膠囊外圍一圈完全透明，內容往上捲會從四周露出來、捲進膠囊底下變模糊。底列不再是另一塊顏色：內容卡延伸到視窗底（沒有下緣圓角與投影），底列是一片跟內容卡同色、同點陣的遮色片疊在上面（background: inherit＋background-attachment: fixed），上緣 56px 漸層淡出。內容卡用 padding-bottom 留出底列高度，高度由 partials/wizard-chrome.js 量成 --wizard-foot-h。

4.52b Stock bar

🟢 atom

Purpose

用途

A 5px horizontal quantity bar that says "how much is left" at a glance — stock level, usage ratio. Always pairs with the exact figure next to it (e.g. "3 / 50"): the bar carries the feel, the number carries the truth, and neither substitutes for the other. Thinner and simpler than the Completeness meter, which owns its own label + count header; this one is bare track + fill and expects the surrounding card to supply the wording.

5px 高的水平量條，一眼讀出「還剩多少」——庫存水位、用量比例。一定要搭配旁邊的精確數字（例如「3 / 50」）：量條負責體感、數字負責精確值，兩者不可互相取代。比 Completeness meter 更細更簡單——那支自帶標籤＋計數表頭，本元件只有軌道＋填充，文字由外層的卡提供。

Do該做

Fact list 🔵 atom · fact-list.css

A read-only record: label on the left, value on the right, one per line, hairline separators. For detail dialogs and anywhere that answers questions rather than collecting answers. Not .field — form labels are the vocabulary of “waiting for you to type”, and read-only content dressed in them reads as a disabled form. Not .data-list — that one is for lists of things (40px icon tile, taller rows, often clickable); a fact is not a thing, it is one line saying what a value is, and eight of them in a data list blows each one up into an object. Distinct from .review-status__meta / .ptl__meta, which flow inline and suit one or two footnotes under a heading; this one is a column you read down.

一組唯讀紀錄：左邊灰字說這是什麼、右邊放值，一項一行、髮絲線分隔。給詳情彈窗這類「回答問題、不能編輯」的內容用。不用 .field——表單標籤是「等你填」的語彙，拿它裝唯讀內容會讀成一張被停用的表單。也不用 .data-list——那支是給「一列一個東西、可能可以點進去」的清單用的，有 40px 圖示磚與較大行高；事實不是物件，它只是一句「這一欄的值是什麼」，八項排出來每一項都被放大成一個獨立的東西。與 .review-status__meta／.ptl__meta 的分工：那兩支是行內流式，適合一兩項附註掛在標題底下；本支一項一行、值靠右，適合五項以上要逐行對照的紀錄。2026-08-19 建（消費頁：project-detail 的更新詳情彈窗）。

Progress mark 🔵 atom · progress-mark.css

One mark shared by both progress surfaces — Progress timeline and Step list. Three rules: every milestone is a tick box (hollow ring + faint check = not yet, filled green + white check = done, filled red + exclamation = overdue) — one shape for a milestone's whole life, only the fill and the glyph change; fill = weight, read first when scanning, with the glyph as the confirmation you get on stopping; a small hollow dot (--ghost) means this row is not a milestone (a general update, the project-created node) — no state, so no glyph. --today is a position on the axis rather than a milestone state, so it stays glyph-less: a check there would read as “today is done”.

一顆記號，兩個消費者共用：Progress timeline（進度分頁的時間軸）與 Step list（總覽的進度摘要）。語言三條規則——每一顆里程碑都是一個打勾格（空心圈＋淡勾＝還沒到、實心綠＋白勾＝已完成、實心紅＋驚嘆號＝逾期）：同一個形狀走完一顆里程碑的一生，狀態換的是填色與字符、不是形狀，形狀一換讀者就得重新學一次；填色＝份量，它是掃視時第一個被看到的訊號，字符是停下來之後的確認；空心小點（--ghost）＝這一列不是里程碑（一般更新、項目建立），它沒有狀態、不會逾期，所以也沒有字符可放。--today 是軸上的一個位置而不是里程碑的狀態，所以不放字符——放勾會讀成「今天完成了」。
2026-08-18 兩輪裁決：先是把兩處各自的畫法（摘要的圈＋字符、軸的點的顏色）收成一套（方案 B），同日使用者看過實機後追加「軸上也要有勾勾或驚嘆號」，尺寸因此收斂成單一 20px（--sm／--md 墓碑），兩處現在是同一顆記號，不是同一套規則的兩個尺寸。

還沒到 todo 已完成 done 審核中 doing（只給「完成作品」那顆系統節點；里程碑已無此態） 逾期 alert 今天 today 不是里程碑 ghost

Step list 🟡 molecule · step-list.css

A short list of steps that answers “how far along are we” — not a timeline. Unlike Progress timeline, it has no date gutter, no today marker and nothing to scroll back through: each row only says which stage it is in. The state marks come from Progress mark at --md, shared with the timeline (2026-08-18) — this list only adds the row-level weight on top: --alert (late) colours the whole row, --todo dims it to 55%. The mark is small, so colouring it alone gets skipped when scanning.

一串回答「走到第幾步」的清單，不是時間軸。與 Progress timeline 的差別：沒有日期欄、沒有今天、不能往回捲，每一列只說它在哪一段。狀態記號用 Progress mark 的 --md，與進度分頁的時間軸共用同一套（2026-08-18 使用者裁決方案 B）；這一份只在記號之上再加**整列**的份量：--alert（逾期）把整列一起上色、--todo 壓到 55%。記號小、色塊也小，只染記號掃過去會被略過。消費頁：project-detail 總覽的進度摘要。

4.51b Progress timeline

🟠 organism

A vertical time flow driven by real dates: future at the top, today in the middle, the past below (spec 5.1.2.2 §2.2.10 v3.0, D194). Three columns — date gutter / axis with its dot / content. The single sort key is the date, so there is no manual reordering: change the date and the node moves. Today is a real node on the axis, the only row whose wording changes with the situation, and the post composer is embedded in it.

一條由真實日期驅動的垂直時間流：未來在上、今天在中、過去在下（規格 5.1.2.2 §2.2.10 v3.0，D194）。版面三欄：日期欄／軸線與軸點／內容欄。排序只有一個依據就是日期，所以沒有手動調整順序——要換位置就改日期。今天是軸上一個真實節點，也是整條軸上唯一會隨情境換說法的位置，發文框內嵌在它身上。

What on the axis opens — the axis is for scanning, so each row carries only what reads at a glance; the rest goes into a detail dialog. Two click targets share one hover/focus treatment (negative side margins so the highlight runs 8px wider than the text — otherwise it reads as a box drawn around the words): .ptl__update[data-up-open] (2026-08-19, D205) is any update, including the completion note nested under a milestone; .ptl__head[data-ms-open] (2026-08-20, D208) is the title row of a completed milestone. There are only two kinds of update post (D206) and both must open — and a milestone post's whole appearance on the axis is that milestone row, so leaving only its nested body clickable makes half of that post unreachable. Unfinished milestones stay unclickable: the record answers “what happened to this one”, and one that has not happened yet has nothing the row is not already showing.

軸上哪些東西點得開——軸是掃視用的，一列只放讀得下去的份量，其餘進詳情彈窗。兩種可點目標共用同一套 hover／focus（負的左右 margin 讓底色比文字往兩側各長 8px，不然亮起來像文字被框住）：.ptl__update[data-up-open]（2026-08-19，D205）＝每一則更新，含掛在里程碑底下的完成宣告；.ptl__head[data-ms-open]（2026-08-20，D208）＝已完成里程碑的整條標題列。更新貼文只有兩種（D206），兩種都要點得開，而里程碑貼文在軸上的樣子就是那一列里程碑——只讓底下那一小段內文可點，等於這一類貼文有一半的呈現點不開。未完成的不可點：紀錄回答的是「這顆發生過什麼」，還沒完成的那一顆能寫的只有軸上已經寫著的預計日期。

項目建立

Two rows never move with the dates. --system (Finished work) is pinned to the very top of the axis and carries no date — its date is the release day, which may not exist yet. --start (Project created) is pinned to the very bottom and is where the connector line stops; the line is switched off on --start rather than on :last-child, because nodes can be appended after it during a render. The system node stores no state of its own: it reads the submission record straight from js/work-review-store.js, so Overview, Progress and the work itself can never disagree.

兩列不隨日期移動。--system（完成作品）釘在軸的最上方、不帶日期——它的日期是上映日，可能還沒定。--start（項目建立）釘在最下方，也是軸線的終點；軸線關在 --start 而不是 :last-child，因為渲染時它之後還可能被追加節點。系統節點**不存自己的狀態**——直接讀 js/work-review-store.js 的送審件，所以總覽、進度與作品三處講的一定是同一件事。

4.52 Section nav

🟡 molecule

The left-hand list for switching sections. Since 2026-08-26 (Q75 extended) it is also the page-level navigation on every detail page — product, project, auction, bundle, creator, fan, IP, series, settings — replacing the horizontal .tabs there. Division of labour with tabs.css now: .section-nav owns section switching on detail pages; horizontal .tabs stays for list-page toolbars and in-section filters. Five or more items in a horizontal bar wrap or truncate; a vertical list grows naturally.

切換分節的左側清單。2026-08-26 起（Q75 擴大）它也是所有詳情頁的頁級導覽——商品、項目、拍賣、套組、創作者、粉絲、IP、系列、設定九頁同款——取代原本橫排的 .tabs。與 tabs.css 的分工改為：詳情頁的分節切換歸 .section-nav；橫排 .tabs 留給清單頁工具列與節內篩選。五項以上橫排會擠成兩行或被截斷，直排天生可長。原本叫 .settings-nav、只長在設定頁，2026-08-17 活動詳情要用同一個東西時提升成中性名稱；舊 class 仍列在同一組選擇器裡，設定頁的 markup 不必改。

組裝規則：主要區域用側欄（本元件），區域底下的分節用 .list-toolbar ＋ .tabs--underline-short --underline-label --count-plain（與清單頁的類型切換同一組，殼不能省），內容區用 .nav-sections。橫列與內容之間、內容各區塊之間都是 --sp-18。

與詳情頂列的關係（2026-09-11，Q115）：有 .detail-topbar 的頁面，分節橫列不再自己 sticky——頂列黏住後把它收編：橫列捲到頂列底下時，.tabs 搬進頂列的 [data-dock-tabs]（起點對齊內容欄、左邊留給縮圖＋名稱）、動作群搬進 [data-dock-actions]（整頁動作右邊），原位留高不留內容；往回捲或切分頁還回去。黏住態的動作只留 icon（[data-dock-icon]），編輯中例外。邏輯在 js/detail-topbar.js，探索紀錄 lab-detail-dock.html。沒有頂列的頁（取貨場次詳情）維持原本的 sticky。

4.52a Stat row

🟡 molecule

The headline figures at the top of a card. Where .kpi is a "one figure, one card" unit that lives in a bento, .stat-row has no surface of its own — it is part of the card it sits in. Use it when a card already exists and needs its own numbers; putting .kpi there makes a card inside a card.

一張卡最上方的那一排主要數字。.kpi 是「一個數字一張卡」、住在 bento 裡的量體；.stat-row 沒有自己的表面，它是所在卡片的一部分。卡片已經存在、只是需要自己的數字時用它——放 .kpi 會變成卡中卡。

Density variant — --inline

密度變體 — --inline

The same row when the figures are the card's footnote rather than its subject (its first consumer is the creator card in Roster picker, 260px wide). Column name and value collapse onto one line and drop to label size — value 12, name 11 — so the whole set costs one line of height instead of two. It is still the same row, read the same way (name first, value after, tabular), so "a row of figures inside a card" keeps one answer site-wide. Columns come from grid-auto-flow: column with equal 1fr tracks, so two or three figures both divide evenly and the values sit on one vertical line card to card — a second digit never pushes the next column along. The name may ellipsise, the value never does: in a tight column the words give way, not the number. .stat__value--zero drops a 0 — and its column name with it — to --faint-ink, so the cards that still have work stand out on their own.

同一排數字，但用在「數字只是這張卡的註腳、卡真正在講的是別的」的情境（首個消費者是 Roster picker 的 creator 卡，260px 寬）。欄名與值收成同一行、字級小到只是一組標籤（值 12、欄名 11），整排因此只佔一行高度而不是兩行。它仍然是同一排、同一種讀法（欄名在前、值在後、等寬數字），所以站上「卡內數字排」這個角色仍只有一個答案。欄由 grid-auto-flow: column ＋ 等分 1fr 生成，兩欄三欄都自動等分，卡與卡的值落在同一條垂直線上——位數變多不會把後面那一欄往右推。欄名可截斷、值永不截斷：窄欄先犧牲的是字，不是數字。.stat__value--zero 把 0 連同它的欄名一起退到 --faint-ink，還有事要處理的卡自己浮出來。

4.52a-2 Todo list

🟡 molecule

An editable checklist inside a card. Where .data-list is a read-only list of facts the system decides, every row here is something the creator typed, ticked or deleted themselves. Test: is the text on this row user-written? Then it is a todo-list.

一張卡裡的待辦清單。.data-list 是唯讀的事實列（內容由系統決定）；這裡的每一列都是使用者自己加、自己改、自己劃掉的事。判斷句：這一列的文字是不是使用者打進去的？是就用 todo-list。

開演前檢核

4.52a-3 Next step

🟡 molecule

The last band of a card: what the creator should do next at this stage, with the action right there. Split from .info-banner (explanation, no action) and .insight-row (a computed one-liner, no action) — this is the only one that carries a button. Test: is there something to press after the sentence? Then it is a next-step.

一張卡的最後一段：告訴創作者「這個階段最該做的那一件事」，並就地給出那個動作。與 .info-banner（純說明、沒有動作）、.insight-row（算出來的一句話結論、沒有動作）的分工：只有這一支帶動作。判斷句：這段字後面有沒有一顆要按的按鈕？有就是 next-step。

🟡 molecule

Per-item levels — how much of each item is sold or used. Three columns on one line: name → bar → figures, so one row is one item's complete state. Pairs with stock-bar for the bar itself.

4.53 Store settings page

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

2026-08-13: the product-spec (F7) template editor now opens as a modal (.payout-modal + .payout-dialog--wide) instead of swapping the list out for an edit view in the same card — the list stays where it was, closing returns you to the row you came from; .ss-spec-editor__head/__foot and [data-spec-view] retired (tombstoned in CSS). Currency (F6) is read-only — native select gets disabled (the zselect trigger follows automatically) with one currency preset (D186). Partner discount codes are Phase 4 only — type switch, partner-only block, the partner demo row and the “Own” meta label carry data-feat="full", and the tab intro is a data-feat/data-feat-off pair (D185). Adding a code is one button (own vs partner is switched inside the modal), superseding the “two buttons at the bottom of the list” wording below. 2026-08-11 (D184): moved from a popup to its own page — the content outgrew the modal (the five groups differ 18× in size and two of them grew their own list↔edit views), it now drops the global app shell (no sidebar) but keeps the list-page header — .page-crumb + .page-intro (breadcrumb, large title, sub, actions on the right). It is a page, not a flow; the breadcrumb doubles as the way back to E-Shop. Layout: four horizontal tabs in the main column (Payment / Selling defaults [currency + shipping] / Product specs / Discount codes, wrapped in a .list-toolbar shell) plus a persistent .preview-col rail on the right holding the storefront, editable in place; actions moved to .page-intro__actions and the bottom .ss-actionbar retired. Going back to E-Shop restores the list state. E-Shop store-level settings as a popup (store-settings.html, spec 5.1.5.5 / D035 / D067) opened from E-Shop F3 as an embed-modal iframe — no global nav / breadcrumb / page header (the modal frame owns the title + close); actions sit in a bottom submit bar (.ss-actionbar). IA: a persistent Storefront card on top — a Base44 / Facebook-style identity band (cover + overlapping logo avatar + shop name / URL / bio shown as text) with per-field click-to-edit in place (.ss-edit: read text ↔ inline input/textarea/select, ✓/Enter commits, ✕/Esc cancels). Brand assets are the cover + avatar (edited via their own buttons) — no separate upload tiles. Then five peer setting groups (Product display / Payment / Shipping) as tabs (one at a time), plus a See as fan split preview. The whole page fills the standard 1280px .page column like other pages (it is not a two-column detail page, so it does not take .page--narrow). This component adds the field types base controls don't cover — URL affix (.ss-url), $ amount affix (.amount-field), read-only Stripe card (.ss-status) — the drag-to-reorder list (.ss-order, fan-side order · F3 / D031) and the fan preview body (.ss-fan).

2026-08-13 三項更新：（1）商品規格（F7）的範本編輯改成彈窗（.payout-modal ＋ .payout-dialog--wide）——原本清單↔編輯在同一張卡裡互換，捲到哪、現在在哪一層都得自己記；浮起來之後背景那份清單留在原位，關掉就回到剛才那一行。.ss-spec-editor__head／__foot／[data-spec-view] 退場（CSS 留墓碑）。（2）幣別（F6）鎖成唯讀：原生 select 加 disabled（zselect 觸發鈕自動跟著），預設帶一個幣別，「選擇幣別」空選項退場（D186）。（3）代理優惠碼整支只在 Phase 4：型別切換列、代理專屬區塊、清單的代理碼列與「自用」meta 標籤掛 data-feat="full"，分頁開場白做成 data-feat／data-feat-off 成對兩句（D185）。另外新增優惠碼只有一顆按鈕（自用與代理在彈窗裡切），下文「清單底部兩顆按鈕」的舊敘述以本段為準。2026-08-11（D184）由彈窗改成獨立頁面：內容量撐爆彈窗（五組設定量體差 18 倍、其中兩組各自長出「清單↔單筆編輯」兩層），改頁面後不掛全域 app shell（沒有側欄），但頁首用清單頁那一套 .page-crumb ＋ .page-intro（麵包屑＋大標題＋副標＋右側動作）——這是一個「頁」不是一個「流程」；麵包屑同時是回電子商店的路（2026-08-11 兩次修正後的定案）。版面＝主欄上方橫向分頁四組（收款／銷售預設〔幣別＋出貨〕／尺寸指南設定／優惠碼，裝在 .list-toolbar 殼裡）＋右側 .preview-col 常駐直軌放店面門面（就地換圖改字，兼作編輯處與當下長相）；動作移到 .page-intro__actions，底部 .ss-actionbar 退場；分區標題與副標移除（分頁已經寫了名字）。返回電子商店會還原清單狀態，這是彈窗時期「不離開管理脈絡」的替代承諾。以下描述其餘結構：電子商店「商店層級設定」popup（store-settings.html，spec 5.1.5.5 / D035 / D067），由 E-Shop F3 以 embed-modal iframe 開啟——無全域導航／麵包屑／頁首（標題與關閉由 modal 外框提供），動作置底部提交列（.ss-actionbar）。IA：店面門面卡常駐置頂——用 Base44／Facebook 式身分帶（封面＋疊加 logo 頭像＋店名／網址／簡介為文字），逐欄就地編輯（.ss-edit：文字態 ↔ 內嵌 input/textarea/select，✓/Enter 確認、✕/Esc 取消）。品牌素材就是封面＋頭像（各自有編輯鈕），不另設上傳框——其下付款／出貨／幣別／尺寸指南設定／優惠碼五個對等設定群組以 tab 切換（一次處理其一；2026-08-10 新增優惠碼，spec F8／D183：清單 ↔ 單組編輯兩層檢視。清單六欄，種類收進代碼欄第二行、「賣掉」欄寫筆數與金額；種類在「新增」當下決定〔兩顆按鈕〕，編輯頁只讀不切；編輯頁逐條 .settings-row，代理專屬的推廣者、分成與唯讀代理銷售紀錄整組顯隱），另有 粉絲視角預覽（See as fan）畫面分割。整頁用滿標準 1280px 的 .page 欄寬（非兩欄詳情頁，不套 .page--narrow）。本元件補基礎控制項沒有的欄位型別——網址前綴（.ss-url）、金額前綴（.amount-field）、唯讀 Stripe 卡（.ss-status）——拖曳排序清單（.ss-order，粉絲端順序 · F3 / D031）與粉絲預覽內容（.ss-fan）。

4.54b PDP preview (fan-side mirror)

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

The create form's right column says “how buyers see it on Ztor”. 2026-09-04 (user ruling, D248) that sentence has to be true: the preview is no longer a small card Studio drew for itself, it is the phone layout of the fan-side product page (ztor.vercel.app/shop-item.html) mirrored into the column, fed by whatever the creator has typed so far. The old Preview card stays for the other create flows.

建立流程右欄那句「買家在 Ztor 看到的樣子」——2026-09-04（使用者裁決 D248）要它真的成立：預覽不再是 Studio 自己畫的一張小卡，而是粉絲端商品頁（ztor.vercel.app/shop-item.html）手機版的版型鏡像，資料接建立流程當下的欄位。原本的 Preview card 留給其他建立流程用。

Three things here deliberately break Studio's own conventions, because that is what the fan side looks like: square size chips (that page's --radius-md is 0), a white-on-dark pill CTA (the product page is already full of brand orange, so an orange button would lose the hierarchy), and a quiet near-white price instead of an orange one. Those values live inside this component and must not leak out as Studio button/chip variants. Colours and spacing still go through r2.3 tokens, mapped role-for-role.

這裡有三個地方刻意違反 Studio 自己的慣例，因為粉絲端就是長這樣：尺寸 chip 是直角（那一頁的 --radius-md 為 0）、主要行動是白底深字的膠囊鈕（商品頁本身已經很多品牌橘，CTA 再用橘就沒有主次）、價格用近白而不是橘。這些值寫在本元件內，不得外流成 Studio 的按鈕或 chip 變體；顏色與間距仍走 r2.3 的 token，只是角色對應到粉絲端的用法。

不可互動。數量器與加入購物車都是 <span>——這是粉絲端的一張畫面，不是創作者要操作的控制項。還沒填的欄位退回 .is-empty 占位字；完全沒有資料的區塊（只有一張圖時的縮圖列、單一規格商品的選項）直接不出現。

ds-components/pdp-preview.css

4.55 Preview column

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

The "form | preview" two-column layout for create flows: a left form column and a right sticky preview column (title + grey sub + live preview content). Replaces the old slide-out Preview panel; the card inside reuses Preview card. Every box inside the column (Preview card, Listing settings card) drops its 1px border and takes the floating-card treatment instead, so the right column matches the left column's form-section --outlined (2026-07-21). Used by create-product, create-bundle, create-auction and create-campaign. 2026-08-10: .preview-split--narrow — the right column drops from 320px/40 gap to 264px/24, taking the numbers straight from .wizard-split--narrow (what Create event already uses) so the two create flows do not sit side by side with one wide rail and one narrow one. First consumer: create-product; the other consumers keep the default width.

建立流程的「表單｜預覽」兩欄版面：左表單、右一條 sticky 預覽欄（標題＋灰副標＋即時預覽）。取代舊滑出式 Preview panel；欄內的卡重用 Preview card。欄內所有盒子（預覽卡、上架設定卡）都去掉 1px 邊框、改用浮起卡的填色＋陰影＋上緣光，與左欄的 form-section --outlined 一致（2026-07-21）。create-product、create-bundle、create-auction、create-campaign 使用。2026-08-10 新增 .preview-split--narrow：右欄由 320px／間距 40 收成 264px／間距 24，數值取自建立活動在用的 .wizard-split--narrow——兩個建立流程並排看時右欄本來一寬一窄，收斂成同一組數字、不另立第三種。首個消費頁＝create-product，其餘消費頁維持預設寬度。

4.56 Preview panel

🟠 organism

Right-hand split panel holding the live preview card — not an overlay. Opened on demand by the create-flow top-bar Preview button: it takes layout on the right and compresses the wizard (body.preview-open), so the form stays visible and editable; no dim scrim. ✕ / Esc closes and restores. Shown here statically.

右側畫面分割面板，承載即時預覽卡——非浮層遮蓋。由建立流程頂部 Preview 鈕按需開啟：佔版面、把 wizard 壓窄（body.preview-open），表單仍可見可編輯，無變暗遮罩。✕／Esc 關閉復位。此處靜態展示。

Reused by E-Shop F5 “Store preview”: .preview-panel--inset compresses .main instead of the wizard. There it is toggleable, default-closed (opened from the F3 “Store preview” button; closed via a floating ✕ in the sheet’s top-right + Esc — spec F5 / D084) and runs headerless (no .preview-panel__head; the “商店預覽” label lives in the fan-store hero overline). On narrow screens (≤1100px) it falls back to a static block stacked below the list.

由 E-Shop F5「商店預覽」重用：.preview-panel--inset 壓窄的是 .main 而非 wizard。在該頁為可開關、預設關閉（由 F3「商店預覽」鈕開啟；關閉走 sheet 右上浮動 ✕＋Esc——spec F5／D084），且為 headerless（無 .preview-panel__head，「商店預覽」標題移進 fan-store hero overline）。窄螢幕（≤1100px）退化為靜態區塊堆疊在清單下方。

4.57 Fan store preview

🟠 organism

The fan-side creator page rendered inside every “See as fan” preview — shared by E-Shop F5 (Store preview), Store settings F1 and the detail-page preview panels (§6.7: one source, any difference is a defect). 2026-09-11 rebuilt as a mobile mirror of the real fan page (user supplied the live screenshot), the same move the product-page mirror made (§4.22g, D248): the layout and proportions are lifted from the fan app (375 viewport), the whole thing renders at zoom: 0.75 so the column is 270px, no phone bezel. Three things the user crossed out stay out: the app bar (menu / logo / search / cart / login), the bottom app tab bar, and the “demo scene” chip — those are the app shell, not this creator's page. The old bezel version with hero gradient, top fans, about and tab bar is retired.

每個「See as fan」預覽內呈現的粉絲端創作者頁，由 E-Shop F5（商店預覽）、商店設定 F1 與三個細節頁的預覽面板共用（§6.7 同源，差異即缺陷）。2026-09-11 依使用者提供的粉絲端實際畫面重做成手機版鏡像，做法與商品頁鏡像（§4.22g，D248）一樣：版型與比例照粉絲端（375 視窗）搬進來、整支 zoom: 0.75 顯示、欄寬 270px、不畫手機外框。使用者劃掉的三樣不進預覽：app bar（選單／logo／搜尋／購物車／登入）、底部 app 導航、「情境展示」浮標——那些是 app 外殼，不是這位創作者的頁面。舊版（手機外框＋hero 漸層＋頭號粉絲＋關於＋底部導航）整份退場。

Colors and spacing now use r2.3 tokens only — the old scoped --fst-* raw hex palette (25 raw values) is gone, so the fan-store raw-color exception in design-system.md §1.5 no longer applies. Role mapping to the fan app: --foreground≈text-primary, --muted-foreground≈text-secondary, --ztu-film≈white-alpha-4, --primary≈yellow-500. Data: the persona picks avatar, name, role, follower count and bio; product cards ask ProductsStore when the page has it (name, price in the list's currency format, image), else demo values. Card order is fixed (CARD_IDS) so E-Shop can hide unlisted / hidden items by position.

顏色與間距只用 r2.3 token——舊版 scoped 的 --fst-* 寫死色盤（25 處裸色）整組退場，design-system.md §1.5 那條 fan-store 裸色例外不再適用。角色對應到粉絲端：--foreground≈text-primary、--muted-foreground≈text-secondary、--ztu-film≈white-alpha-4、--primary≈yellow-500。資料：人格決定頭像、名字、身分、追蹤數與簡介；商品卡在頁面有載 ProductsStore 時問它（名稱、清單同一套幣別寫法的價格、圖），沒載用示範值。卡片順序固定（CARD_IDS），E-Shop 據此依上架／顯示狀態收起對應的卡。

Page tabs re-measured + sticky (2026-09-11, user: “the tab bar style differs from the original, and something pins to the top when you scroll”): .fan-store__nav now copies the fan app’s .glass-tabs — 48px pill, 4/10 padding, --ztu-film fill, --ztu-rim-soft rim, blur(8px) saturate(1.5); items 40px, 14px, no wrap (overflow scrolls, scrollbar hidden); active = --primary bold text over a faint orange top-edge gradient plus two orange inner highlights (the fan app’s --lg-fill-active / --lg-shine-active, expressed as color-mix on tokens). The nav lives in .fan-store__stick (position: sticky; top: 0); when partials/fan-store.js sees it hit the top of its scroll container it adds .is-pinned: a 24px avatar + bold 13px name row (.fan-store__minihead) grows in above the tabs and a ::before band (bleeds 12/16/24px, 70% --ztu-canvas → transparent, --ztu-blur-shell blur, bottom masked out) dims whatever scrolls underneath — the fan app’s .tabstick-host.is-pinned + .creator-minihead.

分頁列重量＋釘頂（2026-09-11，使用者：「指出的部分樣式和原本不同」「下滑的時候有東西置頂在上面」）：.fan-store__nav 改照粉絲端 .glass-tabs 量——48px 膠囊、padding 4/10、--ztu-film 底、--ztu-rim-soft 邊、blur(8px) saturate(1.5)；項目高 40、字 14、不換行（放不下橫捲、捲軸藏起）；選中＝--primary 粗體字＋只在頂端一線的淡橘漸層底＋左上／右下兩道橘色內光（粉絲端的 --lg-fill-active／--lg-shine-active，以 token 的 color-mix 表達）。分頁列住在 .fan-store__stick（position: sticky; top: 0）；partials/fan-store.js 看到它貼到捲動容器頂緣就加 .is-pinned：上方長出 24px 小頭像＋13px 粗體名字一行（.fan-store__minihead），底下一片 ::before 帶（出血 12/16/24、70% --ztu-canvas→透明、--ztu-blur-shell 模糊、下緣以 mask 淡出）把滑過的內容壓暗——即粉絲端的 .tabstick-host.is-pinned＋.creator-minihead。

Consumers (2026-09-11): E-Shop F5 (toggleable right column) and Store settings (right column, always on — the “See as fan” button and slide-out sheet were retired; user: “why does this look different from the E-Shop list page, and it duplicates the storefront card”). Both use the same card: preview-col--tall --dim + form-section--outlined + __head--rule, 320px column, mirror zoom 0.8.

消費頁（2026-09-11）：電子商店 F5（可開關的右欄）與商店設定（右欄常駐——「粉絲視角預覽」鈕與滑出側欄退場；使用者：「怎麼長得和電子商店的列表頁的不一樣，而且重複了」）。兩頁同一張卡：preview-col--tall --dim＋form-section--outlined＋__head--rule，欄 320、鏡像 zoom 0.8。

⚠ Follower count, social buttons (ztor / IG / Threads / X / TikTok), Join community, Unlock secrets, featured row, wishlist heart and the page tabs (Shop / Events / Ranks / Posts / Projects) are product-change proposals (ASSUMPTIONS UIA-026) — this preview only mirrors what the fan app already shows.

4.58 Dropdown menu

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

Native <details>/<summary> action menu: any .btn as trigger, a floating panel of action links below-right. No JS — open/close is the native details toggle. Use for "create / more actions" menus in toolbars; avoid for nav mega-dropdowns (use NavigationMenu) and for form value selection (use a select/Input).

原生 <details>/<summary> 動作選單：任一 .btn 當觸發器，下方靠右浮出動作連結面板。不需 JS — 開合走原生 details。用於工具列的「建立／更多動作」選單；導覽 mega-dropdown 別用（改用 NavigationMenu），表單選值也別用（改用 select／Input）。

Minimum tier that can buy買得到的最低分級

The third menu is the --ladder variant (E-Shop's Fan-tier threshold, 2026-07-31). Clicking a tier sets the threshold there: that tier and every tier above it become checked, so the checked set is always a run from the top — the left rail draws that run. The third row is pinned in the --preview state to show the hover forecast ("click here and this row joins too"). The trailing .dropdown__meta numbers are cumulative — "how many fans can buy if the threshold sits on this row" — so they read straight down as the cost of tightening the gate.

第三個選單是 --ladder 變體（電子商店的粉絲分級門檻，2026-07-31）。點某一級＝把門檻設在那一級，該級與其上各級一起成為已選態，所以已選的永遠是從頂端連續的一段——左緣那條線畫的就是那一段。第三列刻意固定在 --preview 狀態，示範 hover 預告（「點這裡的話這一列也會被納入」）。 尾端 .dropdown__meta 的數字是累計值——「門檻設在這一列，有多少人買得到」——所以往下讀就是把門檻收緊的代價。

Triggers: any .btn (primary ＋ New or a btn--icon kebab for per-row actions). Items can be <a> (navigate) or <button> (run JS — reset to look like a link); state-dependent items toggle with [hidden] (e.g. E-Shop row publish/unpublish). E-Shop product rows use the kebab variant; native <details> needs page JS for outside-click / select-to-close.

觸發器：任何 .btn（主要 ＋ New，或列操作用 btn--icon kebab）。選單項可用 <a>（導頁）或 <button>（跑 JS，已重置成連結外觀）；隨狀態切換的選單項用 [hidden] 互斥顯示（如電子商店列的上架/下架）。電子商店商品列用 kebab 變體；原生 <details> 的「點外部／選後收起」需頁面 JS 補。

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Use a real .btn variant as the summary trigger.
  • 用真正的 .btn 變體當 summary 觸發器。
  • Keep items short, action-first, max ~6 entries.
  • 項目精短、動詞開頭，最多約 6 條。
  • Lead every item with a matching .ztor-icon (2026-07-21 使用者裁示) — the only exception is .dropdown__item--toggle (a switch row, e.g. E-Shop's List-in-shop toggle).
  • 每個選項前面都要有對應的 .ztor-icon（2026-07-21 使用者裁示）——唯一例外是 .dropdown__item--toggle（開關列，如電子商店的「在商店上架」）。
Don't別做
  • Don't rebuild it per page with inline styles — link dropdown-menu.css.
  • 別在頁內用 inline style 重刻 — 連結 dropdown-menu.css。
  • Don't use it for navigation menus or form selects.
  • 別拿來做導覽選單或表單下拉選值。

.dropdown__item--choiceValue row (menuitemcheckbox), 2026-07-29 — not an action, a value. Same icon-exemption as --toggle: the leading slot holds the tier .badge (same badge vocabulary as tier-settings, no second palette). Selected state is the trailing .dropdown__check, never a background tint — a tinted row fights :hover and the user can't tell "I picked this" from "my mouse is here".值列（menuitemcheckbox），2026-07-29——不是動作，是一個值。與 --toggle 同樣豁免領頭 icon 規則：領頭位置放該分級的 .badge（與 tier-settings 同一套徽章語彙，不另立第二套配色）。已選態靠尾端的 .dropdown__check，不用底色——底色會跟 :hover 打架，使用者分不清「這是我選的」還是「我的滑鼠在這」。
.dropdown__menu--ladderRenders a group of --choice rows as one ladder (2026-07-31, E-Shop Fan tier). Adds a 2px --selected-ink rail down the left edge of every checked row, so the contiguous run reads as one range instead of four independent switches. Interaction (click sets the threshold) is page JS — the CSS only draws the run.把一組 --choice 值列呈現成「一道階梯」（2026-07-31，電子商店粉絲分級）。已選列左緣加一條 2px --selected-ink 直線，讓連續的一段讀起來是一個範圍，而不是四個獨立開關。互動（點一級＝設門檻）由頁面 JS 負責，CSS 只負責畫出那一段。
.dropdown__item--previewHover forecast inside --ladder: rows that would become checked show a 40%-opacity check. Makes the ladder relationship visible before the click, so nobody has to click wrong once to learn it.--ladder 內的 hover 預告：點下去會被納入的列先顯示 40% 透明度的 check。讓階梯關係在點擊前就看得見，不必先點錯一次才學會。
.dropdown__metaTrailing secondary value on a value row (E-Shop tier menu: "988 fans" = how many fans can buy if the threshold sits here). margin-left:auto pushes it right so the four numbers line up as a column you can compare down; tabular-nums keeps the digits from shifting. Muted color and one step smaller — it is a number that helps you decide, not the thing the row selects.值列尾端的次要資訊（電子商店分級選單的「988 人」＝門檻設在這一級有多少人買得到）。margin-left:auto 推到右側，四列數字對成一欄可以直接往下比；tabular-nums 讓位數不跳動。次要色、小一階字——它是幫忙做決定的參考值，不是這一列選的東西本身。
.dropdown__capMenu caption — one small uppercase line naming the question the value rows answer (e.g. "Minimum tier that can buy"). Not an item, not clickable, so it is not a .dropdown__item.選單抬頭——一行小字說明這組值列在回答什麼問題（如「買得到的最低分級」）。不是選項、不可點，所以不是 .dropdown__item。

4.60 View switch ✝ retired

⚰️ tombstone

Retired 2026-07-23. A pill-shaped two-icon toggle (solid foreground fill on the active side) that flipped Projects between list and card view. User feedback: it read as ugly and off-system — the solid fill was a third way of drawing "selected" on this site, fighting Segmented control's white-raised pill. Its role — switching the view of the same data — is what Segmented control already owns, so it was folded into that component's icon-only variant .segmented__btn--icon rather than kept as a second pattern. Rules removed from shared.css (tombstone comment left in place).

2026-07-23 退場。膠囊形雙圖示切換器（選中側實心填 foreground），原本用於 Projects 的清單／卡片切換。使用者反饋很醜、和 design system 不搭——實心填是站上第三種「已選中」畫法，與 Segmented control 的白浮起 pill 打架。它的角色（同一資料的視角切換）本來就屬於 Segmented control，因此收斂成該元件的純圖示變體 .segmented__btn--icon，不另留第二套。規則已自 shared.css 移除（原處留墓碑註解）。

🟠 organism

Purpose

Two-part payout flow: a page-side bank picker card grid (.payout-bank-*) on the Earnings · Payouts tab, plus the request-payout modal (.payout-modal backdrop + .payout-dialog shell with head / body / foot, amount input, summary and success view). Mounted from partials/payout-request-modal.js on earnings.html; the same dialog shell is reused by the F10 manual-entry modal (partials/manual-entry-modal.js).

Relationships

元件關係

atomButton Input Switch Badge Form grid
moleculeField system Control row Amount field

The dialog chrome here (.payout-dialog head / body / foot) is the project's canonical modal shell — reuse rules live in Pillar 5 · Modal shell. All four consumers (partials/payout-request-modal.js, partials/manual-entry-modal.js, partials/restock-modal.js, partials/pickup-session-modal.js) plus creators.html's inline create-creator form build fields from Field system / Form grid / Control row and the amount input from .amount-field--hero (2026-07-11) — the page-local .payout-field* / .payout-form-grid / .payout-inline-control / .payout-amount-* markup they used to hand-roll is gone everywhere; the classes have no remaining consumer and their rules were removed from payout-modal.css. The ticket edit dialog in create-event.html (Ticket tier card) also reuses this shell, and is the first consumer of the .payout-dialog__split layout below. Side width is --payout-split-side since 2026-08-10, defaulting to the original hard-coded 200px so that dialog is unchanged; create-event's Ticket setup sets 360px for its generated-ticket list, which cannot fit five fields in 200px — a variable rather than a second modifier, because the only difference is one number. .payout-dialog__split-side (2026-08-10, optional) makes the side column position: sticky with its own overflow-y: for dialogs where the left column is the settings and the right column is what those settings produce, a side column that scrolls away defeats the split. Its own max-height: 100% keeps a long result list scrolling inside the column instead of stretching the dialog; it reverts to static at ≤640px, where stacking already scrolls and sticking would cover what follows.

這裡的 dialog 殼（.payout-dialog 頭／身／腳）是本項目的 canonical modal 殼——共用規則見 Pillar 5 · Modal shell。全部四個 consumer（partials/payout-request-modal.js、partials/manual-entry-modal.js、partials/restock-modal.js、partials/pickup-session-modal.js）與 creators.html 內建的建立 creator 表單，欄位皆改用 Field system／Form grid／Control row，金額輸入改用 .amount-field--hero（2026-07-11）——這些檔案原本自刻的 .payout-field*／.payout-form-grid／.payout-inline-control／.payout-amount-* markup 已全數移除；這些 class 已無任何 consumer，規則也已從 payout-modal.css 移除。create-event.html 的票種編輯彈窗（Ticket tier card）也重用這個殼，是下方 .payout-dialog__split 版面的首個消費者。側欄寬度自 2026-08-10 起改吃 --payout-split-side，預設仍是原本寫死的 200px，所以那個彈窗行為不變；建立活動的「票務設定」把它設成 360px 裝生成的門票清單——一列五個欄位，200px 塞不下。用變數而不是再開一個修飾類，因為兩者的差別只有一個數字。.payout-dialog__split-side（2026-08-10 新增，選配）讓側欄 position: sticky 黏在頂端、自己 overflow-y 內捲：用在「左欄是設定、右欄是那些設定產生的結果」的彈窗，側欄跟著捲走就等於看不到結果，分欄也就白分了。側欄自己的 max-height: 100% 讓結果多時它內捲、而不是把整個彈窗撐長；≤640px 收單欄時自動退回 static（上下堆疊本來就跟著捲，黏著只會擋住下面的內容）。

Head sub-title and footer slots (2026-09-22, D311): .payout-dialog__head-titles + .payout-dialog__sub let the head carry a second line — the title says which thing the dialog is open on, the sub-title gives its context (the single-ticket dialog: ticket name above, date · venue below; with several dates, the ticket name alone does not say which one). In the footer, .payout-dialog__foot-note is the left slot for whatever is blocking Save ("N fields need fixing") and .payout-dialog__foot-actions is the right slot for the buttons: the foot is space-between, so two bare buttons get pushed to opposite edges, and the reason belongs on the same line of sight as the primary action. Dialogs with no sub-title and no blocking reason stay exactly as they were.

標題列副標與 footer 兩個槽（2026-09-22，D311）：.payout-dialog__head-titles ＋ .payout-dialog__sub 讓標題列多一行——標題回答「開在哪一件東西上」，副標補它的脈絡（單張門票彈窗：上面票名、下面場次日期・場地；多場次活動只看票名分不出是哪一場）。footer 的 .payout-dialog__foot-note 是左槽，放擋下儲存的理由（「N 個欄位待修正」）；.payout-dialog__foot-actions 是右槽，放按鈕群——foot 本來就是 space-between，只放兩顆裸按鈕會被推到兩端，而理由該跟主鈕站在同一條視線上。沒有副標、沒有擋關理由的彈窗維持原樣。

4.62 Restock table

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

Restock popup for the E-Shop restock sub-flow (spec §5.1.5.6, D104 order model + D106 member tabs). A restock is one order: the popup reuses the canonical payout dialog shell (.payout-modal / .payout-dialog) with a document layer — method as .segmented.radio-cards (two side-by-side cards + top-right orange dot, Restock now / Scheduled) plus supplier / notes and, for Scheduled, an expected-arrival date — and an item layer that is a .restock-table of three number columns per row: Current (read-only), Restock (typeable), After (read-only, live current + restock). 2026-07-22 layout (Figma node 861-28842): the item table sits right below the method (product-name label then table); supplier / notes / ETA move below the table; the footer (Cancel / Submit) is pinned to the dialog bottom — only the body scrolls (same pattern as the platform-fee modal); the old under-method hint row and the yellow stickynote have been removed. A product's variants are a matrix of rows (single-variant = 1 row; 2-option = sub-grouped by option-1 via .restock-table__group) — no tabs. A bundle separates its member products with .tabs (one tab per member); each tab panel (.tab-panel) holds that member's variant table. Only one tab level (members) — variants never use tabs; quantities persist across tabs. History log on product-detail reuses .data-list. Mounted from partials/restock-modal.js.

E-Shop 補貨子流程 popup（spec §5.1.5.6，D104 補貨單＋D106 成員 tab）。一次補貨＝一張補貨單：popup 重用 canonical payout dialog 外殼（.payout-modal／.payout-dialog），單據層＝補貨方式改用 .segmented.radio-cards（兩張並排卡＋右上橘點，立即／定時）＋供應商／備註，定時另加預計到貨時間，整張填一次；品項層＝.restock-table 三欄數字表，每列：當前數量（唯讀）、補貨數量（可填）、補後數量（唯讀，即時＝當前＋補貨）。2026-07-22 版型（Figma node 861-28842）：逐選項表移到方式正下方（先商品名稱標題再表格）；供應商／備註／預計到貨改到表格下方；footer（取消／送出補貨）釘在框底、只捲 body（與平台費率彈窗同一套）；方式下方的灰色提示行與底部黃色 stickynote 已移除。商品的規格是矩陣列（單一選項＝1 列；2 選項以選項一分組 .restock-table__group）——不用 tab。組合則以 .tabs 把成員商品分開（一成員一 tab），每個 tab 面板（.tab-panel）放該成員的規格表。只有一層 tab（成員），規格不用 tab；數量跨 tab 保留。商品細節頁補貨紀錄重用 .data-list。由 partials/restock-modal.js 掛載。

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Keep the 2026-07-22 order: method (radio-cards) → product-name label → .restock-table → supplier / notes / ETA below; pin the footer to the dialog bottom, scroll only the body.
  • 照 2026-07-22 順序：方式（radio-cards）→ 商品名稱標題 → .restock-table → 供應商／備註／到貨在下方；footer 釘框底、只捲 body。
  • Keep Current and After read-only (.restock-table__ro); only Restock is typeable — stock rises only through a logged restock.
  • 當前與補後維持唯讀（.restock-table__ro），只有補貨可填——庫存只透過有紀錄的補貨上升。
  • Group a multi-variant product or bundle member with .restock-table__group; bundle members = .tabs (one tab per member product, D106).
  • 多選項商品或組合成員以 .restock-table__group 分組；組合成員＝.tabs（一成員一 tab，D106）。
Don't別做
  • Don't fork the dialog / form / segmented / tabs / data-list styles — only the .restock-table rows are restock-specific.
  • 別 fork dialog／表單／segmented／tabs／data-list 樣式 — 只有 .restock-table 列是 restock 專屬。
  • Don't put method / supplier / ETA on each row, and don't bring back the under-method hint row or the yellow stickynote — the 2026-07-22 layout removed them.
  • 別把方式／供應商／到貨放進每列，也別找回方式下的提示行或黃色 stickynote——2026-07-22 版型已移除。
  • Don't tab variants or nest tabs — only member products get tabs; variants stay a table (avoids two-level tabs).
  • 別把規格做成 tab、別巢狀 tab — 只有成員商品用 tab，規格維持表格（避免兩層 tab）。

4.68 Alert

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

Inline notice with a status-tinted icon, title, description, optional CTA, and (card density) a chevron close button. Use .alert--card in the dashboard alerts panel; .alert--row for inline page warnings (low-stock, region). Avoid for a single editorial hint — use the Info banner.

Page-top variant (.alert-inset ＋ .alert--inset-card — the shell below stands in for .main; sticky positioning omitted in this demo). When it is sticky (2026-08-01), ::before lays a --surface-page scrim behind the card — 200px above so nothing peeks through the 16px gap, and --alert-inset-fade (44px) below so content fades out under the notice instead of being cut by a hard edge. z-index is 10, above ordinary content and .list-toolbar (6), below a stuck .list-dock (20), popovers (30) and the topbar (50). When a page wants a stuck toolbar, use the shared snap dock (.list-dock + js/sticky-dock.js) rather than hand-rolling it — while it is snapped, .main:has(.list-dock.is-snapped) .alert-inset drops the sticky so the notice scrolls away.

頁面貼頂變體 (.alert-inset ＋ .alert--inset-card — 下方外框代表 .main；demo 中不套 sticky）。真的黏頂時（2026-08-01）由 ::before 墊一層 --surface-page 同色底：上緣多蓋 200px，讓上方那道 16px 空隙不漏內容；下緣延伸 --alert-inset-fade（44px）做漸層，內容在通知下方漸消而不是被硬邊切斷。z-index 為 10——高過一般內容與 .list-toolbar（6），低於黏頂的 .list-dock（20）、浮層（30）與 topbar（50）。頁面若讓工作列貼頂，一律走共用的 snap dock（.list-dock ＋ js/sticky-dock.js），不要手刻——貼頂時 .main:has(.list-dock.is-snapped) .alert-inset 會解除 sticky，通知條隨頁面捲走。

4.70 Status axes

🟡 molecule

Two independent order status tracks shown together (spec 5.1.5.3.1 §2.2 / PCR-001): fulfilment (履約: To ship / Awaiting pickup / Shipped / Completed) and payment·settlement (收入結算: Paid / Disputed / Cancelled). The two axes are never combined into a single badge. .status-axes = badges side by side (list rows, fulfilment first); .status-axes--split gives each axis its own group, divided by a hairline rule (order detail header). 2026-08-07: the older .status-axes--labeled variant (an uppercase label above each axis) was retired — the rule already delivers what PCR-001 asks for, and the badge wording (Shipped / Awaiting pickup vs Paid) already says which axis it belongs to, so the labels said the same thing twice. Badges come from badge.css — Paid uses badge--success (green, Q11 2026-07-13; was badge--neutral). 2026-09-09 (D253): the payment·settlement axis dropped Refunded — the platform doesn't refund in-app, so a fully-voided order shows Cancelled there instead (fulfilment axis goes blank, since nothing ships anymore); see order-detail.html's renderStatus().

訂單兩條獨立狀態軸並列（規格 5.1.5.3.1 §2.2 / PCR-001）：履約（待出貨／待取貨／已出貨／已完成）與收入結算（Paid／Disputed／Cancelled），不併成單一 badge。.status-axes＝badge 並排（清單列，履約在前）；.status-axes--split 每軸自成一組、中間以細分隔線區隔（訂單詳情頁首）。2026-08-07：原本每軸上方掛大寫標籤的 .status-axes--labeled 變體退場——分隔線已經達成 PCR-001 要的「兩軸不混成一顆徽章」，而徽章文字（已出貨／待取貨 vs 已付款）本身就說明它屬於哪一軸，標籤是把同一件事講兩次。badge 取自 badge.css——Paid 用 badge--success（綠色，Q11 2026-07-13；原為 badge--neutral）。2026-09-09（D253）：付款・結算軸拿掉已退款——平台不提供站內退款，全數品項作廢的訂單改在這軸顯示已取消（履約軸則因不會再出貨而留空），見 order-detail.html 的 renderStatus()。

4.71 Chart

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

SVG-based visualization family with five sub-patterns (line chart, bar chart, stacked bar, source-list legend, rank bars) plus a .chart-card composition shell and a JS-driven tooltip/cursor layer. Use .linechart for trends, .barchart for discrete values, .stacked-bar + .source-list for a proportion breakdown, .rank-bars for ranked rows, and .chart-card to wrap with head + footer; avoid for exact tabular figures — use .ztor-table.

以 SVG 為基礎的視覺化家族，含五種 sub-pattern（line chart、bar chart、stacked bar、source-list legend、rank bars），外加一個 .chart-card 組合外殼與 JS 驅動的 tooltip／cursor 層。趨勢用 .linechart，離散值用 .barchart，比例拆解用 .stacked-bar + .source-list，排名列用 .rank-bars，要包 head + footer 用 .chart-card；要精確的表格數字別用 — 改用 .ztor-table。

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Give .pie aria-hidden="true" — the legend beside it carries every number.
  • 給 .pie 加 aria-hidden="true"——數字全在旁邊的圖例上。
  • Write --pie-stops segment bounds as cumulative percentages, each starting at 0.
  • --pie-stops 的段界寫累計百分比，每段起點一律寫 0。
  • Set stacked-bar segment widths + palette inline.
  • stacked-bar 的 segment 寬度 + 配色用 inline 設定。
  • Scale .rank-bar__fill so the largest value reads 100%.
  • 縮放 .rank-bar__fill，讓最大值讀作 100%。
  • Override --donut-hole when the donut sits on a surface other than --card.
  • 圓環放在非 --card 底色上時，一併覆寫 --donut-hole。
Don't別做
  • Apply .linechart__area to multi-series charts.
  • 把 .linechart__area 套到多 series 的圖上。
  • Rely on hover tooltip/cursor for essential values (JS-driven, pointer-only).
  • 關鍵數值靠 hover 的 tooltip／cursor（JS 驅動、僅限 pointer）。
  • Force 3+ segments into .donut — use .pie, .stacked-bar or .rank-bar instead.
  • 把三段以上的比例硬塞進 .donut——改用 .pie、.stacked-bar 或 .rank-bar。
  • Reach for .pie to rank things — a pie answers "how was this whole split", a bar answers "which is bigger".
  • 用 .pie 比大小——圓餅回答「這一整塊是怎麼被分掉的」，長條才回答「誰比誰長」。

4.72 Earnings waterfall

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

A statement-style vertical ledger (spec §5.1.8 F12) that walks gross revenue down to distributable profit and its Creator / NFT split. Reads like a P&L — milestones (income / subtotal / pool / distribution) carry a running-balance bar; deductions are plain indented name … −amount rows with no bar, so it doesn't become a wall of bars. Figures follow §7.3 (only settled income counts). Used on the Earnings · Breakdown tab and reused for the F11 per-project ladder and the F7 transaction mini-ladder.

報表式垂直帳本（spec §5.1.8 F12），把總收入一路走到可分配淨利與 Creator／NFT 分配。讀起來像損益表——里程碑（income／subtotal／pool／distribution）帶 running-balance 條；扣項是純文字縮排 名稱 … −金額 列、不帶條，避免變成一面 bar 牆。數字口徑依 §7.3（僅計已結算收入）。用於 Earnings · Breakdown 分頁，並重用於 F11 單一項目階梯與 F7 交易小階梯。

Do該做

Don't別做
  • Don't render $0 rows to fake a full waterfall — use .waterfall__empty when there is no settled income.

  • Don't put unsettled / disputed amounts into distributable profit.
  • 別把未結算／爭議中金額算進可分配淨利。

4.77 Leave dialog

🟠 organism

Confirm-before-leaving dialog for every create / edit flow. Injected and driven by partials/wizard-chrome.js, shared by all 6 create pages. Two states, one shell: when the page has unsaved edits it asks about saving (Save and leave / Leave without saving); when nothing was edited it just confirms leaving (Leave) — no save question. Pages with no save affordance in the top bar can opt out of the save question entirely via .wizard[data-leave-simple] and always show the plain-leave state. Capped card, dimmed scrim, title + body + stacked actions + corner close. 2026-09-11: e-shop.html reuses this shell for the “Show in shop” confirmation (title switches per on/off state, D263) — it is the site’s only confirm-dialog idiom. 2026-09-18: a .leave-dialog__list element (one row per affected item, hairline dividers) sits between body and actions; the draft-delete confirm uses the same shell with a .btn--destructive primary. 2026-09-18 (D288): the list now serves two cases — unlisting a product that is still inside listed bundles (lists the bundles, primary “Unlist these bundles too”; moved here from the archive step, which is now a plain confirm) and relisting a bundle (D289): unlisted members are listed as “these go back on sale with it” with a primary “Relist all” (confirm — they relist together); archived members block instead, listed with a single “Got it” and the cancel button hidden — it informs, it does not ask. 2026-09-22 (D298): the blocked copy now says “Unarchive these items first, then list the bundle” — an archived item's only exit is Unarchive (back to Unlisted, no confirm, nothing else changes), and the bundle relist gate is only reached from the Listed switch on an unlisted bundle. Unlisting itself always confirms first, for all three sales channels.

建立／編輯流程的「返回離開確認」彈窗。由 partials/wizard-chrome.js 注入並控制，6 個建立頁共用。兩個型態、同一外殼：頁面有未存編輯時問儲存（儲存並離開／不儲存就離開）；沒編輯過則只確認離開（離開）、不問儲存。頂列沒有儲存入口的頁面可加 .wizard[data-leave-simple] 完全跳過問儲存那一態，一律走純離開版。有上限的卡、變暗 scrim、標題＋內文＋堆疊操作＋右上關閉。 2026-09-11：e-shop.html 的「顯示於商店」確認彈窗直接用這個殼（標題依開／關換句，D263）——它是站上唯一的確認彈窗語彙，不另造。2026-09-18：內文與操作之間可插一段 .leave-dialog__list（一列一項、細分隔線）；草稿刪除確認用同一個殼、主鈕換 .btn--destructive。2026-09-18（D288）：清單改服務兩種情境——單售下架時仍在上架中的組合包裡（列組合包、主鈕「一同下架這些組合包」；從封存搬過來，封存改回單純確認）、組合包重新上架（D289）：有已下架成員時列出「會一起重新上架的成員」、主鈕「一併重新上架」（確認＝成員連帶重新上架）；有已封存成員時改為擋下（列成員、只有一顆「知道了」、取消鈕收起——它是告知不是詢問）。2026-09-22（D298）：擋下的內文改成「先解除封存這些成員，再上架組合包」——已封存的出口只有「解除封存」（回到已下架、不確認、其他不動），組合包的重新上架閘門只從已下架組合包的上架開關進來。下架本身也一律先確認，三種販售管道一致。

要先儲存再離開嗎？

這一頁有你做的編輯。

4.79 Album tracks

🟠 organism

Multi-track manager for digital products whose sub-category is Album (spec 5.1.5.2 §4.2 F11.1). Empty state shows a "No files uploaded yet" placeholder. Upload multiple audio (mp3) / video (mp4) files; each becomes a track row with a cover, editable name, file meta (name · size · time), drag-to-reorder handle, and a ⋮ menu (Edit name · Change image · Upload lyrics · Delete). Hovering the cover reveals play/pause + edit (change image). Uploading rows show "…is uploading…" with an indeterminate bar and no drag handle. Lyrics are audio-only — after Upload lyrics a "View Lyrics" button appears; video tracks have no lyrics. Reuses the .dropdown menu component. Click to try below.

數位商品次分類為音樂專輯（Album）時的多曲目管理器（spec 5.1.5.2 §4.2 F11.1）。空狀態顯示「尚未上傳任何檔案」佔位訊息。上傳多個音訊（mp3）／影片（mp4）檔，每檔一列曲目：封面、可改曲名、檔案 meta（檔名·大小·時間）、拖曳把手、⋯ 選單（改名·換封面·上傳歌詞·刪除）。hover 封面浮現 播放/暫停＋編輯（換封面）。上傳中列顯示「上傳中…」＋不定進度條、無拖曳把手。歌詞為音訊限定——上傳歌詞後出現「查看歌詞」；影片曲目無歌詞。重用 .dropdown 選單元件。可在下方點擊試用。

Note: presentation-layer demo — upload / lyrics / cover are faked (files shown via object URL, no real upload or storage). Track-field product details (min 1 track, cover required, lyrics format, size limits, preview) are TBC upstream (recorded in ASSUMPTIONS).

4.82 Pickup management

🟠 organism

On-site QR redemption workspace (spec 5.1.5.11 · D111). E-Shop sibling of Orders. 2026-08-01: the session-detail first screen now borrows the product-detail skeleton wholesale — .form-section--outlined card, .form-grid two columns, .form-section__head/__title headings, .bento + .kpi--compact for the big number, .kv for the summary. .pickup-board only adds the column divider and the responsive stack; left column is what is being collected, right column is what staff need to scan (.scanner-hand URL + password). The roster is .product-list--roster, one column per spec field. 2026-09-03 (D240): one row per pickup unit (one item = one code) — the Qty column retires, Pickup code and From bundle join, and buyers holding several units collapse into an expandable group row. Since 2026-09-03 (Q107) that grouping is Row disclosure (§4.204) laid over the roster rows — .rowdis__group wraps the parent row and its children (no --gutter, table-shaped), .rowdis__head / .rowdis__child with js/row-disclosure.js; the old .product-list__row--group / --child it first used has retired. The full Scanner access settings card and .pickup-select rows are kept below for the standalone scanner page and the create-session popup (F3).

現場 QR 核銷工作區（規格 5.1.5.11 · D111），E-Shop 下與訂單管理並列。2026-08-01：場次詳情第一屏整套沿用 product-detail 的骨架——.form-section--outlined 分區卡、.form-grid 兩欄、.form-section__head／__title 區段標題、.bento＋.kpi--compact 大數字、.kv 鍵值摘要；.pickup-board 只補兩欄之間的分隔線與響應式堆疊。左欄＝領取的活動與物品，右欄＝工作人員操作取貨要知道的（.scanner-hand 掃碼網址與密碼），上方疊一段隨場次狀態換的核銷數字。名單用 .product-list--roster，規格的每個欄位各自成欄。2026-09-03（D240）：改成**一列＝一個領取單位**（一件商品一個領取碼）——「數量」欄退場，新增「領取碼」與「來源組合」，買多件的買家收成一列可展開的群組列。2026-09-03（Q107）起這個分組吃 Row disclosure（§4.204）——.rowdis__group 包住母列與它的子項（不加 --gutter，表格型），名單列上疊 .rowdis__head／.rowdis__child，互動走 js/row-disclosure.js；它最初沿用的 .product-list__row--group／--child 已退場。完整的「Scanner 存取」設定卡與 .pickup-select 多選列保留在下方，供獨立 scanner 頁與建立場次 popup（F3）使用。

4.83 Mobile scanner

🟠 organism

2026-09-08 camera photo + roster legibility: the camera pane now carries a static stand-in photo behind the reticle (.scanner-cam__feed — image plus a --surface-inverse color-mix scrim; a live stream replaces that one layer in production), so the pane reads as a camera looking at something. 2026-09-08 相機示意照片＋名單可讀性：相機分頁在對準框背後鋪一張靜態示意照片（.scanner-cam__feed＝照片＋一層 --surface-inverse color-mix 暗紗；正式版換掉這一層就是真的相機串流），對準框才有東西可以對。照片恆為暗色，區內文字改吃 --foreground-on-inverse 那一組。名單群組列：通用人形圖示換成共用的 .ztor-avatar--sm 姓名首字（票券群組維持票券晶片、同為 32px），右欄主行改成還剩幾件、已領 M／N 退成註腳，子列在 .rowdis__lead 放組內序號（同 pickup-detail 的 Q109 做法），已核銷的子列降一階，整組領完則整塊降一階。

2026-09-03 one code, one item (D240): redemption now works on a pickup unit — one code redeems exactly one item. The result sheet shows only the unit just scanned (buyer, source order or ticket, item, option, source bundle) and a single confirm action; confirming returns to the camera and a persistent progress band (.scanner-progress) says how far that buyer has got in this session (redeemed / total, how many are left). The roster groups units under each buyer (parent row = buyer + M / N, child rows = one unit each), and the counts strip and item stats are summed from pickup units. The old multi-claim list (.scanner-claims) is retired.

2026-09-03 一物一碼（D240）：核銷單位改成「領取單位」——一個領取碼核銷一件。結果 bottom sheet 只顯示剛掃到的這一件（買家、來源訂單或票號、商品名、選項、來源組合）與一顆確認鈕；確認後回到相機連續掃描，並由常駐的進度 band（.scanner-progress）顯示這位買家在本場次已領幾件、還剩幾件。名單分頁改成按買家分組（父列＝買家＋已領 M／N，子列＝一個領取單位），頂部計數與項目統計都由領取單位加總。舊的多件清單（.scanner-claims）已退場。

Standalone phone scanner (spec 5.1.5.14 · D111/D121/D122/D240) — a separate URL with no Studio nav. 2026-08-19 flow redesign: the password gate shows the session identity (name / place / time / state) before unlocking, plus an optional staff name recorded on every redemption; after unlock the camera is the home screen with a live pending/redeemed counts strip on top and a Scan / Roster / Items bottom tab bar. Scan results come up as a bottom sheet inside the frame (success · duplicate · not-in-session · cancelled), so confirming returns straight to the camera — a continuous-scan rhythm for queues. Blocked (not started / ended), offline-hold and 5-attempt lockout states are first-class screens. The camera area keeps the frame's own surface — in production a live camera image fills it, so the prototype only draws the aiming furniture (four --primary corner brackets + sweep line) and floats manual entry over it; sheet scrim = --overlay-tint. Roster rows are tappable: they pre-fill manual entry with that buyer's code (identity check stays read-only, redeeming still goes through F1.1 manual input).

獨立手機 scanner（規格 5.1.5.14 · D111/D121/D122）——獨立 URL、無主工作台導航。2026-08-19 流程重規劃：密碼閘門在解鎖前就先亮場次身分（ztor 標記＋名稱／地點／時間／狀態），並提供選填的工作人員標示（記進每筆核銷紀錄）；解鎖後頂列只剩「正在掃哪一場」，相機即主畫面，其上常駐待核銷／已核銷即時計數，底部 掃描／名單／項目 三分頁。掃描結果改為框內 bottom sheet（成功·重複·不屬此場次·已取消），確認後直接回到相機——支撐現場排隊的連續掃描節奏。場次未開始／已結束、離線保留、密碼五次鎖定都是一等公民畫面。相機區維持手機框自身的底色（正式產品由實際相機畫面填滿），原型只畫對準用的四角括號（--primary）與掃描線，手動輸入鈕浮在其上；sheet 遮罩＝--overlay-tint。名單列可點：把該買家代碼帶入手動輸入（身分核對維持唯讀，核銷仍走 F1.1 手動輸入）。

4.84 Radio list

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

Lightweight vertical 1-of-N picker: a radio dot + title (optional one-line sub) per row; a filled orange dot marks the selection. Lighter than Selection card (no card frame/shadow) and, unlike Segmented, it is a data choice rather than a view switch. Two variants: base keeps every option visible; --collapsible (2026-07-21, Figma 856-22782) shows only the current selection plus a chevron and reveals the full list on click — use it when the picker sits in a narrow column and vertical space is scarce, e.g. the listing row of a create flow (Don't list / List now / Schedule) under the store-preview card. Since D241 (2026-09-04) that row is one of three inside Listing controls, and only the create flows use this picker for it — detail pages switched to a Switch, because by then the item already exists and all that is left is on or off. The other two rows (show in shop, sale) never used it. In the collapsible variant the selected option appears twice while open (once in the trigger, once in the list) — that is the intended Figma behaviour. Independent component (own classes + JS), not built on Segmented. New consumption context (2026-08-09): the base variant now also covers single-select options inside a form — create-event's ticket-tier rules block (purchase condition / per-person limit / discount) uses .radio-list for its radio choice, replacing a short-lived page-local drawn-radio (see the retired .zradio).

輕量垂直單選：每列一個 radio 圓點＋標題（可帶一句描述），圓點填橘＝選中。比 Selection card 輕（無卡框陰影）；與 Segmented 的分工是它做資料選擇、不是視角切換。兩個變體：base 選項恆展開；--collapsible（2026-07-21，Figma 856-22782）收起時只顯示目前選項＋chevron，點一下才展開完整清單，用於窄欄、垂直空間吃緊的情境——例如商店預覽卡下、建立流程的上架列（不上架／立刻上架／定時上架）。D241（2026-09-04）起那一列是 Listing controls 三列中的一列，而且只有建立頁用這支選擇器；細節頁改用 Switch——那時東西已經存在，只剩開著還是關著。另外兩列（顯示於商店、開賣）從來沒用過它。收合式展開時已選項會出現兩次（觸發列一次、清單一次），這是 Figma 原設計、刻意保留。獨立元件（自有 class＋JS），非建在 Segmented 上。新消費情境（2026-08-09）：base 變體現在也承接表單裡的規則選項——建立活動的票種卡購票規則區塊（購票條件／每人限購／折扣）改用 .radio-list 做單選，取代短命存在過的頁內自繪 radio（見已退場的 .zradio）。

Rendered preview

視覺展示

Base — every option visibleBase — 選項恆展開

--collapsible — click the trigger to open--collapsible — 點觸發列展開

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Use for mutually-exclusive data choices; pick --collapsible when vertical space is scarce.
  • 用於互斥的資料選擇；垂直空間吃緊時選 --collapsible。
  • Sit it on a white / --card surface (hover uses --accent).
  • 放在白／--card 底上（hover 用 --accent）。
Don't別做
  • Use it to switch the view of one dataset — that's Segmented.
  • 別用在切換同一資料的視角（那是 Segmented）。
  • Mix both variants for the same role on different pages — every create flow's listing row is collapsible. (A detail page using a switch instead is a different control for a different question, not a second variant of this one.)
  • 別讓同一角色在不同頁用不同變體——建立流程的上架列一律收合式。（細節頁改用開關是換一個控制回答另一個問題，不是本元件的第二種變體。）

Specification

規格

Sourceradio-list.css · partials/radio-list.js (collapsible behaviour)
AnatomyBase: .radio-list > .radio-list__item (--active) > .radio-list__dot + .radio-list__text (__title + optional __sub).
Collapsible: .radio-list.radio-list--collapsible[data-open] > .radio-list__trigger (dot + text + .radio-list__chevron) + .radio-list__options[hidden] > .radio-list__item.
Variants(base) every option visible · --collapsible trigger + disclosure list, 1px --border frame at --radius-xl, open trigger fills --input-surface, chevron rotates 180°; the open list hides the currently selected row (2026-09-11 — the trigger already represents it; CSS-only, JS state unchanged).
Statesdefault · hover (--accent) · focus-visible (--ring) · selected (--active, orange filled dot) · open / closed ([data-open], collapsible only).
Behavior / usageVertical flex; transparent rows, hover --accent; selected = orange filled dot (--primary), no bg/border change. Rows with no .radio-list__sub vertically center dot + title. partials/radio-list.js auto-mounts every .radio-list--collapsible: toggles open state, mirrors the selected row's text + data-i18n keys into the trigger, closes on outside click / Esc, and dispatches radio-list:change (detail.item) so pages only own their own field-reveal logic.
Token usage--foreground, --accent, --muted-foreground, --primary, --border, --input-surface, --ring, --radius-md, --radius-xl, --sp-2/8/10, --fs-14/12, --duration, --easing.
Classes.radio-list · .radio-list--collapsible · .radio-list__trigger · .radio-list__chevron · .radio-list__options · .radio-list__item · .radio-list__item--active · .radio-list__dot · .radio-list__text · .radio-list__title · .radio-list__sub
DependenciesComposes Icon (chevron-down) in the collapsible trigger.
Evidence / usageCreate flows use --collapsible for the listing row (2026-07-21): create-product · create-bundle · create-auction (under the preview card). D241 (2026-09-04): product-detail and bundle-detail move that row to a Switch inside Listing controls, so they leave this list once migrated. 2026-08-09: create-event.html uses the base variant for the ticket-tier rules block's radio choice (purchase condition / per-person limit / discount) — spacing rules live in ticket-tier-card.css (.rule > .radio-list).

4.85 Date input placeholder

🔵 atom

Purpose

用途

Native <input type="date|datetime-local|time"> ignores placeholder and paints its own 年/月/日 --:-- mask in ordinary body colour, so an untouched field reads as already filled. This decorator replaces the empty state with the same placeholder language every other field uses: calendar icon + muted "Pick a date". Filled state is untouched — the date renders in normal body colour at the field's original padding, so no layout shifts. Applied automatically site-wide by partials/date-input.js; pages keep plain <input class="input" type="date"> markup.

原生 <input type="date|datetime-local|time"> 不吃 placeholder，空值時瀏覽器自己畫「年/月/日 --:--」且用一般內文色，看起來像已經填了值。本裝飾層把空值狀態換成站上其他欄位一致的 placeholder 語言：日曆 icon ＋ 淡灰「選擇日期」。已填狀態完全不動——日期用正常內文色、內距回到欄位原值，不造成任何位移。由 partials/date-input.js 全站自動套用，頁面 markup 維持乾淨的 <input class="input" type="date">。

Rendered preview

視覺展示

Empty — icon + placeholder空值 — icon ＋ placeholder

Filled — plain body colour, original padding已填 — 正常內文色、原始內距

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Leave page markup as a bare .input — the decorator wraps it at runtime.
  • 頁面 markup 就寫乾淨的 .input，包裝交給執行期的裝飾層。
  • Call ZtorDateInput.mount(scope) only if you bypass the DOM observer.
  • 只有繞過 DOM observer 時才需要自己呼叫 ZtorDateInput.mount(scope)。
Don't別做
  • Hand-write .date-input wrappers in pages — duplicated markup drifts.
  • 別在頁面手寫 .date-input 外層，重複 markup 會分岔。
  • Keep the icon visible when filled — it eats 28px and clips narrow fields.
  • 別讓 icon 在已填狀態留著——它吃掉 28px，窄欄會被切字。

Specification

規格

Sourcedate-input.css · partials/date-input.js
Anatomy.date-input[data-empty] > .date-input__icon + .input + .date-input__ph. The wrapper, icon and placeholder are injected at runtime; pages only author the .input.
States[data-empty="true"] calendar icon at --sp-12 + "Pick a date" at --sp-40 in --muted-foreground, native ::-webkit-datetime-edit hidden, input padded to --sp-40 · [data-empty="false"] icon and placeholder hidden, padding back to the base --sp-12, date in --foreground.
Behavior / usageCovers date, datetime-local and time — all three share the "Pick a date" copy (field.pick-date) per the 2026-07-21 ruling. The native calendar button is flattened into a transparent full-field overlay, so clicking anywhere opens the picker via showPicker(). A MutationObserver catches runtime-injected fields (restock, pickup session, manual entry, product post modals) so partials need no wiring of their own.
Token usage--muted-foreground, --foreground, --font-body, --fs-14, --sp-12, --sp-40.
Classes.date-input · .date-input__icon · .date-input__ph
DependenciesDecorates Input; composes Icon (calendar).
Evidence / usage~40 date fields across 17 pages: create-product · create-bundle · create-auction · create-event · create-campaign · create-project · product-detail · bundle-detail · settings · fans-crm · admin-platform-fees · ip-bank-reporting · pickup · pickup-detail · e-shop · earnings, plus the restock / pickup-session / manual-entry / product-post modals.
NoteThis page has no data-i18n runtime, so the demo placeholder stays English in both language modes; product pages resolve field.pick-date normally.

4.87 Stock readout

🔵 atom

Purpose

用途

A read-only quantity shown as a big number rather than an input, for values that can only change through a specific action. Product detail uses it for stock: units are added by Restock (every restock is logged), so rendering it as an .input would imply you can type over it. The optional denominator (a Limited edition cap) and the unit both live in __unit, keeping the number itself the single focal point.

唯讀的數量，用大數字而非輸入框呈現——適用於「只能透過某個特定動作改變」的值。商品明細的庫存用它：庫存只能靠補貨增加（每筆留紀錄），做成 .input 會讓人以為可以打字覆蓋。可選的分母（限量版本的上限）與單位都收在 __unit 裡，讓數值本身維持單一焦點。

Rendered preview

視覺展示

3 units Low Stock
To add units, use Restock on the right — every restock is logged.
18 / 50 units
Limited edition — the cap goes in the unit slot, no badge needed.

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Pair it with a hint naming the action that changes the number.
  • 配一句 hint 說明「要改這個數字得做什麼」。
  • Put the cap and unit together in __unit.
  • 分母與單位一起放進 __unit。
Don't別做
  • Don't use KPI here — that's a standalone metric tile for dashboards; this is a line inside a form card.
  • 別拿 KPI 來用——那是儀表列用的獨立方塊，這個是表單卡內的一行讀數。
  • Don't render an editable .input for a value the user can't actually type into.
  • 使用者其實不能打字的值，別做成可編輯的 .input。

Specification

規格

Sourcestock-readout.css
Anatomy.stock-readout > .stock-readout__num + .stock-readout__unit + optional Badge. Baseline-aligned flex row; no container styling of its own (it sits inside a .field).
Behavior / usageRead-only. The consumer decides whether to show a status badge (low stock / sold out) and swaps the denominator in when the edition is Limited. Product detail hides the / 50 span unless [data-when-edition="limited"].
Token usage--font-display, --fs-28, --fw-medium, --foreground（數值）; --fs-13, --muted-foreground（單位）; --sp-8, --sp-6. Letter-spacing −0.6px 為顯示字體的視覺補償，非 token。
Classes.stock-readout · .stock-readout__num · .stock-readout__unit
DependenciesComposes Badge (optional). Distinct from KPI — see Do & Don't.

4.88 Restock log ✝

🟡 molecule

✝ Retired 2026-09-11. The fixed-column restock table (built 2026-07-22) was widened to six columns as "stock history" on the same day, then replaced by Stock history after the user chose the "one row per order, details on expand" candidate (lab-stock-history.html H1): supplier, method, ETA and note belong to the order, and one order can restock several combinations — a per-combination table either repeats them or cannot fit the note. restock-log.css is a tombstone; original rules are in git history.

✝ 2026-09-11 退場。固定欄的補貨紀錄表（2026-07-22 建）同日先擴成六欄的「庫存歷史紀錄」，再依使用者裁決（lab-stock-history.html H1）改成「一張單一筆、點開看明細」的 Stock history：供應商、方式、預計到貨、備註是單的屬性，一單可同時補好幾個組合——逐組合一列的固定欄表不是重複講就是塞不下備註。restock-log.css 留墓碑，原始規則見 git 歷史。

4.89 Stock tip

🟢 atom

Purpose

用途

Hover or focus any product row's "Status" or "Stock" cell in the E-Shop product list → a small floating info card. For multi-option or bundle rows, it lists every option combination's own stock count (bundle members flattened down to their own option combinations too). Promoted 2026-07-23 from user feedback — wanting the per-option breakdown visible without opening the Restock popup. Scope was widened the same day: asked why single-variant rows (zine, acetate, pin) didn't get it too — for those rows the card restates current stock (with its real health colour). It briefly also showed a computed low-stock threshold line, added then removed the same day on user instruction — the threshold logic (lowThr(), 10% of cap) still lives in the shared data layer for the Restock popup, it just isn't surfaced in this card anymore.

hover 或 focus 電子商店商品清單裡任何一列的「狀態」或「庫存」欄 → 浮出一張小卡。多選項或組合商品列會列出每個選項組合各自的庫存（組合商品連成員都攤到成員自己的選項組合）。2026-07-23 依使用者反饋 promote——想在不開補貨彈窗的情況下就看到逐選項的庫存。同一天擴大範圍：使用者追問「為什麼單一選項商品（zine、acetate、pin）沒有」——這些列改顯示「目前庫存」一行（照實際健康度上色）。中間曾短暫多顯示一行低庫存門檻，同一天使用者又指示拿掉——門檻換算邏輯（lowThr()，cap 的 10%）仍留在共用資料層給補貨彈窗用，只是這張浮卡不再顯示。

Relationships

元件關係

Built from由哪些元件組成 ↓
No sub-components — plain floating card沒有子元件——單純的浮出卡
Used by被哪些元件使用 ↑
Sits directly on Product list's status/stock cells直接掛在 Product list 的狀態／庫存儲存格上

Why JS positions it, not pure CSS :hover

為什麼定位靠 JS、不是純 CSS :hover

The list scrolls under a sticky filter bar (E-Shop's .list-toolbar / .list-status-row). A row near the top of the viewport would have its popup covered by the sticky bar if it always opened upward; a row near the bottom would push the popup off-screen if it always opened downward. JS measures the trigger's getBoundingClientRect() on mouseenter/focusin, flips direction based on whether the row sits in the top or bottom half of the viewport, and sets position: fixed coordinates directly — plain CSS can't see viewport position to make that call.

清單捲動在一個有 sticky 篩選列的容器裡（電子商店的 .list-toolbar／.list-status-row）。固定往上開，viewport 上緣的列會被 sticky 列蓋到；固定往下開，viewport 下緣的列會把浮卡推出可視範圍。JS 在 mouseenter／focusin 量測觸發格的 getBoundingClientRect()，依列在 viewport 上半部或下半部翻轉開啟方向，直接設定 position: fixed 座標——純 CSS 看不到 viewport 位置，做不了這個判斷。

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Generate the popup content from the same variant data the Restock popup reads — never hand-type a second copy of the numbers.
  • 浮卡內容從補貨彈窗讀的同一份選項資料產生——別另外手key第二份數字。
  • Keep both cells' content identical for now (status cell and stock cell both show the full option breakdown).
  • 目前兩個欄位的內容維持一樣（狀態欄、庫存欄都顯示完整的選項明細）。
  • When the row's badge is "Low Stock" (e-shop.row.low), filter the list down to just the options that need restocking — omit the healthy ones entirely rather than just de-emphasizing them.
  • 列徽章是「急需補貨」（e-shop.row.low）時，清單只留需要補貨的選項——健康的選項直接不列，不是弱化顯示就好。
Don't別做
  • Don't leave a native title attribute on a cell that also carries .stock-tip — they compete on the same hover, stacking a browser-native tooltip on top of the custom popup (found on the acetate row's stock cell, removed 2026-07-23).
  • 別在掛了 .stock-tip 的儲存格上留原生 title 屬性——兩套 hover 提示會互搶，瀏覽器原生 tooltip 疊在自訂浮卡上面（acetate 列的庫存欄踩過，2026-07-23 移除）。
  • Don't put data-i18n directly on .stock-tip — i18n.js's innerHTML swap would wipe the .stock-tip__pop child. Wrap the translatable text in its own <span data-i18n> sibling instead.
  • 別把 data-i18n直接掛在 .stock-tip 上——i18n.js 的 innerHTML 覆寫會把子節點 .stock-tip__pop 一起清掉。可翻譯文字改包一層 <span data-i18n>手足。

Specification

規格

Sourcestock-tip.css
Anatomy.stock-tip (trigger cell, position: relative) > .stock-tip__pop (position: fixed card, role="tooltip"; position: absolute under .stock-tip--anchored) > .stock-tip__row (.stock-tip__name + .stock-tip__qty, --low/--out modifiers colour the quantity).
Statesdefault (closed) — opacity:0; visibility:hidden · .stock-tip.is-open (JS-added on mouseenter/focusin, removed on mouseleave/focusout) — popup fades in, position set inline by JS.
Behavior / usageContent is pre-populated once per row on page load into both the status cell's and the stock cell's .stock-tip__pop — only the position is recomputed on every hover. Rows with option data (from the same PRODUCT_MATRIX/PRODUCT_VARIANTS/BUNDLE_MEMBERS the Restock popup reads) get the per-option breakdown; if the row's status cell contains [data-i18n="e-shop.row.low"] ("Low Stock"), that list is filtered to just the low/out entries before rendering (2026-07-23). Rows without option data (single-variant) get one line instead (2026-07-23, scope widened): current stock, colour reflecting row[data-status] — the option-health filter above doesn't apply to it. A low-stock threshold line was briefly shown here too; removed same day on user instruction (the threshold math still lives in the shared data layer for the Restock popup).
Token usage--card (bg) · --shadow-float (E3, same rung as dropdown/readiness pops) · --radius-md · --foreground / --foreground-muted (label) · --status-warning / --status-error (quantity colour) · --fs-12 / --fw-medium / --lh-normal.
Classes.stock-tip(--anchored · --up) · .stock-tip__pop · .stock-tip__row · .stock-tip__name · .stock-tip__qty(--low/--out)
DependenciesNone — plain CSS, no composed component.
Evidence / usagee-shop.html — every row of the Products tab (zine/tee/hoodie/acetate/pin) and both rows of the Bundles tab. store-settings.html (2026-09-22, D299) — discount-code list "Applies to" cell when a code is bound to specific items (--anchored; count text refilled per language by the page since i18n has no {n} parameter).

4.86 Nest

🔵 atom

Purpose

用途

A full-bleed block seated at the bottom of a card: its left, right and bottom edges meet the card's outer edge. Use it when flipping a mode grows a whole set of controls below — e.g. switching Variations to "Multiple" in create-product. Aligned to Figma node 856:27798. Q71 (2026-08-25): the upward-cast shadow is gone — the layer now separates from the card with a 1px top hairline instead.

嵌在卡片底部的滿版子層：左右與下緣切齊卡片外緣。用在「切換某個模式後，下方長出一整組設定」的情境——例如建立商品的商品選項切到「多選項」。對齊 Figma node 856:27798。Q71（2026-08-25）：拿掉向上打的陰影，改用上緣 1px 髮絲線分層。

Rendered preview (toggle the theme — light separates by the hairline alone, dark relies on the nest-surface film since its hairline is transparent by design)

視覺展示 （切換日／夜看差別——亮色靠髮絲線分層，深色線本身透明、改靠 nest-surface 薄膜分層）

Variations

The nest below is flush with the card's own edges.

Two fills only — layer 3 and beyond use borders

只有兩層填色——第三層以後改用邊框

L1 card --card (absolute) → L2 nest --nest-surface (translucent film). Stacking a third fill makes every layer muddier and washes the canvas's colour temperature out, so depth beyond L2 is carried by a 1px border instead. The rule is not written into nest.css — a nest doesn't know what will be placed inside it, and a blanket .nest > * would hit the wrong things. Consumers apply it themselves; first case is Variant builder's .option-set__row / .variant-option, which dropped their --input-surface fill for transparent + 1px --border. L3 borders have no dedicated token — reuse --border.

L1 卡片 --card（絕對色）→ L2 nest --nest-surface（半透明薄膜）。再往上疊第三層填色會讓每一層都愈來愈糊、也把畫布的色溫洗掉，所以 L2 以後的層級改用 1px 邊框表達。這條規則不寫在 nest.css 裡——nest 不知道自己裡面會放什麼，硬寫 .nest > * 會誤傷；由消費端自己套。首個落地案例是 Variant builder 的 .option-set__row／.variant-option，它們把 --input-surface 填色換成 transparent ＋ 1px --border。L3 邊框沒有專屬 token，就用 --border。

Why a cool-grey film, not plain white: a white overlay neutralises the midnight canvas's cool cast (B−R drops from +2 to +0.8). The tint rgb(222,223,233) pushes it to +3.0 instead, staying the same temperature as the canvas. Same value Figma arrived at independently (856:27796).

為什麼用冷調薄膜、不用純白：純白疊上去會把 midnight 畫布的冷色調洗掉（B−R 由 +2 掉到 +0.8）。改用 rgb(222,223,233) 這個 tint 反而把冷調推到 +3.0，與畫布同溫。Figma 獨立算出的也是同一個值（856:27796）。

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Put it last inside the card — it is anchored to the bottom edge.
  • 放在卡片的最後一個子元素——它是貼著底緣長的。
  • Use .card--muted instead for a static sub-block that keeps the card's inner padding.
  • 只是「卡片裡的一段」而且要保留卡片內距時，改用 .card--muted。
Don't別做
  • Don't put a dropdown or popover in a card that holds a nest — the card is clipped.
  • 含 nest 的卡片裡別放 dropdown／popover——那張卡被裁切，浮層會被切掉。
  • Don't stack a third fill inside a nest; use a border.
  • 別在 nest 裡再疊第三層填色，用邊框。

Specification

規格

Sourcenest.css
AnatomySingle block. Negative margins (calc(var(--sp-16) * -1)) cancel the parent card's --sp-16 padding on left / right / bottom; --sp-16 top margin keeps the gap from the preceding control.
Behavior / usageborder-radius matches the parent card's --radius-xl exactly, because the three edges are coincident. Q71 (2026-08-25): the layer is separated from the card by border-top: 1px solid var(--nest-line) instead of an upward shadow. Light theme: both fills are white, so the hairline (--nest-line, opaque) is the only thing that shows a boundary. Dark theme: --nest-line is transparent (invisible on purpose) and the separation is carried entirely by the --nest-surface 4% film. The parent still needs .form-section--outlined:has(> .nest) { overflow: hidden; } so the nest's own outer corners stay exactly flush with the card. .nest[hidden] forces display:none so a consumer's own display:flex can't leak through.
Token usage--nest-surface（dark rgba(222,223,233,.04) / light transparent）, --nest-line（dark transparent / light rgba(16,17,20,.08)）, --radius-xl, --sp-16. --shadow-nest-up is no longer used by this component (still used by Funding panel).
Classes.nest
DependenciesRequires a Form section .form-section--outlined parent. Distinct from Card .card--muted — see Do & Don't.
Evidence / usagecreate-product — Variations builder (#cp-var-builder), shown in Multiple-variations mode.

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Keep all four tier columns equal width — that is what makes "fewer benefits going right" readable.
  • 四欄一律等寬——「往右走越來越少」是靠這個才讀得出來。

  • 窄容器用 .tier-ov--compact，再窄就包 .tier-ov-scroll 橫向捲。
Don't別做
  • Put inputs or switches in it — read-only is the split between this and .bmx.
  • 別加輸入框或開關——唯讀是它與 .bmx 的分工。
  • Let a column size to its content; an unequal grid makes the comparison lie.
  • 別讓欄寬跟著內容跑，欄寬不齊比較就失真。

殼層換裝（2026-08-31，Q97）：浮層外框改吃 ztorUI 的殼層材質，與側欄／精靈頂列同一套語言——面板 --ztu-glass-bg 玻璃底加 --ztu-blur-heavy（40px）模糊加四角 --radius-shell 加頂緣 --ztu-glass-rim 內光加 --ztu-shadow-card（原本是不透明 --surface-shell、只圓上面兩角）、留白改 --ztu-shell-gutter 四邊等寬（原本貼著視窗底邊）、頭列由 --surface-page 改透明讓面板玻璃透上來、分隔線改 --border-soft、兩顆控件的 hover 底由 --accent 改 --ztu-film。模糊只做在面板這一層：背板改成純暗紗（濃度旋鈕 --sheet-veil，現值 --ztu-canvas 60%，不加 backdrop-filter），整個視窗都糊掉的話面板就沒有東西可以透過去，玻璃感會消失。紅線：背板這一層不可以動 opacity——帶 opacity 的祖先會成為 backdrop root，底下那一頁被排除在後代的 backdrop 之外，面板的 backdrop-filter 就變成「有宣告、computed 讀得到、但什麼都沒糊」（2026-08-31 踩過，入場淡入已改成動 background-color，面板的位移動畫也拿掉了 opacity）。配套在 shared.css 的內嵌模式：html[data-embed] .main 的不透明底改透明，並關掉 <body> 的檯面色、暖光與四層星空，讓 iframe 整片透明——否則浮層裡的詳情頁會把檯面再畫一次，讀起來像「換了一張新背景」而不是「一塊毛玻璃蓋在原本那頁上」。暗紗濃度是實測值：太透，詳情頁自己的半透明卡片裡會浮出底下那頁的鬼影；太不透，就沒有玻璃。詳情頁內容一行未改。

樣式來源：ds-components/detail-sheet.css。
