2026-07-31 使用者裁決（版面重整）：
.vault-lens 自成一列橫跨在庫房與內容之上、靠右對齊——它換的是整頁的檢視角度，放側欄會被讀成清單篩選器、放頁首動作列會被讀成一顆按鈕。狀態不另外寫成一句話：側欄逐列標「打不開」＋主欄遮罩＋下拉自己轉橘已經說完了；這一列只是版面，不上底色（內容靠右之後整條上色會變成一大片空色塊）。「回到我的視角」排在下拉左邊，讓下拉守住最右邊界。
頁首不放動作列——建立庫房的入口只留側欄 .vault-rail__new 一顆，且排在 .vault-rail__list 之上，跟按下去長出來的 .vault-rail__draft（清單第一列）連在一起。
空的分區整個不出現（.vault-group--empty／__empty 已退場）：新庫房原本會連續印出四塊「這裡沒有東西」，改成空庫房只給一張 .vault-empty，「三種媒體各自歸位」那句話在那裡講一次。
上傳入口隨狀態換位置——空的時候是 .vault-empty 整塊，有內容之後收進 .vault-gridbar__right 的 ghost 鈕；兩者共用同一個 <input type=file>，拖放綁在 [data-vault-grid] 容器。
.vault-rail__draft 移到清單第一列並拆掉外層卡片（原本橘框卡片＋.input 自己的框＝框中框）。
說明各歸各位：條件細則貼著條件放成 .vault-door__fine，整頁的原型聲明降級為頁尾 .page-note，兩者都不再是壓在媒體清單下面的 .info-banner。

總覽卡片牆 ＋ 單一庫房彈窗（2026-07-31 探索、2026-08-01 退為保存檔 media-vault-popup.html）：使用者試用後裁示正式頁改回清單與詳情並排——可以直接切換庫房、直接編輯 media，不必先開再關一層彈窗。兩種版型共用同一支 js/media-vault.js，靠 <html data-vault-view="popup"> 分流。當初的推導：全站導覽已經是左欄，庫房清單再常駐一欄就變兩條並排；清單天生垂直（縮圖／名稱／內容數／鑰匙數）轉橫排塞不下，所以解法不是轉向，是讓它不要跟主內容同時出現。
頁面只放 .vault-overview 卡片牆（封面放得比 276px 側欄大，「哪座門開得最大」比清單更一眼看得出來）；點一張卡，那座庫房開在 .vault-modal 裡——彈窗內沒有全站導覽，清單因此可以留在左邊，只有一條左欄，換庫房也不必關掉彈窗。外殼沿用 Embed modal，只換尺寸（1320×940）與內部捲動；捲動容器換成 .vault-modal__body，所以側欄與讀數的貼頂高度在彈窗內歸零。庫房名字只寫在彈窗標題列（捲不走），內文不重複。
探索過但沒採用：只留標題旁的切換下拉（看不到全部庫房的概況）、把全站導覽改走頂列（那是全站偏好，為單一頁面改它本末倒置）。

清單靠右（2026-08-01 使用者裁示）：.vault-layout 改成 1fr 276px，用 order 換位置而不動 DOM 順序——清單是在庫房之間導覽的東西，讀屏與 Tab 先碰到它是對的，換的只是它畫在哪一邊；窄版收成單欄時清單回到內容上方（右邊已經不存在，擺下面等於要先捲過整座庫房才選得到下一座）。檢視身分那一列跟著改為靠左、與內容切齊同一條左邊界。

單一內容的設定（2026-08-01 使用者裁示「點進去每個 media 設定裡」）：點格子／音檔列打開右側 Drawer。用抽屜不用第二層彈窗——庫房本身已經是一層彈窗，再疊一層會變成對話框中的對話框，而且會蓋掉剛才點的那一格。內容只放這座原型真的有的欄位（名稱可改；類型／長度／大小／加入日期唯讀，用 <dl> 而非 input，因為它們改不動）與既有的刪除動作。
同一輪：檢視身分搬進彈窗標題列（它問的是「這座庫房從粉絲那一側長怎樣」，是進到庫房才要問的問題；標題列捲不走）；Embed modal 的遮罩底色改黑——原本混的是 --foreground，深色主題下那是接近白的前景色，遮罩因此變成一層白紗，改成與 .payout-modal 同一個配方（--background ＋ --overlay-tint），全站遮罩只剩一種寫法。

區塊標題（2026-07-31 使用者裁示）：.vault-door__label（解鎖條件／誰進得來／已發出的鑰匙／這座庫房裡）原本走「12px 全大寫加字距 muted」的欄位標籤規格——那是標一個輸入框用的。這四個各自帶起下面一整塊內容，是標題，所以改吃 Card 的 .card__title 既有規格（Satoshi 標題體 18px Regular 前景色），與全站區塊標題一致；圖示放大到 16px、維持 muted 色，不跟標題搶字重。

「進得來的方法」（2026-07-31，原型先行、待上游裁決 — ASSUMPTIONS PG-025）：rules 從單層條件陣列改成「方法」清單 [{items:[…]},…]——一個 {} ＝ 一種進得來的方法；任何一種達成就進得來，同一種方法裡的條件要全部達成。例：方法一＝「核心圈 ＋ 買過黑膠」，方法二＝「出席過簽名會」，兩種中一種就開得了門。
方向是外層任一、內層全部——創作者腦中的東西是「我開了幾條路給粉絲走」，每條路各有幾個門檻；反過來同樣算得出結果，但要人自己補括號。
措辭不用邏輯符號：畫面上寫「這些要一起達成」「或是」「多一種進得來的方法」，不寫「且／或／AND／OR」。
漸進顯示：框只在該方法有兩個以上條件時才畫；「或是」在有兩種方法時才出現。空的方法不算達成（否則剛加一種還沒選條件，門就對全站開了），刪到空的自動消失。鑰匙不受影響，永遠疊在條件之上。遮罩上的條件直排、行間寫「或是」——橫排斷行會讓人看不出括號在哪。
這動到的是權限規則，屬產品決策，觸及人數與遮罩文案全部隨之改變；未經上游核准前不得視為正式功能。

  1. 1 《海上霸姬鄭一嫂》為什麼是這五年最好的港產武打片 640 次
  2. 2 【分鏡拆解】旺角狙擊開場那顆長鏡頭 512 次

長條寬度是資料（--w 由呼叫端算好），色相是分類（--hue 吃 --chart-* token）；.perf-rank--nopct 為無百分比的 4 欄變體。.perf-rank--wide 把名稱欄改吃比例（2fr 對長條的 1fr）、不設固定上限——預設的 148px 是為片名、歌名、平台名這種七八個字的短名訂的，作品全名與貼文標題是一整句，塞進去只看得到前六個字；換成更大的固定值也只是把問題往後推，比例才會把剩下的寬度真的讓給名稱。實際由 js/performance-store.js 與 js/audience-store.js 生成，消費頁：index.html、project-detail.html、audience-report.html、fan-analytics.html。

樣式來源：ds-components/perf-rank.css。

「畫面乾淨時 Save 按鈕自我停用」——已儲存卻仍亮著的 Save 是在說謊，狀態改由旁邊的時間戳承接安心感；未儲存變更用琥珀色而非紅色，因為此刻還沒有出錯。實際由 js/toast.js（window.ztorToast.show(...)）動態建立於 <body> 下。消費頁：media-vault.html、tier-settings.html、tier-benefits.html。

跨頁佇列 queue() (2026-07-30 新增)

有些確認發生在「按下去就換頁」的動作上（例：建立流程按發布 → 導向項目詳情頁）。show() 只活在當前頁，換頁那一刻就被丟掉；queue() 把訊息先存進 sessionStorage，換頁後由下一個載入 js/toast.js 的頁面在 DOM ready 時「先刪佇列再顯示」——所以中途重整不會把同一則提示再跳一次。任何頁面只要載入 js/toast.js 就自動具備接收能力，不必逐頁接線。

window.ztorToast.queue('項目已發布', {
  key: 'cpp.publish.toast.now',   // i18n key：顯示時機在下一頁，語言可能已切換
  tone: 'success'
});
// → project-detail.html 載入時自動顯示一次，之後從佇列清除

存的是 i18n key 而不是翻好的字串——顯示時機在下一頁，語言可能已被切換過；查不到 key（打錯、字典未補）才退回呼叫時傳入的 message 字串當保底，畫面上不會出現 raw key。首個消費者：create-project.html 的建立流程發布動作，導向 project-detail.html 顯示成功提示。

樣式來源：ds-components/toast.css。

4.110 Custom select (zselect)

🟡 molecule

用途

自製下拉選單，取代瀏覽器原生 <select> 展開後的清單——那部分是作業系統畫的，任何瀏覽器都不開放樣式化。js/zselect.js 在執行期把每個 <select class="select"> 升級成「觸發鈕＋自繪 listbox」，原生 select 留在 DOM 當資料來源。

坐在可切檢視／編輯的面板裡時要標 data-view-safe（2026-08-10）。觸發鈕本體是 <button>，而 shared.css 有一條「[data-mode="view"] 底下藏掉所有按鈕」的規則——那條針對的是動作鈕，不是表單控件；沒標的下拉會在唯讀狀態整顆消失，只剩一個標籤底下空一塊。標了就一起搬到觸發鈕，唯讀時仍看得見選到的值（停用態的淡色）。首個消費者：project-detail.html 公開資訊的年齡分級。
2026-09-11 起不必逐顆標：shared.css 那條白名單直接放行 .zselect__trigger——商品詳情的商品設定分頁一次有六七顆下拉，逐顆補標漏一顆就少一個欄位；唯讀時觸發鈕跟著原生 select 一起 disabled，只顯示目前值。既有的 data-view-safe 留著無害。

4.111 Finding card

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

One finding that carries its own evidence: the conclusion on the left, the figures that produce it on the right. Written as a paragraph, the numbers get buried in the sentence and the reader has to pull them out to compare — when that comparison is the whole point. Spec 5.1.7.8 F7 requires four parts and refuses fewer: the finding, scannable figures, what it is based on, and a way to drill in.

一則「帶得走證據的結論」：左邊是一句話的發現與依據，右邊是支撐它的數字。寫成一段文字時數字會埋進句子裡，讀的人要自己把兩個數字拉出來比 —— 而那個落差正是整則結論的重點。規格 5.1.7.8 F7 要求四個組成缺一不可：結論句、可獨立掃視的支撐數字、依據與涵蓋範圍、追查入口。

Relationships

4.112 Source status

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

A data-coverage indicator that takes no layout of its own. It sits in the page header actions and says two things in one pill — how many sources the figures cover, and whether anything needs attention. The detail opens on click. Coverage is the precondition for reading every number on the page, so it must always be visible; but it is not the task the user came to do, so it must not occupy a block. When something is wrong the whole pill turns destructive and stays that way until it is resolved.

不占版位的資料涵蓋指示。它坐在頁首操作區，用一顆膠囊講兩件事 —— 數字涵蓋幾個來源、有沒有需要處理的異常；明細點開才展開。涵蓋範圍是判讀頁上每個數字的前提，必須隨時看得到；但它不是使用者來這頁要完成的任務，所以不能占掉一個區塊。有異常時整顆轉 destructive 色，且異常排除前不回到低調樣式。

4.113 Auth shell

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

The shell for the pre-login layer — the only surface a visitor sees before the workspace exists. It carries no product navigation: there is no sidebar, no header, no breadcrumb, because none of them can be trusted to mean anything before identity is known. There is no card either — the content sits straight on the page background, matching the ztor consumer login. Every step swaps inside the same column rather than navigating away, so the visitor never loses the sense of being in one place doing one thing.

未登入層的殼，是訪客在工作區存在之前唯一看得到的畫面。它不掛任何產品導航——沒有側欄、沒有頁首、沒有麵包屑，因為身分未知之前這些東西都指不到可信的目的地。也沒有卡片：內容直接坐在頁面底色上，比照 ztor 消費端的登入頁（2026-08-04 使用者裁示）。所有步驟在同一個內容欄裡互切、不換頁，讓訪客始終覺得自己在同一個地方做同一件事。

2026-08-04 使用者裁示再兩件：(1) 內容的垂直起點改成固定——.auth-page 由 align-items:center 換成 flex-start ＋ calc(var(--sp-96) + var(--sp-72)) 上內距（手機 ≤480px 仍是 --sp-96）。置中的問題是四個畫面高度不同，切畫面時標題會上下跳；固定起點之後標題永遠在同一條線上，只有下方在長高。(2) 加上第三方登入——Apple／Google／Facebook／LINE 四個入口。品牌標記是 icons.js 裡唯一非 Tabler 的字符（Simple Icons CC0 官方單色路徑），一律吃 currentColor、不帶品牌彩色值。

2026-08-04 第二輪使用者裁示「將第三方全部都用這種格式」：第三方原本是一列四顆只有品牌標記的方塊（.auth-oauth / .auth-oauth__btn），本輪改成跟電子郵件／手機號碼同一種卡，六張一起住進 F1 那個 .segmented.radio-cards--gate——2 欄 × 3 列，第 1 列是電子郵件／手機號碼、第 2-3 列是四個第三方。用同一個 grid 而不是兩個相鄰區塊，是因為六者是同一個決定的六個答案，切成兩塊會冒出兩種垂直間距在描述同一件事。六張都是「標題＋一行副標」，所以六張等高：副標的職責是回答「怎麼驗證」——前兩張是密碼／簡訊驗證碼，四張第三方的對應事實是「不需另設密碼」，四張共用同一個 i18n key（login.method.oauth.sub）。共用一句是刻意的：它們彼此的差別已經由圖示與名稱說完，副標負責說這一整組跟前兩張差在哪；寫成四句不同的話會變成把 Apple／Google 這些名字再講一次。可讀名稱＝卡面上看得見的標題，login.oauth.* 五個純 aria-label 的 key 一併刪除；.auth-oauth 兩條規則零消費，也一併從 auth.css 移除。

2026-08-04 使用者裁示改成無卡片版：原本的 .auth-card（--card 底＋--shadow-card＋--radius-xl＋--sp-32 內距）改名 .auth-shell 並拿掉全部容器外觀，頁底也由 --surface-shell 換成 --background——--surface-shell 存在的理由是襯托疊在上面的卡，卡沒了就不需要那一層。內層 F1 的兩個登入方式仍是可點方塊（.radio-cards--gate），拿掉的只有最外層那張卡。

步驟切換由 data-auth-step 與 [hidden] 驅動，不換頁也不動 URL——四個畫面（方式選擇／電子郵件／手機號碼／忘記密碼）共用同一個內容欄。.auth-step[hidden]{display:none} 是必要的顯式還原，因為 .auth-step 自己宣告了 display。

ds-components/auth.css。消費頁：login.html（規格 5.1.10 / D170）。這頁不載 js/sidebar.js，骨架照站上唯一的無側欄全畫面先例 scanner.html。全站帳戶選單的「登出」（js/sidebar.js 的 [data-logout]）導回這一頁。

4.114 Ticket tier card

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

A repeatable row for building a list of ticket tiers inside a creation flow. Each card has two faces: collapsed it is a summary — name plus the two facts that decide whether the tier is right (price, quantity); expanded it becomes the edit form and the summary steps aside. Only one card edits at a time, so the list never turns into a wall of open forms.

建立流程裡可重複增列的票種卡。每張卡有兩個面貌：收合時是摘要——名稱加上判斷這個票種對不對所需的兩個事實（價格、數量）；展開時整張變成編輯表單、摘要讓位。一次只有一張卡在編輯，清單才不會變成一整面攤開的表單。

Single-ticket dialog, rebuilt 2026-09-22 (D311): the dialog shell is unchanged (.payout-modal / .payout-dialog, Q27) but its contents are not. The two tabs (Settings / Who can buy) are gone — they split one ticket in half, while price and who-can-buy are the same decision. In their place: four .form-section--dense blocks — Basics (ticket name + the image shrunk to one tile) / Price & quantity (a .calc-list--form: ticket price + booking fee = fans pay − platform fee = you receive, with quantity deliberately outside the list) / Entry (early-entry minutes + an explicit “Follow the date / Custom” pair) / Who can buy (a “Follow event defaults” switch at the right of the section title: on = three summary rows of the inherited rules, off = the rules expanded, copy-on-write unchanged). The head carries a sub-title (date · venue) and the footer’s left slot reads “N fields need fixing”. New: a platform-fee exception, Admin-only, hanging under the platform-fee row (.calc-list__extra: an optional switch, off by default, then a required 0–100 rate); the creator sees a read-only fee row reading “Exception X% (set by Admin)”. The three-layer rate resolution (this ticket’s exception → this creator’s override → General) lives in js/platform-fees.js and names the leaf with the fee-settings page’s own i18n keys. A bookyay-imported ticket turns the whole block into read-only fact rows plus one “From bookyay” badge on the section title — no per-field lock chips, no clear buttons (same line as D308).

單張門票彈窗重做（2026-09-22，D311）：彈窗殼沒變（.payout-modal／.payout-dialog，Q27），內容整個重排。「設定／購買條件」兩個分頁退場——分頁把一張票拆成兩半，而價格與誰能買是同一次決定。改成四個 .form-section--dense 區塊：基本（門票名稱＋縮成一格的門票圖片）／價格與數量（.calc-list--form 算式列表：票價 ＋ 手續費 ＝ 粉絲付 − 平台費 ＝ 創作者實收，數量刻意排在列表之外）／入場（提前入場分鐘數＋明確的「跟隨場次／自訂」二選一）／購買條件（區塊標題右側一顆「跟隨活動預設」開關：開＝三組規則的繼承值摘要三列，關＝規則攤開可改，copy-on-write 不變）。標題列多一行副標（場次日期・場地），頁尾左槽寫「N 個欄位待修正」。新增「例外平台費」：Admin 專屬，掛在平台費那一列底下（.calc-list__extra——開關選填預設關，開了才出現必填的 0–100 費率）；creator 本人看到的是唯讀的平台費列＋「例外 X%（Admin 設定）」。費率三層解析（本票例外 → creator 覆寫 → General）住在 js/platform-fees.js，葉節點名稱共用費率設定頁自己的 i18n key。bookyay 帶入的票整段改唯讀事實列＋區塊標題一枚「bookyay 帶入」徽章，不再逐欄掛鎖徽章與清空鈕（D308 同一口徑）。event-detail.html 的票種彈窗同一套結構，最後一個區塊是「販售」（暫停販售）——發布後改購買條件的規則上游未定。

4.116 Ticket preview

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

The ticket a fan ends up holding, shown live while the creator fills the form beside it. Two halves with a tear line between them: the top is identity (when, name or logo, what kind of ticket), the bottom is the QR that gets scanned at the door. The tear is the only metaphor this object needs — it says at a glance which half is for a person and which is for a machine.

粉絲最後拿到的那張票，創作者在旁邊填、這裡即時長出來。一條撕線把票分成兩半：上半是識別（時間、票名或 logo、哪一種票），下半是進場掃的 QR。撕線是這個物件唯一需要的隱喻——一眼就說明哪半張給人看、哪半張給機器掃。

.session-list · __row（--main 為第 1 場）· __no（固定寬序號，讓多列欄位左緣對齊）· __fields（日期｜場地兩欄；--main 改單欄）· __text（--empty 為未填時的降權態）· __end（固定寬尾欄，讓「有移除鈕」與「有徽章」兩種列的右緣也對齊）· __add。2026-08-09 新增：__head[data-multi]（選配欄位標題列，與 __row 同排版、文字改小標色）· .session-list--detailed（多欄修飾類：單場 4 欄「日期｜起｜訖｜入場」，[data-multi="true"] 多插「場次名」成 5 欄，兩種欄寬各自定義；≤640px 時 __head 隱藏、欄位收成 1～2 欄）。

第 1 場為什麼是唯讀鏡像：日期與場地在同一頁上面已經有一組正式欄位，這裡再給一組可編輯的，同一筆資料就有兩個真相來源——使用者改了下面那格，上面那格與 Review 摘要、發布前檢核不知道該聽誰的。改成鏡像後只有「第 2 場起」是這份清單自己的資料。

開關為什麼在「場地與時間」不在確認頁：使用者最初指定放最後的確認頁；確認頁的定位是「檢查每一項沒問題就發布」，在那裡開一個會生出 N 個活動的開關等於在檢查步驟做重大建立動作，而且日期與場地都在前一步填過、要改得跳回去。2026-08-06 與使用者確認後移到「場地與時間」。

清單頁的群組列＝Row disclosure（§4.204，2026-09-04 改 L3 整組換層）：群組容器 .rowdis__group 包住母列＋所有子列（表格型不加 --gutter）、母列疊 .rowdis__head＋data-rowdis-row（整列可點）、把手 .rowdis__toggle＋data-rowdis、子列 .rowdis__child＋data-rowdis-child（零縮排，展開時階層由 .rowdis__group 那塊 L2 薄膜面板說），互動走 js/row-disclosure.js。把手站列首欄（2026-09-04 · Q109 改）——原本把手跟在名稱後面（列的中段），與列尾的 ⋮ 讀不出「這是同一列的兩個控制項」，各組名稱長度不同時把手的 x 位置還會浮動。現在它在 .rowdis__lead、列的最前緣，⋮ 維持最末端，子列在同一格放場次序號；一般列也有這一欄（留空），所以名稱欄的左緣仍是一條線。當初「不放最右操作欄」的顧慮依舊成立（清單頁的 .main 是 overflow-x:hidden，視窗窄一點時右側幾欄會被切掉且捲不到），列首欄剛好在被切掉的反方向。（2026-08-06 到 2026-09-03 之間，這件事由 product-list.css 自己的 __row--group／--child 承擔；Q107 裁決收斂成一支之後那組已退場，CSS 原處留墓碑。）系列母頁的入口要有名字：母列標題本身是連結（進系列母頁），但母列的整列點擊是「展開」，光靠標題沒人會發現那裡還能點去別的地方，所以操作欄的 ⋮ 另給一個具名項目「管理整個系列」，子場詳情頁的「系列」分頁也放一個。行為約定由消費頁負責：母列整列可點＝展開／收合（明確的展開鈕與 ⋮ 裡那一項一律有效，連結與選單本身放行）；子列不進分頁計數；子列可見＝母列過篩選且展開；搜尋中一律攤開（搜到的字可能長在某一場身上）。

三種活動詳情頁（2026-08-06 使用者裁決）：單場活動（event-detail.html，無系列）／系列母頁（series-detail.html）／系列子場（event-detail.html，有系列）。母頁承載共用設定、改一次同步所有場次；判準是「這個欄位每一場一不一樣」——一樣的（名稱、描述、陣容、圖片、人數、票種與票價）住母頁，不一樣的（日期、場地）住子場。階層要在麵包屑上讀得出來：子場是「活動 / 系列母頁 / 這一場」三層、返回鈕回系列母頁；末層寫「第 N 場 · 場地」不寫活動名稱（同系列各場刻意同名，用名稱三場會一模一樣）。單場活動維持兩層。母頁不是一場活動，所以頁首不掛日期與場地、也沒有報到與名單。入口有兩個：活動清單的母列標題、子場詳情頁「系列」分頁的「管理整個系列 →」。頁面上刻意寫死兩則規則：已開賣的警示用 .alert--row.--warning（沿用編輯活動「改動的後果」同一種說法），以及「取消系列中的一場＝與取消一場獨立活動完全相同的作廢規則」。

ds-components/session-list.css ＋ ds-components/row-disclosure.css／js/row-disclosure.js（群組列）。消費頁：create-event.html（步驟 3 場地與時間 › 系列場次，用 .session-list--detailed ＋ __head）、create-event-legacy.html（基準版）、events.html（系列母列與子列）、series-detail.html（系列母頁，場次表用頁內變體 product-list--series）、pickup-detail.html（2026-09-03／D240，取貨名單以買家分組：買多件的買家收成母列、每一件是一條子列；與活動清單同一支元件，未另開第二種分組列）。產品規格缺口見 ASSUMPTIONS SER-001。

4.118 Entry list

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

A field that collects an unknown number of same-kind short entries. One row is one .input plus a trailing remove button; an add button below appends an empty row. Built for the cast and crew step of the work release flow (spec 5.1.2.2.1 §4), where a film may credit one director or three.

用來收「不確定會有幾筆」的同型別短文字。一列是一格 .input 加行尾刪除鈕，下方的新增鈕補一列空的。為作品上架流程的演職人員而建（規格 5.1.2.2.1 §4）——一部片可能掛一位導演，也可能掛三位。

Relationships

元件關係

Built from由哪些元件組成 ↓
atomInput Button Icon
Do not confuse with Spec row: that one holds paired name-and-value data, this one holds a single column where every row answers the same question. Ask whether the row itself needs a field name — if it does, use Spec row.與 Spec row 分工明確：那支收「名稱＋值」的成對資料，這支收單欄清單、每一列都是同一個問題的另一個答案。判斷句是「這一列本身需要欄位名稱嗎」——需要就用 Spec row。

Rendered preview — last row filled, add button offered

視覺展示 — 最後一列已填字，給新增鈕

Last row still empty — add button withheld

最後一列還空著 — 收起新增鈕

Same markup in both previews — only [data-last-empty] differs. Nine of these sit side by side on the cast-and-crew step, and nine permanent add buttons shouted louder than the names; an add button also buys nothing while the last box is still blank.

兩張示範是同一份 markup，差別只在 [data-last-empty]。演職人員那一步並排九份名單，九顆常駐的新增鈕比名字本身還搶眼；最後一格還空著時按它也不會得到任何東西。

For developers — classes · code給工程師 — class · 程式碼

.entry-list[data-last-empty]（flex column）> .entry-list__row × N（.input 吃滿剩餘寬＋.btn--icon 刪除）＋ .entry-list__add（align-self:flex-start，不跟著拉滿寬）。

只剩一列時不給刪除鈕：清單至少留一格可填，由消費頁的 JS 切 hidden；元件負責的是「藏得掉」——.btn 自帶 display，[hidden] 單靠自己蓋不過去，所以 CSS 有一條 .entry-list__row .btn[hidden] { display:none }。

最後一列還沒填字就不給新增鈕（2026-08-07 使用者反饋）：.entry-list[data-last-empty="true"] .entry-list__add { display:none }。做成元件預設而不是可選變體——目前只有 publish-work.html 一個消費頁，而「上一格填了才問下一格」對任何同質清單都成立；要退回常駐版只要不設這個屬性，沒有 [data-last-empty] 的清單行為完全不變。空／不空由消費頁的 JS 判斷，屬性寫法沿用站上既有的 [data-empty]（Date input、票種卡的清空 ✕），不另立第三種「有值才出現」的機制。

焦點不能跟著按鈕消失：按下新增後那一列是空的、新增鈕當場收起，焦點若留在原地就落在 display:none 的按鈕上，所以消費頁在新增後把焦點交給新那一格的 .input；刪除後同理交給鄰近一列（優先上一列）。兩者都在 publish-work.html 的 bindRole() 內。

surface：內容是 .input 與 .btn--icon，兩者各自對所在層有邊界，容器本身不填色，白底與灰底（--card／--surface-shell／--muted）都成立。

ds-components/entry-list.css。消費頁：publish-work.html（步驟 4 演職人員）。

4.119 Review status

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

Answers four questions about one submitted item in one block: where it stands, the read-only facts behind that, why it came back if it did, and what can be done next. Built for the platform review of a finished film (spec 5.1.0.4 / 5.1.2.2 §2.2.9) and used on both sides of it — the creator reads the result on the project page, the reviewer reads the same block on the review page.

把一件送審作品的四個問題收在同一塊：現在走到哪、支撐這個判斷的唯讀事實、被退的話是為什麼、接下來能做什麼。為完成影片的平台審核而建（規格 5.1.0.4／5.1.2.2 §2.2.9），審核的兩端共用——創作者在項目頁看結果，審核者在審核頁看同一塊。

__thumb (2026-08-11) is optional and appears only in the work section of a project (spec 5.1.2.2 §2.2.11), where the creator has to recognise which work this is before reading its status. The updates section leaves it out — that block is about the post, and the surrounding section already says which project it belongs to.

__thumb（2026-08-11）是選配的，只用在項目詳情的作品區段（規格 5.1.2.2 §2.2.11）——那一區要先讓創作者認出這是哪一件作品，才讀得下狀態。更新區段那一塊不放：它講的是那則貼文，識別已由所在區段交代過。

For developers — classes · code給工程師 — class · 程式碼

.review-status（--rejected／--approved 只改 note 的左側色條；--flat 去掉外框與內距，供已經有卡片外框的容器內用）> __head（Badge ＋ __title）· __meta > __meta-item（每項是「欄目名＋值」兩個 span，第一個吃 --muted-foreground）· __note > __note-label ＋ __note-body（white-space:pre-line，退件理由是自由文字）· __actions。

狀態字彙不住在元件裡：徽章的文字與色調由 js/work-review-store.js 提供（label()／tone()），元件只負責版面。理由是同一組「待審核／審核中／審核通過／審核不通過」在創作者端與 Admin 端都會出現，字彙寫進任何一頁都會長出第二份；枚舉的權威在主規格 §7.2 作品審核列。

刻意與項目狀態徽章分開：作品審核狀態講的是「這一件送審作品」，項目狀態講的是「整個項目」，是兩個主體的兩套狀態，規格明令不得互相代用。所以這一塊坐在項目更新區段裡、有自己的徽章，不去改頁首那顆項目狀態徽章。

條件顯示的成員都要能藏：__meta-item、__note、__actions 各自宣告了 display，CSS 逐一補了 [hidden]{display:none}——不補的話 el.hidden = true 藏不掉（審核完成時間在還沒有結果時就會空著一個欄目名）。

surface：--card 底＋1px --border，白底與灰底（--surface-shell／--surface-page）都成立；note 用 --muted 填色，靠比容器深一階被看見。

ds-components/review-status.css。消費頁：project-detail.html（項目更新區段的作品審核狀態）、admin-video-review.html（送審件頁首與審核動作）。產品缺口見 ASSUMPTIONS UIA-109／UIA-111。

4.115 Size chart editor

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

A data table where the creator controls both axes. Rows are sizes; columns are whatever this garment needs measured — and that genuinely differs per item, so the columns cannot be a fixed set the way every other table on this site has one. Delete affordances stay hidden until you hover the row or column they belong to, because two growable axes means a permanently visible grid of delete icons would outweigh the data itself.

兩個維度都由創作者決定的資料表。列是尺碼、欄是這件衣服需要量的部位——而要量哪幾個部位本來就因商品而異，所以欄沒辦法像站上其他表格那樣是固定集合。刪除鈕平常藏起來、hover 到所屬的那一列或那一欄才浮現：兩軸都會長，一整排常駐的刪除圖示會蓋過資料本身。

Relationships

元件關係

Built from由哪些元件組成 ↓
atomInput Icon
Visual language is borrowed wholesale from Variant builder's table (frame, muted head, .input cells, row-end delete) so the two read as one family; the dynamic-column mechanism is borrowed from Benefit matrix's --bmx-cols.視覺語彙整套取自 Variant builder 的表格（外框、靜音表頭、.input 格子、列尾刪除），讓兩張表讀起來是同一族；動態欄的機制取自 Benefit matrix 的 --bmx-cols。

Rendered preview (guide switcher · size-system tabs · unit toggle · size chart)

視覺展示 (指南切換 · 尺碼制分頁 · 單位切換 · 尺寸表)

Shop guide
Size chart
Garment laid flat, not body measurements.

Fill in every system. Switching only swaps the size column — the measurements stay the same.

Size
For developers — classes · code給工程師 — class · 程式碼

.sce · __wrap（外框＋橫捲）· __table（欄定義的唯一住處）· __head ＞ __col ＞ __col-label ／ __col-input ＋ __col-remove · __row ＞ __cell（--size 為首欄識別格）＋ __row-remove · __foot ＞ __add。

欄定義只住在 --sce-cols 這一個變數上（宣告在 .sce__table，__head 與每個 __row 都 var() 取用）。__head 與每一列是各自獨立的 grid container，欄寬要對齊就只能吃同一份 grid-template-columns；JS 增減欄時只改這個變數＋每列補一格 DOM，不動 CSS。

首欄必須固定寬、不能用 max-content：兩個 grid 會各自解析 —— 表頭那格只有文字（72px）、資料列那格是輸入框（152px），兩邊就錯開。已改固定 112px。

表頭的欄名輸入框平常收起邊界：.input 的邊界是 box-shadow 環不是 border，所以要清 box-shadow，改 border-color 沒有作用。

.sce-block__tabs（2026-08-21 · D214）＝尺碼制的四個分頁（國際／US／EU／JP）——一列是一個實體尺碼，四種標示法只是它的四個名字，所以每一制各存一份尺碼欄、量測值四制共用。沿用 .tabs --count-plain，計數位置借來標「這一制還有幾格沒填」；.tabs 預設的下外距在這裡歸零，間距由下方的說明句承接。

.sce-block__head（2026-08-20 · D212）＝子塊抬頭：左標題＋說明、右邊放屬於這張表的控制項。唯一用例是尺寸表右上的量測單位——公分與英吋是絕對換算，切換是換一種看法、不是另外填一份資料，所以歸這張表管。換算以公分為真值（cell.dataset.cm）、畫面依單位算出來顯示到小數一位；不拿畫面數字反覆相乘（來回切兩次就會漂掉）。尺碼制不適用：各國尺碼是慣例對照不是公式，它留在上面當設定列。

.sce-block（2026-08-20 由 store-settings.css 的 .ss-spec-block 搬來改名）＝編輯器裡各子塊之間的呼吸：上下 20px ＋ 一條 --border-soft 上分隔線，不各自畫框；彈窗裡第一個子塊不畫上線。

指南切換（2026-08-21 · D216）：帶 opts.guides 開進來時，彈窗頂端多一列「看哪一份」（下拉 .select ＋ .sg-picker__select——指南份數會長，segmented 撐不住），每一份的整份表單各自快照、換回來原封不動；該模式下名稱欄不出現。從商店設定點單一份進來時不帶 guides，行為不變。

編輯器是共用 partial（partials/size-guide-modal.js，2026-08-20 · D211）：window.ztorSizeGuide.open({ titleKey, showName, blank, name, nameKey, onSave })。showName:false ＝商品專屬那份不問名字。增刪列／欄、--sce-cols 同步與 aria-label 同步都在這支裡，兩頁不各寫一份。

ds-components/size-chart-editor.css。消費頁：store-settings.html（spec 5.1.5.5 F7.2 · D171——商店的尺寸指南）與 create-product.html（spec 5.1.5.2 §4.1 F2 · D211——這件商品專屬的一份）；每次開啟含尺寸表與身高體重參考各一個實例，後者欄固定、不掛欄刪除鈕。

.source-gate（靠左對齊，閘門殼 .wizard__gate-inner 預設置中）> __head（返回鍵＋__titles 同一列）· 搜尋框與結果為 Owner lookup 的 .owner-lookup ＞ .input[role=combobox] ＋ .owner-lookup__results · __acts（略過／帶入，靠右）。選配 .source-import ＞ .select：帶入後在表單頂端顯示的唯讀欄位列。

2026-08-10（使用者指示）結果清單改用 Owner lookup 下拉。原本是把結果常駐攤在頁面上的 .radio-cards--gate.radio-cards--list 清單。改的兩個理由：①站上已經有一個「打字找一筆、下拉挑一個」的元件——creators 的帳號查找、Admin IP Bank 的權利人、陣容藝人搜尋都是它，這一關沒有理由長成第二種樣子；②常駐清單一進場就先給五筆要讀完才知道自己在做什麼決定，聚焦才展開才是搜尋該有的節奏。聚焦時整份列出、不套用輸入框裡的關鍵字——選過之後框裡放的是那一場的名稱，拿它當關鍵字會只剩一列，等於看不到其他選項。已選中的那一列在重開的清單裡以 aria-selected="true" 標出。連帶：.source-gate__empty（無結果說明文字）撤除，那句話改畫在下拉裡的 .owner-lookup__result--empty；.radio-cards--list 因此失去消費頁（同日一度被建立活動的「要怎麼建這些門票？」選擇彈窗接手，隨後使用者指示那個彈窗改回並排兩欄），列為退場候選、待裁決。

已經帶過的那一場：列出來但選不了（2026-08-13，使用者指示）——同一場 bookyay 活動在 ztor 上只會存在一次，帶過就不能再帶。清單裡仍然列出它、<button> 上加 disabled ＋ aria-disabled（灰掉的樣式由 owner-lookup.css 的 [disabled] 接手，不必另外加 class），右邊掛一顆 .badge.badge--neutral.owner-lookup__flag「已匯入」說明為什麼點不動。刻意不從結果裡濾掉——使用者搜尋的目的常常正是「確認這場我是不是已經建過了」，濾掉會回答成「找不到相符的活動」，那是錯的訊息。

帶入後直接落在「票務商品」那一步（2026-08-13，使用者指示）——帶入之後的基本資料、場次、票種、票務四步整份由 bookyay 決定、也整份鎖住，一步一步按過去等於翻四頁唯讀畫面；票務商品是帶入後第一件真的要創作者決定的事，落點就放這裡。被跳過的四步在進度列上照樣標「已完成」（進度列以「編號小於當前步」判定完成，不必另外記帳），要回頭看內容也照樣點得進去。

返回鍵對齊標題（2026-08-10 第三輪，使用者反饋「這兩個要對齊」）——__head 原本 align-items: center，返回鍵與「標題＋副標」整個標題群置中對齊；但標題群兩行疊起來共 63px（標題行高 42px＋副標行高 21px），置中只會把返回鍵放到這 63px 的正中央，比標題自己的中心低 10.5px，看起來偏低。改成 align-items: flex-start，再用 margin-top: 3px 把返回鍵的中心精準推到標題那一行的中心：(標題行高 42px − 返回鍵直徑 36px) ÷ 2。

ds-components/source-import.css。消費頁：create-event.html（bookyay 帶入閘門，場地資料）。

4.121 Field source tag

🟢 atom

Purpose

用途

Marks "where did this field come from" next to a field label (imported from bookyay, can't be edited here), and keeps a locked field readable — it's not broken, it's "managed elsewhere": slightly lower contrast, cursor switches to not-allowed. Promoted 2026-08-09 from create-event.html's page-local .ce-src / .is-locked.

欄位標籤旁標記「這一格是從哪裡帶進來的」（bookyay 帶入後不可改），並讓被鎖定的欄位維持可讀——不是「壞掉」而是「別處管的」，只降一點對比、游標改不可編輯。2026-08-09 自 create-event.html 的頁內 .ce-src / .is-locked promote。

Relationships

元件關係

Used by被哪些元件使用 ↑
Consumed inside Source import's post-import form fields; not a standalone control用於 Source import 帶入後的表單欄位內，非獨立控件

Rendered preview

視覺展示

Locked on a Radio card group (.is-source-locked on a .segmented.radio-cards — 2026-08-09: same lock, non-form-control target; see the code tab)

鎖定在 Radio card 群組上 (.is-source-locked 掛在 .segmented.radio-cards 上——2026-08-09：同一套鎖定，作用對象不是表單控件；見下方 code 分頁)

Locked ≠ broken. The locked field drops its fill entirely — it takes whatever surface it sits on, so it never reads as a darker "something went wrong" box inside a card — and its value steps down to --locked-field-ink. Only the 1px border marks where the field is. Compare with the editable field below it: filled surface, full-strength value. Two rounds, both 2026-08-09: first this component defined that transparent look for itself (overriding the then---muted-filled component baseline); then, once the user decided "the whole component library gets exactly one disabled look," that same transparent look was promoted up into input.css's .input:disabled as the sitewide baseline — so this file no longer defines a lock appearance of its own (see the code tab below).

鎖住不等於壞掉。鎖定欄位整個拿掉填底——直接吃它所坐的那個面，所以不會在卡片裡變成一塊更深的「這裡壞了」方塊——值的顏色降到 --locked-field-ink，只留 1px 邊界標示這一格的範圍。跟下面那個可編輯欄位對照：有填底、值是全強度。兩輪修訂，皆 2026-08-09：第一輪本檔自己定義這組透明底樣式（蓋過當時 --muted 填底的元件層基準）；第二輪使用者裁示「整個元件庫只能有一個 disabled 樣子」後，同一組透明底值被上收進 input.css 的 .input:disabled 成為全站基準——本檔因此不再自己定義鎖定外觀（見下方給工程師的 code 分頁）。

.is-source-locked, not .is-locked — that name is already used by Media vault for a completely different meaning (a graded tier locked in viewer mode: dimmed + grayscale + a lock icon). Neither name is namespaced, so if both components ever serve the same page, whichever loads last would silently win. "Source-locked" and "permission-locked" are two different ideas and each needs a name the other can't overwrite.

命名刻意用 .is-source-locked、不用 .is-locked——那個名字已被 Media vault 用在完全不同的語意（檢視器模式下某分級整列打不開：變暗＋灰階＋鎖頭）。兩者都不在自己的命名空間裡，若同頁兩支元件同時服役，載入順序會決定誰的 .is-locked 生效。「來源鎖定」與「權限鎖定」是兩回事，各自要留一個不會被對方覆寫的名字。

.field-source（掛在 .field__label 內、靠右對齊；.field__label:has(.field-source) 才開 flex，避免壓掉一般欄名裡刻意留的空白）· .is-source-locked（掛在欄位容器；本身不再定義表單控件的鎖定樣式，2026-08-09 第二輪——內部的 .input／.textarea／.select 完全吃 Input 的 .input:disabled（透明底＋--locked-field-ink）；.segmented__btn（Radio card 建在它上面）不是表單控件、吃不到 :disabled，鎖定樣式仍由本檔定義——cursor:not-allowed ＋ pointer-events:none）。

第三輪（2026-08-09，同日）：.segmented__btn 這條原本還留著舊制的 opacity:.78，等於同一頁同時存在「表單控件用顏色降對比」與「segmented 用透明度降對比」兩種鎖定語彙。改成同一套做法：opacity 拿掉，改讓 .radio-card__title / .radio-card__sub 直接吃 --locked-field-ink（不疊 opacity），卡面其餘部分（邊框、底色）不降對比——鎖定的是「內容不可改」，不是「整張卡消失」，與 Upload tile 已填態撤除綠框同一個方向：站上「不可改／已完成」一律靠顏色或邊框樣式表達，不疊 opacity 弱化整塊。pointer-events:none 維持，滑鼠仍點不動。

權重注意（第一輪的舊寫法，現已不適用）：本檔第一輪曾把鎖定態寫成 .is-source-locked .input:disabled（0-3-0）去蓋過元件層同權重的 .input:disabled（0-2-0）。第二輪把值上收進元件層之後，兩者變成同一份規則，本檔不再需要用權重蓋過誰。

4.203 Roster picker

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

Pick above, work below. A card per subject across the top, the selected one's content underneath at full content width. The layout for cross-subject workbenches: you have to see everyone before it makes sense to pick one to work on. Built 2026-09-02 for Event import (spec 5.1.0.6 · D233); rewritten and renamed the same day from the morning's two-column shell, on the user's call ("creator picker on top, event list below" / "creators as cards laid out across").

上面選人、下面看那一位。上段是一張卡一個對象、橫著排；下段是選定那一位的內容，佔整個內容寬度。跨對象工作台的版型：先看得到全部，才談得上選一個來處理。2026-09-02 為創作者活動管理頁（spec 5.1.0.6 · D233）建，同日依使用者裁示（「creator 選擇在上、活動列表在下」「creator 改成一張一張卡片橫著排列」）從上午那一版的兩欄殼整支改寫並改名。

Which shell? If the picker chooses which section of the same thing → Section nav (140px, short labels). If it chooses which subject, and each subject carries an avatar, a name and a few progress figures → this one. That much does not fit a 140px rail, and reads better laid out across as cards than squeezed into a narrow list row.

該用哪一支殼？要選的是「同一個東西的哪一段」→ Section nav（140px、短標籤）；要選的是「哪一個對象」、而且每個對象要帶頭像、名稱與幾個進度數字 → 本支。那些塞不進 140px 的側欄，橫著排成卡片也比擠成一條窄列好讀。

The selected state is borrowed, not redrawn. Each card also carries Selection card, so the surface, radius, shadow, hover and selected state all come from there: selected = a 1px orange outline with a neutral shadow. This component writes no --active rule of its own.

已選態是借的，不是新畫一種。卡片本體同時掛 Selection card，卡面、圓角、陰影、hover 與已選態全部來自那一支：已選＝1px 橘色 outline ＋中性陰影。本支不寫任何自己的 --active 規則。

.roster-pickerVertical flex, gap: --sp-24 — the picker section on top, the body below. Rhythm is held by the container, never by a member's own margin (DS §2.3 / STYLE-DECISIONS Q103).直排 flex、gap: --sp-24——上段選人、下段內容。節奏由容器持有，不由成員自帶 margin（DS §2.3／STYLE-DECISIONS Q103）。
.roster-picker__gridrepeat(auto-fill, minmax(260px, 1fr)). auto-fill, not auto-fit: auto-fit collapses the empty tracks, so a three-person roster stretches into three page-wide banners. auto-fill keeps them, the cards stay card-sized and the set stays left-aligned. 260px is what "32px avatar + name + two label columns" needs (the longest English pair measures 119px); narrow screens drop to a single column on their own.repeat(auto-fill, minmax(260px, 1fr))。用 auto-fill 不是 auto-fit：auto-fit 會把空軌道收掉，只有三位時三張卡各自撐成頁寬的橫幅；auto-fill 保留空軌道，卡維持在一張卡該有的寬度、整組靠左排。260px＝「32px 頭像 ＋ 名稱 ＋ 兩欄小標籤」放得下（英文最長那一組實測要 119px）；窄畫面自然掉成一欄。
.roster-picker__cardCarried together with .selection-card — that one owns the surface, radius, shadow, hover and the selected outline; this class only lays out the two columns and two lines inside. No --active rule is written here, so "a selectable card is selected" keeps a single answer site-wide.與 .selection-card 同時掛——卡面、圓角、陰影、hover 與已選 outline 都歸那一支，本 class 只排卡內的兩欄兩列。這裡不寫 --active，「可選取的卡被選中」站上維持單一答案。
.roster-picker__card-media · __card-text · __card-nameThe card is two columns: a 32px identity circle on the left, and on the right two stacked lines — name, then the status line. The card sets flex-direction: row over .selection-card's default column, and trims the vertical padding from 14 to 12 (with only two lines, 14 leaves them floating in a band of empty space); the horizontal 16 stays, matching every other selection card on the site. The name deliberately does not carry .selection-card__title: site-wide that class sits in the shared.css "titles are set in caps" list, and this is a person's name — data, not a section heading. Caps would shout "DENISE LONELY" and stop matching the same name in the head row below.卡是兩欄：左邊 32px 識別圓，右邊上下兩列——名稱，然後狀態列。卡把 .selection-card 預設的直排改成 flex-direction: row，並把上下內距由 14 收成 12（只剩兩列，14 會讓那兩列浮在一格空白的中間）；左右維持 16，與站上其他 selection-card 一致。名稱刻意不掛 .selection-card__title：站上那一支歸在 shared.css 的「標題一律大寫」名單裡，而這裡放的是一個人的名字（資料，不是區段標題），大寫會把 Denise Lonely 喊成 DENISE LONELY，也跟下段標題列的同一個名字對不上。
.roster-picker__card-status · __card-statsOne slot, two possible occupants. Linked → the figures, presented entirely by Stat row's --inline variant (the markup carries both classes), filling the line so every card divides it the same way and the values land on one vertical line. Not linked → a "Not linked" badge in that same slot, and no event figures at all: with no bookyay account there is no to-import / imported / to-set-up to speak of, and printing three zeros reads as "we looked, and the answer was zero". The badge sits exactly where the figures would be, so it explains the emptiness in place. Linked cards carry no "Linked" chip — figures already say the account is connected, one on every card is noise, and a 260px card minus a 58px chip leaves 119px for two columns while the English label "Imported" alone wants 50px, clipping it to "Import…". The figures are deliberately not drawn as a segmented bar or a donut: they are not parts of one whole (to import + imported = the pool; to set up is a subset of imported), and either would claim a total that does not exist.一個位置、二選一。已綁定→放數字，呈現整個交給 Stat row 的 --inline 變體（markup 同時掛兩個 class），吃滿整列，每張卡的分法一樣、值因此落在同一條垂直線上。未綁定→同一個位置改放「未綁定」徽章，並且一個場次數字都不印：沒綁 bookyay 帳號就沒有可匯入／已匯入／待設定這回事，印三個 0 會被讀成「查過了、結果是零」；徽章佔的正是數字的位置，就地說明這裡為什麼是空的。已綁定的卡不另掛「已綁定」徽章——有數字就代表帳號通了，一排卡每張都掛一顆是噪音；而且 260px 的卡扣掉 58px 的徽章只剩 119px 給兩欄，光是英文欄名「Imported」就要 50px，會被截成「Import…」。刻意不畫成分段進度條或圓餅：這幾個數字不是同一個整體的幾份（可匯入＋已匯入＝池總數，待設定是已匯入的子集），那兩種畫法會宣稱一個不存在的整體。
.roster-picker__body · __detailBoth are vertical flex at --sp-16, and both get an explicit [hidden] { display: none } — a class that writes display otherwise overrides [hidden], and __detail is toggled from JS.兩支都是 --sp-16 的直排 flex，並各自補一條 [hidden] { display: none }——class 寫了 display 會蓋掉 [hidden]，而 __detail 正是 JS 切顯隱的那一段。
.roster-picker__headThe selected subject's title row — name and figures on the left, the actions on the right; wraps on narrow screens.選定者的標題列——名稱與數字在左、動作在右；窄畫面自動換行。
.roster-picker__head-actions · __head-syncThe action group carries its own [hidden] { display: none }, because what belongs there is often specific to the selected subject (on Creator events an unlinked creator has no source to check, so the whole group goes). __head-sync is a line of status text that sits inside that group, ahead of the button — "Last checked 2026-09-02 09:40" next to "Check again". Keeping the two together is the point: they are two halves of one thing (when it last happened / do it again), and put on opposite ends of a wide title row they stop reading as a pair. Same quiet-text vocabulary as __head-meta — 13px, --muted-foreground, tabular figures.動作組自帶 [hidden] { display: none }：擺在那裡的東西常常是「這個對象才有」的（創作者活動管理頁上，未綁定的 creator 沒有可檢查的來源，整組收起來）。__head-sync 是**放在這一組裡面**、按鈕前面的一行狀態字——「最後檢查 2026-09-02 09:40」接著「重新檢查」。放在一起是重點：這兩個是同一件事的兩半（上次什麼時候發生／把它再做一次），分置寬標題列的兩端就讀不成一組了。文字語彙與 __head-meta 同一套：13px、--muted-foreground、等寬數字。

ds-components/roster-picker.css

4.204 Row disclosure

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

One list item is really several: the parent collapses to a single row, and the rows underneath appear only when it is opened. This is the site's single answer for that role. Until 2026-09-03 there were two implementations of it — product-list's __row--group/--child for table-shaped lists and data-list's __row--child for list-shaped ones — and STYLE-DECISIONS Q107 replaced both with this component. Rebuilt 2026-09-04 into the "L3 — whole group changes plane" model: hierarchy is no longer said with indent and a left hairline, but with which plane the whole group sits on. Collapsed, a row looks like any other row on the same L1 card face; expanded, the parent and its children are wrapped together into one L2 film panel, and child columns line up with the header pixel-for-pixel — zero indent.

一筆清單項目其實是好幾筆：母列收成一列，底下每一筆點開才出現。站上「可展開子列」的單一答案。2026-09-03 之前這件事有兩份實作——表格型清單用 product-list 的 __row--group／--child、清單型用 data-list 的 __row--child——STYLE-DECISIONS Q107 裁決後由本支取代兩者。2026-09-04 改寫成「L3 整組換層」模型：階層不再靠縮排與左緣線說，改由「這一組坐在哪一層平面」說。收合時整列與其他資料列同層（L1 卡面）；展開時母列與它的子項一起被包進一塊 L2 薄膜面板，子項欄位與表頭嚴格對齊、零縮排。

It owns the disclosure and the plane, not the columns. Three things belong to it: where the handle sits and which way it turns, the aria-expanded state, and which plane the group sits on once expanded (same plane while collapsed, an L2 film panel while open, a 1px frame for the second layer). Column widths and cell contents stay with the container it is laid over — the .product-list__row grid, or .data-list__row-main / __amount. That is why it is a layer of classes carried alongside a container row rather than a list of its own.

它擁有揭露與那塊面，不擁有欄位。歸它的三件事：把手的位置與轉向、aria-expanded 狀態、以及「這一組展開時坐在哪一層面」（收合同層、展開後的 L2 薄膜面板、第二層的 1px 框）。欄寬與每一格的內容仍歸它疊上去的那個容器——.product-list__row 的 grid 欄，或 .data-list__row-main／__amount。所以它是與容器列同時掛的一層 class，不是另一種清單。

Expand at the leading edge, ⋯ at the trailing edge. Since 2026-09-04 (Q109) the disclosure handle sits in its own narrow lead column at the very start of the row, and the actions menu stays at the very end — the two controls hold the two ends and never sit next to each other. Child rows put their number within the group in that same cell; rows with no group leave it empty. Every row in a table has the column, header included. The decision followed eight web examples on Mobbin (Midday, Evernote, Xero, Salesforce, Braintrust, ClickUp, Asana, Zoho CRM), with Braintrust named as the reference. List-shaped consumers keep their handles where they are — see the note under the second demo.

展開在最前緣、⋯ 在最末端。2026-09-04（Q109）起，揭露把手站在列最前緣一個獨立的窄欄，動作選單維持在列的最末端——兩個控制項分踞兩端，從不相鄰。子列在同一格放它在該組內的序號，沒有群組的一般列留空；同一張表裡每一列都有這一欄，表頭也算一列。裁決依據是 Mobbin 上八個 web 實例（Midday、Evernote、Xero、Salesforce、Braintrust、ClickUp、Asana、Zoho CRM），指名參考 Braintrust。清單型的消費頁維持把手現況，理由見第二個 demo 下方的說明。

Zero indent, columns aligned. .rowdis__group wraps the parent row and its children; collapsed it carries no styling, expanded (detected via :has() on an inner handle's aria-expanded="true") it becomes the L2 film panel — --ztu-film fill, a 1px --border-soft ring drawn with an inset box-shadow (a real border would join the grid's column sizing and knock parent and child 1px out of alignment), --radius-lg corners, row hairlines inside the panel turned transparent. List-shaped containers add --gutter (their rows carry no side padding of their own, so the panel needs a negative margin plus matching padding to grow outward without moving the columns); table-shaped containers skip it — .product-list__row already carries side padding, so the panel edge lines up with the row edge as-is. A second layer (order-detail's item → bundle member → member's own pickup units) uses .rowdis__frame instead of a third fill, per the existing rule in ds-components/nest.css: at most two plane fills (L1 card, L2 film), anything past that is a 1px border.

零縮排、欄位對齊。.rowdis__group 包住母列與它的子項；收合無樣式，展開時（用 :has() 偵測內部把手 aria-expanded="true"）成為 L2 薄膜面板——--ztu-film 底、一圈 inset box-shadow 畫的 1px --border-soft（用 box-shadow 而不是真的 border，是因為 border 會參與 grid 欄寬計算，母列與面板外的資料列會因此差 1px、欄位對不齊）、--radius-lg 圓角，面板內部的列底線轉透明。清單型容器要加 --gutter（列本身沒有左右內距，靠負外距＋等值內距讓面板往外長、欄位起點不動）；表格型容器不加——.product-list__row 本來就有左右內距，面板邊緣與資料列外緣重合就是對的。第二層（order-detail 的品項 → 組合成員 → 成員自己的領取單位）改用 .rowdis__frame、不再疊第三層填色，依 ds-components/nest.css 的既有規則：填色最多兩層（L1 卡片、L2 薄膜），第三層以後改用 1px 邊框。

表格型容器裡（.product-list）——整列可點，不加 --gutter。預設展開；標亮那列常駐模擬 :hover（面板內 H1＋H4），不必真的移過去，方便跟上面那列素面對照。

清單型容器裡（.data-list）——只有把手可點、加 --gutter，示範兩層（第二層是 .rowdis__frame 的 1px 框，不疊第三層填色）

No lead column here (2026-09-04 call). A list-shaped row has no column grid and no header to align to; and this demo shows the two-layer case, where the member row is both a child of layer one (wants a number) and the parent of the layer-two frame (wants a handle) — one lead cell cannot hold both. The three list-shaped consumers keep their handles where they are: order-detail for the reason just given, project-detail because its lead is already the ＋／−／＝ marker chip and the handle reads better next to the amount it expands, scanner because its roster is --static and has no handle to move.

這裡不套列首欄（2026-09-04 判斷）。清單型的列不是欄格線結構，也沒有表頭可對齊；而且這個 demo 正是兩層的情況——成員那一列同時是第一層的子列（該有序號）與第二層框的母列（該有把手），一個列首格放不下兩種角色。三個清單型消費頁因此維持把手現況：order-detail 是剛才這個理由，project-detail 的列首已經是 ＋／−／＝ 的記號晶片、把手貼著金額擺才讀得出「這個數字展開成它的組成」，scanner 的名單是 --static 唯讀恆亮、根本沒有把手可搬。

In context — how a group list behaves once filtering and search are laid over it (children follow the parent through the filter, and a search opens every group) is a composition rule, not this component's: see 5.1.3 Filter + list.

實際情境——分組清單再疊上篩選與搜尋之後的行為（子列跟著母列過篩選、搜尋中一律攤開）是組合規則，不歸本元件：見 5.1.3 Filter + list。

For developers — classes · API · code給工程師 — class · API · 程式碼
.rowdis__groupThe group wrapper — parent row + its children live inside it. Collapsed it carries no styling (same plane as any other row); expanded (a :has() check on an inner handle's aria-expanded="true") it becomes the L2 film panel: --ztu-film fill, a 1px --border-soft ring drawn with inset box-shadow (not a real border — that would join the grid's column sizing and knock the row 1px out of alignment), --radius-lg corners, row hairlines inside turned transparent.群組容器——母列＋它的子項都在裡面。收合無樣式（與其他資料列同層）；展開時（`:has()` 偵測內部把手 aria-expanded="true"）成為 L2 薄膜面板：--ztu-film 底、一圈 inset box-shadow 畫的 1px --border-soft（不用真的 border——那會參與 grid 欄寬計算，把列擠出 1px）、--radius-lg 圓角，面板內部的列底線轉透明。
.rowdis__group--gutterAdd on list-shaped containers. .data-list__row carries no side padding of its own, so the panel needs a negative margin plus matching padding to grow outward without moving the row's x-position. Table-shaped containers skip it — .product-list__row already carries side padding.清單型容器要加。.data-list__row 本身沒有左右內距，靠負外距＋等值內距讓面板往外長，列的 x 位置不動。表格型不加——.product-list__row 自己就有左右內距。
.rowdis__group--staticFor read-only groups (scanner's F3 roster): the panel stays lit regardless of any handle's aria-expanded — there is nothing to expand, but "these units belong to this buyer" still needs the same clarity as an expandable group.唯讀群組用（scanner 的 F3 名單）：面板恆亮，不看任何把手的 aria-expanded——沒有東西可展開，但「這幾件屬於同一買家」要跟可展開的清單一樣清楚。
.rowdis__headThe parent row, carried alongside the container's own row class, and must be a direct child of .rowdis__group (the selector reads :has(> .rowdis__head …)). It only takes a pointer cursor when it also carries data-rowdis-row (whole row toggles); where only the handle toggles, the cursor belongs to the button.母列，與容器自己的列 class 同時掛，且必須是 .rowdis__group 的直接子節點（選擇器寫成 :has(> .rowdis__head …)）。只有同時帶 data-rowdis-row（整列可點）時才給手指游標；只有把手可點的用法，游標歸按鈕本身。
.rowdis__leadThe lead cell (2026-09-04, Q109, Braintrust as the named reference). A narrow cell at the very start of the row, --rowdis-lead-w wide (--sp-28, the exact side of a .btn--icon.btn--xs). Parent rows put the handle here; child rows put their number within the group; ungrouped rows leave it empty. It is part of the column layout, not something groups grow — the header takes one too, or header and body rows sit one column apart.列首欄（2026-09-04 · Q109，指名參考 Braintrust）。列最前緣的一個窄格，寬 --rowdis-lead-w（--sp-28，正好是 .btn--icon.btn--xs 的邊長）。母列在這裡放把手、子列放它在該組內的序號、沒有群組的一般列留空。它是欄位版面的一部分，不是「有分組才長出來」的東西——表頭也要跟著多一欄，否則表頭與資料列會差一格。
.rowdis__numThe child row's number inside .rowdis__lead, counted from 1 within its own group. Plain text, never focusable — the only control in this column is the parent row's handle. --fs-12 / --column-head-ink / tabular numerals, i.e. the same weight as a column header: it is a marker, not a value competing with the row's data.子列在 .rowdis__lead 裡的序號，於該組內從 1 起算。純文字、永遠不可聚焦——這一欄唯一的控制項是母列的把手。--fs-12／--column-head-ink／等寬數字，跟表頭欄名同一個份量：它是編號，不是跟同列的值搶注意力的內容。
.rowdis__labelNo longer used by any product page (since 2026-09-04). It used to be the cell where the handle sat next to a single-line truncating title. With the handle moved to .rowdis__lead, the title cell has nothing beside it to protect from truncation, so all five consumers and this page dropped it. The rule survives only for the frozen exploration page lab-row-hover.html; it retires with that batch. Do not use it in new pages.2026-09-04 起正式頁面已不消費。它原本是把手與「單行截斷的標題」並排的那一格。把手改站 .rowdis__lead 之後，標題格裡沒有要防截斷的並排元素，五個消費頁與本頁 demo 都已移除。CSS 規則留著只為了凍結保存的探索頁 lab-row-hover.html，跟那批一起退場。新頁面不要再用它。
.rowdis__toggleThe handle. Looks are borrowed from Button (.btn--icon, size chosen by the page); this component only adds "does not shrink" and "turns 180° on aria-expanded". State lives on the button, because the button is the focusable, keyboard-operable element — Enter and Space come free from a native <button>.把手。外觀借 Button（.btn--icon，尺寸由頁面決定），本支只加「不被壓縮」與「隨 aria-expanded 轉 180°」。狀態放在按鈕上——它才是可聚焦、可用鍵盤操作的那個元素，Enter 與 Space 由原生 <button> 免費提供。
.rowdis__childThe child row: zero indent (columns line up with the header pixel-for-pixel — hierarchy is said by the plane, not by position), type and text colour one step quieter. It also carries its own [hidden] { display: none }, because the container writes display: grid.子列：零縮排（欄位與表頭嚴格對齊，階層由那塊面說、不是位置），字級與文字色退一階。並自帶 [hidden] { display: none }，因為容器寫了 display: grid。
.rowdis__child--compactThe list-shaped container's density: tighter vertical padding only. ⚠ It no longer owns hierarchy — row rules and the group's closing line are now the group panel's job, not this variant's.清單型容器的密度：只收窄上下留白。⚠ 它不再管階層——列線與組尾線都已改由群組那塊面承擔，不是它的職責。
.rowdis__frameThe second layer's frame (order-detail's item → bundle member → member's own pickup units). A 1px --border instead of a third plane fill, per the existing rule in ds-components/nest.css: at most two fills (L1 card, L2 film), anything past that is a border. Same negative-margin-plus-padding trick as --gutter so the frame sits slightly wider than its rows without moving their x-position.第二層的框（order-detail 的品項 → 組合成員 → 成員自己的領取單位）。1px --border，不疊第三層填色，依 ds-components/nest.css 的既有規則：填色最多兩層（L1 卡片、L2 薄膜），第三層以後改用邊框。同 --gutter 的負外距＋內距手法，讓框比裡面的列寬一點、列的 x 位置不動。

JS module — js/row-disclosure.jsJS 模組 — js/row-disclosure.js

Data-attribute contract: Data-attribute 契約：data-rowdis="<gid>" on the handle (a real <button>, with aria-expanded)掛在把手上（必須是 <button>，自帶 aria-expanded） · data-rowdis-child="<gid>" on each child row (initial state from the markup's hidden)掛在每一條子列（初始態由 markup 的 hidden 決定） · data-rowdis-row (optional) on the parent row to make the whole row a toggle target; links, menus and other buttons inside it are let through.（選配）掛在母列＝整列可點；列內的連結、選單與其他按鈕一律放行。

window.rowDisclosure.init(root, { onToggle }) registers a container (and its callback, for pages where being open is only one of several visibility conditions — the pickup roster also filters by status and search)登記一個容器與 callback，給「展開只是可見性其中一個條件」的頁面用（取貨名單還要疊狀態篩選與搜尋） · set(head, open) · toggle(head) · sync(root) · isOpen(head). Clicks run through one document-level delegate, so dynamically rendered rows need no rebinding and init() never adds a second listener.點擊走 document 級單一委派，動態渲染的列不必重新綁定，init() 也不會再加第二顆監聽器。

4.205 Listing controls

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

Whether fans can buy a thing, whether they can find it, and whether they can buy it right now are three separate questions. Spec §7.14 (D241) made them three independent switches — listed, shown in shop, on sale — and this component is the three rows they live in. Before D241 the same card was called "Listing settings" and one word ("上架") carried both "is it published" and "can you browse to it"; the two are now split.

「有沒有上架」「在網站上找不找得到」「能不能購買和結帳」是三件不同的事。規格 §7.14（D241）把它們定成三個互相獨立的開關——上架、顯示於商店、開賣——本元件就是那三列的骨架。D241 之前這張卡叫「上架設定」，「上架」一個詞同時背了「發布了沒」與「在網站上找不找得到」，現在拆開。

Show in shop sits outside the second layer (2026-09-04 · D247). .lctl__derived holds the schedule of listing — when it goes up, when it comes down. Whether people can find it is a different question that only arises once it is listed, so it gets its own bordered row (control-row, or control-group where hiding has to reveal a private link). It disappears together with the second layer when nothing is listed.

Two sections, two layers each (2026-09-04 · D245). The three switches are independent in the spec, but for a creator they are two decisions taken at two different moments: “does this appear in the shop, and when” is now; “when can people check out” comes after. So the block is split into Listing and Sale, and each section keeps exactly one main decision on the first layer with everything it implies tucked into .lctl__derived below it. On a create page “Don’t list” means draft — the second layer and the whole Sale section disappear. On a detail page the second layer stays put when unlisted: the private link is greyed out rather than removed, because it still exists, it just does not work right now.

It owns the rows, not the controls. Title + one line of explanation, where the control sits, when the schedule fields open, and the distance between the three rows — that is all. The controls themselves are reused as-is: Switch, Radio list (--collapsible), Field + Input, Link field. Which control the listing row uses is the page's call: create flows keep the collapsible three-way (don't list / list now / schedule — at creation time "whether" and "when" are one decision), detail pages use a switch (the thing already exists; all that is left is on or off).

顯示於商店不在第 2 層裡，而且排在它上面（2026-09-04 · D247，同日修訂）。第 2 層 .lctl__derived 裝的是「上架這件事的排程」——什麼時候上、什麼時候下。找不找得到是東西一上架就存在的另一個問題，所以它緊接在主決定後面（中間一條 .lctl__rule），排程盒排在它下面。這一列不給自己的外框（就是一條 .lctl__row）：有框會讀成「兩個對等的盒子」，實際上它只是一列開關；隱藏時要長出的非公開連結或說明用列自己的 .lctl__body。上架沒成立時它與第 2 層一起收起。

兩個 section、每個 section 兩層（2026-09-04 · D245）。三個開關在規格上互相獨立沒錯，對創作者卻是兩個不同時間點的決定：「這件東西要不要、什麼時候出現在商店」是現在的事，「什麼時候可以結帳」是出現之後的事。所以拆成上架設定與開賣設定，每個 section 的第一層只留一個主決定，由它推導出來的設定收進下方的 .lctl__derived。建立頁選「不上架」＝草稿，第 2 層與整個開賣設定一併不出現；細節頁下架時第 2 層不收起——非公開連結灰化而不是消失，因為它還在，只是現在沒有用。

它擁有列，不擁有控制。標題＋一行說明的排法、控制擺在哪、排程欄何時展開、三列之間的距離——就這些。控制本身原樣重用：Switch、Radio list（--collapsible）、Field＋Input、Link field。上架列用哪一種由頁面決定：建立頁沿用收合式三選一（不上架／立刻上架／定時上架——建立時「要不要」與「什麼時候」是同一個決定），細節頁改用開關（東西已經存在，只剩開著還是關著）。

.lctlThe three-row container. It holds the vertical rhythm in its own gap (--sp-24) — never .lctl__row + .lctl__row, per STYLE-DECISIONS Q103. It also zeroes .field's own bottom margin so the two do not stack into a double gap.三列的容器。垂直節奏放在自己的 gap（--sp-24），不用 .lctl__row + .lctl__row（STYLE-DECISIONS Q103）。同時把列內 .field 的下邊距歸零，免得與 gap 疊成兩段距離。

.lctl__head · __titles · __title · __hintTitle and its one line of explanation on the left, the row's control on the right. __hint is deliberately identical to .field__hint in size and colour — it is the same role ("what else do I need to know about this row"), so it must not become a second style for supporting text.左邊是標題與一行說明，右邊是這一列的控制。__hint 刻意與 .field__hint 同字級同色——那是同一個角色（這一列還要注意什麼），不該變成第二種輔助說明樣式。

.lctl__bodyA full-width control under the head — the collapsible radio list, or the Link field that opens when "show in shop" is turned off. Carries its own [hidden].擺在 head 底下的整列寬控制——收合式 radio-list，或關掉「顯示於商店」時展開的 Link field。自帶 [hidden]。
.lctl__sched · __gridThe schedule fields. __sched carries its own [hidden] so a collapsed row takes no space; __grid puts two datetime fields side by side and drops to one column under 720px. Add .lctl--stack on the container where the column is narrow by design (the create flow's 264px preview rail) rather than guessing from the viewport.排程欄。__sched 自帶 [hidden]，收起時不佔位；__grid 讓兩個時間欄並排，720px 以下收成一欄。欄本來就窄的情境（建立流程 264px 的預覽欄）在容器掛 .lctl--stack 明說，不靠猜視窗寬度。
.lctl__ruleThe hairline between the main decision and the second layer (2026-09-04). It runs to the card's inner edge (negative inline margins cancel the parent's --card-pad) because it separates the two halves of the section, not the second layer's own box — a border-top on that box would stop at its rounded frame.主決定與第 2 層之間的髮絲線（2026-09-04）。用負左右外距抵銷母卡的 --card-pad、畫到卡的內緣——它分的是這個區塊的兩段，不是第 2 層那個盒子自己的邊；在盒子上加 border-top 只會停在它的圓角框裡。
.lctl__derivedThe second layer (2026-09-04 · D245): everything that only exists once the main decision is made — listing / unlist time, show in shop, sale window. Whether it has a frame is the consumer's call — add .control-group.control-group--plain for one (2026-09-04: the listing section's second layer has a frame, the sale section's does not). The class itself only owns two things: internal rhythm via gap, and taking the bottom margin back off .field. Markup: <div class="control-group control-group--plain lctl__derived">.第 2 層（2026-09-04 · D245）：主決定成立之後才存在的一組設定——上架與下架時間、顯示於商店、販售窗口。要不要有外框由消費頁決定（加 .control-group.control-group--plain 就有；2026-09-04：上架設定那層有框、開賣設定那層沒有），本類只管兩件事：內部節奏交給 gap、把 .field 的下邊距收回容器。markup：<div class="control-group control-group--plain lctl__derived">。
.lctl__noteOne quiet line for the whole block (currently the time-zone caveat). --faint-ink, so it does not compete with the per-row hints.整區共用的一行淡說明（目前是時區待確認）。吃 --faint-ink，不與各列的 hint 搶注意力。

Product rules it renders它畫的是哪些產品規則 — spec §7.14: unlist time / sale start / sale end are all optional and the form must not pre-fill any of them (a default value decides for the creator); the only validation left is "sale end must be after sale start" (ListingState.validateSaleWindow) — D239's "the sale window must sit inside the listing window" no longer applies to products; a hidden item's private link is generated by ListingState.privateLinkFor() and dies when the item is unlisted.——規格 §7.14：下架日期與時間、開賣日期與時間、停售日期與時間三個都是選填，表單不得預設任何一個（預設值等於替創作者決定）；剩下的校驗只有「停售要晚於開賣」（ListingState.validateSaleWindow）——D239 的「販售窗口必須落在可見性窗口內」對商品已廢除；隱藏時的非公開連結由 ListingState.privateLinkFor() 產生，下架時連同公開連結一起失效。

4.206 Link field

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

A link the system generated, a person cannot edit, and needs to be able to carry away whole. First role: the private link of a hidden product or bundle (spec §7.14) — the creator copies it to someone, or resets it to kill the old one.

一條系統產生、人不能編輯、但要能整條帶走的連結。首個角色是隱藏商品或組合的非公開連結（規格 §7.14）——創作者複製給人，或重置作廢舊的那條。

The feedback lives on the button. "Copied" replaces the button's own label instead of raising a toast: the place your hand just left is the place your eyes are looking, so feedback that flies to a corner of the screen is no feedback. Vault share's .vshare__link is where the site first did this and it stays as it is for now — the vault's link also carries a "just generated" orange frame, which is a different thing from this component's neutral default. Do not copy that markup; when the two are confirmed to be one look, they converge then.

回饋長在按鈕上。「已複製」直接換掉按鈕自己的字，不跳 toast：手剛離開的地方就是眼睛在看的地方，回饋跑到畫面角落等於沒有回饋。Vault share 的 .vshare__link 是站上第一個做這件事的地方，這一輪維持原狀——媒體庫那條連結還多帶「剛產生」的橘框強調，與本支的中性預設不是同一件事。別照抄它的 markup；日後確認兩者要同一個外觀時再收斂。

JS module — js/link-field.jsJS 模組 — js/link-field.js

Data-attribute contract: Data-attribute 契約：data-linkf on the root · 掛在根節點 · data-linkf-copy on the copy button · 掛在複製鈕 · data-linkf-reset on the reset button. Reset does not invent a new URL — it fires linkfield:reset and the page answers, normally with ListingState.resetPrivateLink(entity), then writes the value back with linkField.setValue(root, url).掛在重置鈕。重置不自己決定新連結長什麼樣——它發一顆 linkfield:reset 事件，由頁面回答（通常呼叫 ListingState.resetPrivateLink(entity)），再用 linkField.setValue(root, url) 寫回。

window.linkField.setValue(root, url) · value(root) · copy(root). Clicks run through one document-level delegate, so link rows rendered later need no rebinding. Clipboard writes fall back to an off-screen input + execCommand on non-secure origins.點擊走 document 級單一委派，之後才渲染出來的連結列不必重新綁定。非安全來源沒有 clipboard API 時退回離屏 input ＋ execCommand。

4.207 Stock allocation

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

How one product's inventory pool is split across its sales channels (spec §7.14 · D241). Creating a product creates one atom in the pool and one "single sale" channel; every bundle the product joins is another channel. Any channel can lock N units for itself, and a locked channel does not eat the unlocked stock — so every row needs its own sellable count, not one shared number at the top.

一顆商品的庫存池怎麼分給它的販售管道（規格 §7.14 · D241）。建立商品時池裡建一筆商品、電子商店建一個「單售」販售管道；它加入的每個組合包都是另一個販售管道。任何販售管道都可以從池裡鎖定 N 件給自己，而且鎖定的販售管道不吃沒有被鎖定的庫存量——所以每一列都要有自己的可售量，不是最上面擺一個共用數字。

Two things must always be visible, because they are the rules people get wrong: the per-row sellable count (a locked channel that sold its allocation is sold out even with stock left in the pool), and the warning when every channel is locked — then the unlocked remainder has nobody to sell it, and the row says so with a chip.

兩件事一定要看得到，因為那正是最容易搞錯的規則：逐列的可售量（鎖定的販售管道賣完鎖定量就是售罄，即使池裡還有貨），以及所有販售管道都鎖定時的提醒——那時沒有被鎖定的庫存量沒有人能賣，末列用一顆 chip 講清楚。

The --free row then names which row decided the minimum (stock.capped-by).組合自己的硬上限（限量版本），2026-09-09 新增。它在表裡佔一列，讀法與成員列相同：輸入框在「鎖定量」那一欄，「可售」欄寫出這道上限給得起幾件。擺在表格外面時它讀起來像無關的欄位——設 5、下面顯示 1，看不出關係。末列 --free 接著寫出這個最小值是被誰壓出來的（stock.capped-by）。
--head · --pool · --freeColumn labels, the pool total, and the unlocked remainder. Pool and remainder are separated from the channel rows by a solid --border, because they are the premise and the leftover — not two more channels.欄標題、目前在庫、沒有被鎖定的庫存量。池與沒有被鎖定的庫存量用實線 --border 與販售管道列隔開——它們是前提與剩餘，不是另外兩個販售管道。
.salloc__qtySellable count. Tabular numerals, right aligned: these are read down the column and compared (the bundle's stock is the smallest of them), so they must line up.可售量。等寬數字、靠右：這一欄是要往下掃著比大小的（組合可售量＝取最小值），對不齊就掃不動。
.salloc__chip · .salloc__errorBoth span the full row width on a second line. The chip carries "N unlocked — neither single sale nor bundles can reach them"; the error line carries the over-limit message and matches .field__error in size and colour, because it is the same role.兩者都在第二行橫跨整列。chip 放「N 件未鎖定，沒有販售管道能賣」；錯誤行放超標訊息，字級與顏色比照 .field__error——那是同一個角色。
.salloc__name--thumbName cell carrying the read-only per-combination thumb .variant-thumb--ro before the combination name (2026-09-11 D268; 2026-09-12 Q117: in the cell, not a column). Switches the name cell from stacked to a horizontal row, vertically centred, gap --sp-12. Tracks unchanged.名稱格帶唯讀逐組合縮圖 .variant-thumb--ro、放在組合名前面（2026-09-11 D268；2026-09-12 Q117：併在格內、不另開欄）。名稱格由直排改橫排、垂直置中、間距 --sp-12。欄軌不變。
.salloc--bundleFour columns instead of three: member name, that member's unlocked stock (read-only), the amount locked for this bundle (editable), and what this bundle can therefore sell.四欄而非三欄：成員名、該成員的沒有被鎖定的庫存量（唯讀）、鎖定給本組合的量（可填）、本組合因此能賣幾套。

The numbers come from js/listing-state.js數字全部來自 js/listing-state.js — freeQty(product), channelQty(product, channel), bundleQty(bundle, productsById), allChannelsLocked(product, bundles), and validateLock(product, channel, wanted) for the per-field maximum. Never recompute min(members) or "pool minus locks" in a page.—— freeQty(product)、channelQty(product, channel)、bundleQty(bundle, productsById)、allChannelsLocked(product, bundles)，欄位上限走 validateLock(product, channel, wanted)。頁面不得自己再算一次 min(成員) 或「池減鎖定」。

4.208 Stock history

🟡 molecule

Stock history for one product: restock orders and lock changes in one list, one row per order. The main row says when / which kind / what changed per combination / supplier · method / status; open the row for quantities, supplier, ETA (with Mark received while restocking) and the note. History is mostly scanned and only occasionally inspected, so the main row stays clean. Built on Data list + Row disclosure (Q107 "whole group changes layer"); this file only owns the date column, badge slot, delta digits and the key / value cells of the expanded rows. 2026-09-11, promoted from lab-stock-history.html H1.

一件商品的庫存變動：補貨單與鎖定變動合併一張清單，一張單一筆。主列講什麼時候／哪一種／逐組合變了多少／供應商 · 方式／狀態；點開看逐組合數量、供應商、預計到貨（補貨中時附到貨確認）、備註。歷史紀錄多數時候是掃、偶爾才查細節，主列要乾淨。疊在 Data list＋Row disclosure（Q107 整組換層）上，本檔只擁有日期欄、徽章槽、變動數字與展開層的鍵／值格。2026-09-11 自 lab-stock-history.html H1 promote。

4.209 State check

🟡 molecule

A read-only row of on/off states — a small round mark plus a label per state. It is not an input: the row it sits in is what you click (it takes you to the setting). First use (2026-09-11, user: “pull listing / shown / on-sale out of the settings overview, checkbox-like but not necessarily a checkbox”): the “Listing & sale” row of the product and bundle detail overview, driven by the three switches and their schedules.

4.210 Lock sets

🟠 organism

A bundle’s stock lock, expressed in sets: one “Locked sets” field (blank = not locked; capped by the member with the least unlocked stock), then a framed list — one row per item in the bundle with its stock, unlocked count and “locked = N × per set”. Single-option items are read-only; multi-option items expand (row-disclosure) to optional per-option pinning — sum ≤ N × per set, under-pinning just constrains the total. Rule redefined by the user 2026-09-11; visual is the L3 outcome of lab-bundle-lock.html: 1px frame, edge-to-edge hairlines between rows, the expanded group hovers as one, three numeric columns end 12px from the column edge so the input’s unit lines up with the read-only “N pcs”.

組合包的庫存鎖定，以套為單位：一個「鎖定套數」欄位（空白＝不鎖定；上限受未鎖定量最少的那件商品限制），底下一張外框清單——組合內每件商品一列：商品庫存、未鎖定、已鎖定＝N × 每套用量。單一選項商品唯讀；多選項商品可展開（row-disclosure）逐規格選填分配——Σ ≤ N × 用量，少分配＝只限總數。規則由使用者 2026-09-11 重定義；視覺是 lab-bundle-lock.html L3 定案：1px 外框、列間貼邊髮線、展開的整組一起 hover、三個數字欄的墨水距欄右緣 12，輸入框的單位才跟唯讀的「N 件」對齊。

4.213 Bundle preview card

🟡 molecule

The fan-facing bundle card that sits in the right column while a creator builds a bundle (event step 6, js/bundle-editor.js layout:'split'). Promoted 2026-09-21 from docs/bundle-create-demo-2026-09-21.html after the user ruled 「make it production」. Composed on Preview card (media, name row, description) plus what a bundle adds: an included list in the same order as the editor’s sections (tickets → items → perks), each line an icon + text, with working pickers — date chips when the event has several dates and the bundle is shared across them, tier chips when more than one tier is allowed, one chip row per product option (size, colour). A chip that can’t be picked (a tier with less than a set left, a sold-out option) is disabled — faded and struck, still in the row. Below: selling price (「from $Y」 until every choice is made, then a single figure), struck list price and a 「N% off」 badge when discounted, 「N sets left」 or a Sold-out badge, and an add-to-cart stand-in that is disabled with a one-line reason (「Pick tier, size first」) until the fan has chosen. Picking here only changes this card, never the form. Media is 2:1, not the preview card's portrait 2:3 — in a 340px rail a portrait image would push the included list below the fold (STYLE-DECISIONS Q120, pending). The fan-side bundle page is not specified upstream (ASSUMPTIONS BDL-001/002): this card is a presentation derivation, not a front-end spec.

創作者建組合包時右欄那張「粉絲看到的」卡（建立活動第 6 步，js/bundle-editor.js 的 layout:'split'）。2026-09-21 由 docs/bundle-create-demo-2026-09-21.html promote，使用者裁示「做上正式」。以 Preview card（媒體格、名稱列、說明）為底，加上組合包多出來的段落：內含清單（順序與編輯器分卡一致：票券 → 商品 → 額外權益），一列 icon ＋ 文字，且選擇器可以點——多場且一組通用時有場次 chip、允許多種票種時有票種 chip、多規格商品每個選項一排 chip（尺寸、顏色）。選不到的 chip（剩餘不足一組的票種、沒貨的規格）標 disabled：淡化＋劃線、仍留在排上。底下是售價（沒選齊寫「從 $Y 起」，選齊落到單一數字）、有折扣時的劃線原價＋「省 N%」徽章、「剩 N 組」或售罄徽章、一顆沒選齊就停用並寫一句理由（「先選票種、尺寸」）的「加入購物車」示意鈕。點選只影響這張卡，不寫回表單。媒體格 2:1、不是 preview-card 的直式 2:3——340px 右欄裡直式圖會把內含清單推到摺線下（STYLE-DECISIONS Q120 待裁決）。粉絲端組合包頁面上游未定案（ASSUMPTIONS BDL-001／002）：這張卡是呈現推導，不是前台規格。

ds-components/bundle-preview-card.css · markup generated by js/bundle-editor.js (fanHTML(), layout:'split') · depends on preview-card, chip (:disabled), badge, button

Anatomy

.bpc__title (rail heading, outside the card) → .preview-card.bpc > .preview-card__media (2:1) + .preview-card__body > .preview-card__row (__name[.is-empty] + .ztor-badge event status) · .preview-card__desc · .bpc__list > .bpc__row ×N (16px icon + .bpc__what[.is-empty] + .bpc__pick ×N > .bpc__picklabel + .chip-group > .chip[.chip--active][:disabled] + optional trailing .bpc__picklabel note) · .bpc__price > .bpc__now + .bpc__was + .ztor-badge--warning · .bpc__meta (sets left / .ztor-badge--error sold out / per-date note) · .btn.btn--primary.bpc__cta[disabled] · .bpc__why → .bpc__note (outside the card)

Behavior / usage

Chips carry data-bd-fan-sess / data-bd-fan-tier / data-bd-fan-var (+ -opt, -val); the editor keeps the fan's picks in a side map (not on the bundle record) and re-renders the card in place on every form change. Price = picked tier × per-set quantity + each item at its picked option price (lowest while unpicked), then × (1 − discount %). A tier chip is disabled when the picked date has fewer tickets left than one set (D296 rule 4a); an option value is disabled when no variant with that value has stock (D295). CTA disabled until every picker has a choice, or when sellable sets is 0 (「Sold out」). Read-only stand-in: nothing here writes state.

Token usage

--font-display／--fs-14／--muted-foreground (title), --border-soft (list and price dividers), --font-ui／--fs-13／--foreground (what), --fs-11 (pick labels), --font-numeric／--fs-22 (now), --fs-13 (was — same size as .cb-basestrike, Q35 state A), --fs-12 (meta／why／note), --lh-relaxed, --sp-6…14. No colour of its own beyond text tiers — badges and chips bring theirs.

Usage

create-event.html › step 6 › bundle dialog right column (layout:'split', markup by fanHTML()); create-bundle.html › right preview column (2026-09-21 batch 2, page-level: the outer card is the create-page form-section--outlined preview shell per the 2026-09-04 ruling, the card inside is this component, markup by the page’s own fanHTML() with data-cb-fan-tier/data-cb-fan-var chips). bundle-detail.html has no rail — the fan-facing view there stays the See-as-fan shop mirror. Exploration: docs/bundle-create-demo-2026-09-21.html.

4.214 Section tabs

🟡 molecule

A fixed row of section tabs at the top of a long, sectioned form (the bundle editor’s Contents → Pricing & stock → Name & listing): clicking scrolls smoothly to that section, scrolling highlights the section in view (scrollspy), ←／→／Home／End move between tabs. Added 2026-09-21 from the user’s feedback on the “New ticketed product” dialog (“a tab fixed at the top of the popup that jumps to a section”); the shop’s Create bundle page shares the same mental model, so one component serves both. Not a panel switcher (that is Tabs + .tab-panel) and not Section nav (a detail page’s left rail that swaps panels) — all sections stay on screen; the row only jumps and tracks. Only one fixed row (the spirit of STYLE-DECISIONS Q115): both consumers already have a fixed header, so the row joins that header as its second line — --dialog sits between .payout-dialog__head and __body (outside the scroller), --wizard sits inside .wizard__top after the top bar. Nothing else floats over the content, so scroll offsets need no correction and the right-column preview card’s sticky is never covered. The shell is the 44px “shell” the Q38 underline recipe requires: items stretch to the shell height so the glowing underline lands on its bottom edge, exactly as in List toolbar.

一頁很長、分成幾段的表單（組合包編輯器的「內容物 → 定價與庫存 → 命名與上架」）頂端的一排固定分節分頁：點了平滑捲到那一段、捲動時亮著目前看到的那一段（scrollspy）、←／→／Home／End 在分頁間移動。2026-09-21 由使用者對「新增票務商品」彈窗的反饋而來（「popup 中要有 fix 在最上面的 tab 可以快速滾動到指定區塊」）；電子商店的建立組合頁是同一個心智模型，同一支元件裝兩處。不是切換面板的分頁（那是 Tabs＋.tab-panel），也不是 Section nav（詳情頁左側、切換面板）——三段都在畫面上，這一排只負責跳轉與定位。只准一條固定列（STYLE-DECISIONS Q115 的精神）：兩個消費處都已經有固定頂列，這一排併進那條頂列當第二排——--dialog 放在 .payout-dialog__head 與 __body 之間（捲動區外）、--wizard 放在 .wizard__top 的頂列之後。沒有別的東西浮在內容上，捲動偏移不必修正、右欄預覽卡的 sticky 也不會被蓋到。殼就是 Q38 底線配方要求的 44px「殼」：item 撐滿殼高，發光底線落在殼的下緣，與 List toolbar 同一個機制。

In context · dialog head + section tabs + scrolling body (the tabs work — click or scroll the box)實際情境 · 彈窗標題列＋分節分頁＋會捲的內容區（分頁可以點、方框可以捲）

Spec

Source

ds-components/section-tabs.css (shell + two placement modifiers) · js/section-tabs.js (window.ZtorSectionTabs.init(root?) / .sync(root?)) · depends on tabs (--underline-short + --underline-label)

Anatomy

nav.section-tabs[data-section-tabs] (shell: height: var(--control-h-md) 44px, display:flex; align-items:stretch, flex:none) > .tabs.tabs--underline-short.tabs--underline-label > button.tabs__item[data-st-tab="key"] > <span> label; the current one carries .tabs__item--active + aria-current="location". Targets inside the scroller: [data-st-section="key"]. Modifiers: .section-tabs--dialog (padding --sp-6/--sp-20 so labels share the title’s left edge, 1px --border bottom rule), .section-tabs--wizard (max-width 1000 + --sp-28 − --sp-14 padding = the .wizard__body--narrow content column).

Behavior / usage

data-st-scroller (optional) names the scroll container (nav.closest → sibling query → document; default = nearest scrollable ancestor, else window). data-st-offset (optional, comma list) names fixed bars covering the scroller’s top edge (create-bundle passes .wizard__top); jumps and the spy line subtract their bottom edge, and a nav that sits inside the scroller counts as one. Click: target = section top − offset − 16px, scrollTo({behavior:'smooth'}) (auto under reduced motion). While the smooth scroll travels the spy yields, released on arrival (|scrollTop − target| ≤ 2, bottom reached, or scrollend) with a 2.5s safety — not a fixed delay, because smooth-scroll duration is not guaranteed (a background tab even delays the start) and a timer that fires mid-flight snaps the active tab back to a section passed on the way. Spy: rAF-throttled scroll listener, current = the last section whose top ≤ offset + 17px; at the bottom of the scroller the last section wins so a short final section can be reached. Keyboard: ←/→ (wrap) and Home/End move focus; Enter/Space are native <button>. Idempotent via data-st-ready; hosts that re-render (bundle-editor swaps innerHTML on every render()) call init() again. On init it writes its own height to --section-tabs-h on the scroller (or <html>) so sibling sticky elements can add it — create-bundle: .preview-split { --preview-col-top: calc(96px + var(--section-tabs-h, 0px)) }.

Token usage

--control-h-md (shell height), --sp-6／--sp-20／--sp-28／--sp-14 (padding), --border (dialog bottom rule), --foreground (current label). Type, underline and glow come from Tabs’ --underline-short／--underline-label; nothing is redeclared here.

Usage

create-event.html › step 6 “New bundle” dialog (js/bundle-editor.js sectionTabsHTML(), layout:'split' only; the three .bd-sec--stack sections carry data-st-section); create-bundle.html › second row of .wizard__top (three form-section--outlined.cb-sec carry data-st-section). The funding pages (layout:'sections') have no such row. Do: join an existing fixed header; keep tab labels and section titles on the same i18n keys (cpp.bd.sp.sec.*). Don’t: use it to switch panels; don’t drop bare .tabs--underline-short into a header without this 44px shell (Q38).

4.215 Fan event page

🟠 organism

The fan-facing full event page used as the publish-preview / preview-and-localize content for events (D305, 2026-09-22). 2026-09-22 user ruling: “the preview UI must look exactly like these two pages — only the data and mechanics follow our flow” (ticket page shop-item.html?id=ev-score-live, ticket-bundles page shop-item.html?id=ev-themesong-night&sets=1). So this is no longer a structural re-draw in this site’s tokens: js/fan-event-page.js emits the front end’s DOM and class names (evidence: docs/fe-mirror-2026-09-22/ticket.main.html / bundles.main.html), and ds-components/fan-shop.css is every CSS rule those two pages actually hit, extracted by Playwright and scoped under .fep-shop (its :root tokens included). Only the data changes — name, highlight, description, lineup, notes, ticket delivery, ticket types, bundles (allowed tiers × qty, goods, perks, price / list price) all come from our create-event flow or events-store; purchase buttons are inert; the front end’s “scenario” fab and bottom sheet are not drawn; the three related-event cards are flagged “Not this event”.

活動的發布前預覽／預覽與在地化用的粉絲視角完整頁（D305，2026-09-22）。使用者 2026-09-22 裁決：「預覽 UI 必須做得和這兩個一模一樣，只是資料和機制套用我們的流程與功能」（票券頁 shop-item.html?id=ev-score-live、票務商品頁 shop-item.html?id=ev-themesong-night&sets=1）。所以它不再是用站上 token 重刻的結構鏡像：js/fan-event-page.js 輸出的是前台的 DOM 與 class 名（證據：docs/fe-mirror-2026-09-22/ticket.main.html／bundles.main.html），ds-components/fan-shop.css 是那兩頁實際命中的全部 CSS 規則（Playwright 抽出、加 .fep-shop 前綴，含前台的 :root token）。只有資料換成我們的——名稱、亮點、描述、卡司、須知、取票方式、票種、組合包（允許票種 × 張數、商品、權益、售價／原價）全部來自建立活動流程或 events-store；購買類按鈕不動作；前台的「情境展示」浮鈕與底部抽屜不畫；相關活動三張卡標「非本活動」。

Exception (token discipline): fan-shop.css is a front-end mirror, not a component of this design system — it carries the front end’s raw rgb() values and px type sizes on purpose and must not be referenced by any other Creator Studio page. Its raw-color count is registered by hand in ds-baseline.json; when the front end changes, re-extract and overwrite the file instead of hand-tuning it.

例外（token 紀律）：fan-shop.css 是前台鏡像、不是本 design system 的元件——它刻意保留前台的裸 rgb() 與 px 字級，且不得被 Creator Studio 其他頁引用。它的裸色數量已手動登記在 ds-baseline.json；前台改了就重抓覆蓋，不在這裡手改。

4.202 Archived gate

🟢 atom

Purpose

用途

Makes an archived detail page read-only at the event level (spec §7.14 “Archived · No delete”, D284 / D288). Each detail page already hides or disables its edit entry points; this module is the second line — while the page root carries data-archived, every data-changing control (inputs, switches, segmented buttons, radio lists, chip ✕, the film picker’s add / remove, upload tiles, the private-link reset) is intercepted in the capture phase before any page handler runs. Navigation and viewing stay untouched: links, tabs, section nav, disclosure handles, the confirm dialog and whatever the page allows explicitly (the Unarchive button — since 2026-09-22 / D298 the archived page's only action, which returns the item to Unlisted). Nothing is drawn — the visible read-only cues are the existing info banner, locked listing controls and hidden actions.

把已封存的細節頁在事件層收成唯讀（規格 §7.14「封存與不可刪除」，D284／D288）。每個細節頁本來就會藏掉或停用編輯入口；本模組是第二道——頁面根節點帶 data-archived 時，所有會改資料的控件（輸入格、開關、分段按鈕、單選清單、chip 的 ✕、選片器的加入／移除、上傳格、非公開連結的重置）在 capture 階段就被攔下、到不了頁面的 handler。導覽與查看不受影響：連結、分頁、章節導覽、展開把手、確認彈窗，以及頁面明確放行的（「解除封存」鈕——2026-09-22 · D298 起已封存頁唯一的動作，按下回到已下架）。它不畫任何東西——看得見的唯讀提示仍是既有的 info banner、鎖定的 listing controls 與收起的動作。

Rendered preview (live — the wrapper carries data-archived; toggle it to see the gate open and close)

視覺展示 （真的由模組守著：外框帶 data-archived，切換看閘門開關）

Archived — read-only. Unarchiving returns it to Unlisted; settings are kept.已封存：整頁唯讀，解除封存後回到已下架、設定照舊保留。
Show in shop顯示於商店

For developers — API · code給工程師 — API · 程式碼

No CSS of its own, draws nothing.無自帶 CSS、不畫任何東西。 window.ZtorArchivedGate.install(rootEl, { block?: string, allow?: string }) → { isActive() }。The check is live — the gate reads rootEl.hasAttribute('data-archived') on every event, so archiving and relisting need no re-install. block extends the default blocked selectors, allow extends the default pass-through ones; allow wins. Also honours [data-archived-allow] on any element.判斷是即時的——每個事件都重讀 rootEl.hasAttribute('data-archived')，封存／解除封存不必重裝。block 追加要擋的選擇器、allow 追加放行的；放行優先。任何元素標 [data-archived-allow] 也放行。

4.216 Publish stage

🟠 organism

D310 (2026-09-22): “look at it once before publishing” is no longer a modal — it is a full-page screen. In a multi-step flow it is the last step (create-event step 8, “Preview & publish”); after publishing it re-opens as its own page (event-localization.html). Two columns: the fan-view preview (Fan event page) on the left, and a sticky control sidebar on the right with three sections — Language (four locales, each row carrying its state: Default / Auto-translated / N edited; click to switch the preview locale; “Restore auto-translation”; “Field-by-field” opens the translation table), Currency (base + four converted, each row stating Base / Converted / N overridden; clicking a price inside the preview opens the price table) and a third section that depends on mode: 'publish' shows the pre-publish checks (each item jumps back to its step), 'save' shows an unsaved-changes summary. The primary action (Publish event / Save) sits at the bottom of the sidebar; pressing it publishes — there is no second confirmation. Hovering a preview block floats an “Edit” button that jumps back to the step that owns it (editZones).

D310（2026-09-22）：「發布前看一次」不再是浮層，是全頁畫面。多步驟流程裡它就是最後一步（建立活動第 8 步「預覽與發布」）；發布後再開是一個獨立頁（event-localization.html）。兩欄——左邊粉絲視角預覽（Fan event page），右邊 sticky 控制側欄三段：語言（四語系，每列標狀態：預設／自動翻譯／已修改 N 欄，點選切換預覽語系；有「還原自動翻譯」；「逐欄位對照」開翻譯表）、幣別（基準＋四個換算，每列標基準／換算／已覆寫 N 項；點預覽裡的價格開價格表）、第三段看 mode：'publish' 是發布前檢核（每項可點跳回該步驟）、'save' 是未儲存的變更摘要。主鈕（發布活動／儲存）在側欄底部，按下即發布、不再問第二次。滑到預覽的某一塊會浮出「編輯」鈕，跳回擁有那塊內容的步驟（editZones）。

Why not the wizard rail: .wizard-split__rail is a read-only summary rail; this sidebar is a control panel — every row is clickable, it carries the primary action, and it also has to work on a page with no wizard around it. The sticky offset comes from --pstage-top so the wizard host can set it to its top-bar height without hard-coding a number.

為什麼不是 wizard 的右軌：.wizard-split__rail 是唯讀的摘要軌；這條側欄是控制台——每一列可點、帶主動作，而且在沒有 wizard 的獨立頁也要成立。sticky 位移走 --pstage-top，讓 wizard 宿主把它設成頂列高度，不寫死數字。

Rendered preview (mounted live by js/publish-stage.js with the same demo data as §4.130 — mode:'publish', three-section sidebar, both drawers work)

視覺展示 （由 js/publish-stage.js 用與 §4.130 相同的示範資料當場掛載——mode:'publish'、側欄三段，兩個抽屜都可開）

Spec

Source

ds-components/publish-stage.css ＋ js/publish-stage.js（window.ztorPublishStage.mount(host, opts)）· consumers: 消費頁：create-event.html（第 8 步，mode:'publish'，translation:'manual'）、event-localization.html（mode:'save'，translation:'manual'）、create-product.html（「開始販售」驗證通過後的全頁畫面，mode:'publish'，未傳 translation＝'auto'）· depends on 相依 Fan event page（create-event.html／event-localization.html 的 previewRender）、Fan product page（create-product.html 的 previewRender）、Drawer（--wide：兩張表的右側滑出面板）、Publish preview（表格家族 .pp-table／.pp-cell／.pp-slot--editable／.pp-fan-viewbar，消費頁要一併連 publish-preview.css）、Readiness（檢核列與 banner）、Button、Badge、Table。

Anatomy

.pstage（兩欄 grid）> .pstage__main（粉絲視角預覽，浮動 .pstage-edit 以本欄定位；hover 中的區塊加 .pstage-zone--hot）＋ .pstage__side（sticky 卡）> .pstage__side-inner（可捲）> .pstage-sec ×3 > .pstage-sec__title（群組小字標）＋ ul.pstage-list > li > button.pstage-row[.pstage-row--active] > __name（幣別加 --code 等寬）＋ __state；段底 .pstage-sec__foot（還原自動翻譯或清除譯文／逐欄位對照／價格表）；檢核段 .pstage-check 沿用 .readiness，每列的字換成 button.pstage-linkbtn；未儲存的變更段 .pstage-sum > __row（__k／__v）或 .pstage-sum__none；底部 .pstage__foot（主鈕＋次鈕，各佔滿一列）。兩張表掛在 body 上的 .drawer.drawer--wide。

Behavior

宿主用 mount(host, { fields, prices, currencies, baseCurrency, views, previewRender, mode, translation, editZones, onEdit, checks, onPrimary, onSecondary }) 掛載，拿到 { refresh, syncChecks, result, unmount }。翻譯草稿（DRAFTS／EDITED）與價格草稿（PRICES）是模組變數、不隨每次 mount 重置——回去改一個字再回來，改過的翻譯與覆寫都還在；基準值一變該列覆寫清空重算（§7.15，比照 §7.4）。預覽語系與預覽幣別預設跟宿主走（介面語言／基準幣別），使用者點過才固定。預設語系那一欄唯讀（母本回表單改，D223），其餘語系在預覽裡就地 contenteditable。價格不就地改：預覽裡的價格帶 data-fep-price-key，點了開價格表並聚焦對應那一格。onPrimary 收到 { translations, prices, mode }；mode:'publish' 時檢核沒全過，主鈕 disabled。

Translation mode (D312, 2026-09-23)

translation: 'auto' | 'manual'，選填、預設 'auto'。auto（原行為）：切到還沒填的語系時，草稿直接鏡射預設語言目前值——等於自動翻譯，讀者分不出是原文還是已確認的譯文；create-product.html 未傳此選項，沿用這個模式。manual：其他語系不把原文抄進草稿（未填＝空字串），預覽與翻譯表改用原文當 fallback 顯示（畫面上看得到內容、草稿仍是空）；側欄語言列狀態字串改「未翻譯 Not translated」／「已翻譯 n of N translated」（n＝已填欄數、N＝翻譯表列數）；翻譯表未填格加原文當 placeholder（[data-stage-drawer="trans"] .pp-cell-field::placeholder）；還原鈕文案由「還原自動翻譯」換成「清除譯文 Clear translation」，行為也從「回填原文」改成「清空該語系草稿」。create-event.html 與 event-localization.html 掛 translation:'manual'（活動內容需要人工確認翻譯，主規格 §7.4「活動例外：手動翻譯」）。兩種模式共用同一個 result() 結構，差別只在「空字串」會不會被自動填滿。

Do / Don’t

Do: Do：把「發布前看一次」做成流程的最後一步或一個獨立頁，讓預覽拿到整個寬度。
Don’t: Don’t：在這個畫面之後再加一層「確認發布」浮層——本畫面就是那層確認（D310）。
Don’t: Don’t：把「編輯」鈕插進粉絲頁的 markup——那份 markup 是前台 1:1 鏡像，塞東西進去就不再是鏡像，可翻譯欄位又是 contenteditable，塞在裡面會被當成內容編輯；改用浮動的 .pstage-edit。

4.217 Calc list

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

A list of amounts that add up or subtract down to a result. The operator sits in its own leading column and the result row lives inside the same box, so “this number is those two added together” is something you can see rather than work out. 2026-09-22 (D311) promoted from bundle-editor.css’s .bd-calc-list: the single-ticket dialog’s “Price & quantity” block and the bundle editor’s “Full price” are the same visual role, and the site does not keep two answers for one role (.bd-calc-list/__how/__total stay there as a migration alias — bundle-detail.html's pricing card is owned by another session this round and did not switch class; this component is canonical, and the alias goes when that page migrates). The --form variant lets rows carry inputs — the ticket dialog’s price and booking fee are typed into the list, while fans-pay, platform fee and you-receive are read-only cells that recompute as you type.

一組彼此有加減關係的金額，最後一列是結果。運算子自己站一欄、結果列坐在同一個框裡，「這個數字是那兩個加出來的」用看的就成立；做成一欄一欄的獨立欄位時，關係只存在讀者的腦子裡。2026-09-22（D311）自 bundle-editor.css 的 .bd-calc-list promote——單張門票彈窗的「價格與數量」與組合包的「原價合計」是同一個視覺角色，站上不留兩份做法（那三個 class 在 bundle-editor.css 暫留成遷移別名——bundle-detail.html 的定價卡本輪由另一個 session 持有、沒有跟著改 class；canonical 是本元件，該頁遷移的那一輪連同別名一起刪）。--form 變體讓列裡可以放輸入控件——門票彈窗的票價與手續費直接打在列上，粉絲付／平台費／創作者實收是唯讀格、邊打邊重算。

4.218 Fan product page

🟠 organism

The fan-facing full product page used as create-product’s publish-preview content (D310 decision 4, 2026-09-23) — the product-side sibling of Fan event page, built the same way: a 1:1 mirror of the front-of-house shop-item page’s goods branch, not a structural redraw in this site’s tokens. js/fan-product-page.js reads the front end’s source (assets/shop-detail-render.js’s renderGoods() / goodsBuyHtml() / priceBlock() / variantsHtml() / qtyHtml() / deliveryMicroHtml() / stockLineHtml() / detailsSectionHtml() / relatedHtml() / buyBarHtml()) and emits the matching DOM and class names; ds-components/fan-shop.css section 4 (“product-page components”) extends the .fep-shop tokens section 1–3 already established for the event mirror. Only the data changes — name, gallery, category, options (colour / size), price, discount, stock, specs, pickup & returns all come from the create-product form; purchase buttons are inert; the four related-product cards are flagged “Not this item”.

建立商品「開始販售」發布前預覽用的粉絲視角完整商品頁（D310 決定四，2026-09-23）——Fan event page 的商品版，做法一樣：前台 shop-item 頁商品分支的 1:1 鏡像，不是用站上 token 重刻的結構鏡像。js/fan-product-page.js 讀前台原始碼（assets/shop-detail-render.js 的 renderGoods()／goodsBuyHtml()／priceBlock()／variantsHtml()／qtyHtml()／deliveryMicroHtml()／stockLineHtml()／detailsSectionHtml()／relatedHtml()／buyBarHtml()）輸出對應的 DOM 與 class 名；ds-components/fan-shop.css 第 4 段「商品頁元件」延續活動鏡像已經建好的第 1–3 段 .fep-shop token。只有資料換成我們的——名稱、圖庫、分類、選項（顏色／尺寸）、價格、折扣、庫存、規格、取貨與退貨全部來自建立商品表單；購買類按鈕不動作；相關商品四張卡標「非本商品」。
