ds-components/fan-shop.css（.fep-shop 第 4 段，前台鏡像）· markup 由 js/fan-product-page.js 的 window.ztorFanProductPage.render(host, model, api) 產生，經 Publish stage 的 previewRender 掛進全頁畫面 · consumers: 消費頁：create-product.html（「開始販售」驗證通過後）· depends on 相依 Publish stage（data-fep-price-key 點價格開價格表，同 Fan event page 的機制）、icon（前台 .ds-icon 改包 lucide）。

Anatomy（＝前台 shop-item 商品分支的 <main>）

.fep-shop > main > .section.section-bg-page.section--flush-top > .pdp[data-type=goods] > .pdp-topbar（手機頂欄，不可點）＋ .pdp__page > .container > .page-head__crumbs（商店 › 分類 › 名稱）＋ .pdp__grid > .pdp-gallery[data-fpp-gallery]（縮圖條＋2:3 主圖，>1 張才有左右箭頭）＋ .pdp-buy > .pdp-buy__meta（選填徽章）＋ h1.pdp-buy__title（可翻譯）＋ .pdp-host--shop（店家列，model.shop 給了才畫）＋ .pdp-price[data-fpp-price]（__now／__was／__save，價格節點帶 data-fep-price-key／data-fpp-price-key）＋ .pdp-stock[data-fpp-stock]（限量且剩 ≤10 件才有，「僅剩 N 件」）＋ .pdp-variants[data-fpp-variants]（.pdp-variant[data-variant=colour|size] ×N：顏色＝.pdp-swatch、其餘＝.pdp-size-chip；.pdp-variant__guide 尺寸指南鈕掛第一個非顏色列，沒有這種列就 .pdp-variant--reflone 自成一列）＋ .pdp-buy__actions（.pdp-qty 數量、.btn--mono.pdp-buy__add 加入購物車／已售完、.pdp-buy__heart 收藏）＋ .pdp-delivery[data-fpp-delivery]（交付方式一行）；section.pdp-details > .pdp-details__inner.container > h2 商品詳情＋ p.pdp-details__lead（描述，可翻譯）＋ .pdp-details__cols > __left（.pdp-details__specs-block[data-fpp-specs] > dl.pdp-specs）＋ __right（.pdp-details__shipping-block[data-fpp-returns]，model.returns 有值才畫）；section.pdp-recs 你可能也喜歡 > a.pdp-rec-card ×4（標「非本商品」）；.shop-buybar（手機底部購買列）。

Behavior

宿主（create-product.html）把表單資料整理成一份 model（結構見 js/fan-product-page.js 檔頭：category／badge／gallery／name／shop／price／variants／discountPct／stock／sizeGuide／delivery／desc／specs／returns／related）交給本檔渲染，本檔只知道「粉絲商品頁長什麼樣」、不知道資料來源。可翻譯欄位（name／desc）由宿主給 { key }，本檔以 api.getValue(key) 取當前語系值並掛 api.bindEditable。單一選項給一個價格，多選項取逐組合最低價、價格不同時加「起」；折扣 discountPct > 0 才畫折後價＋劃線原價＋「省 N」，換算後的幣別也照同比例打折。庫存只在限量且剩 ≤10 件時顯示「僅剩 N 件」，0 件時 CTA 轉「已售完」並停用。選項：顏色畫色票（有色號才填色，沒有退回 --border-strong）、其餘畫尺寸格。價格不就地改：data-fep-price-key／data-fpp-price-key 供宿主的 Publish stage 認得，點了開價格表並聚焦對應那一格（與 Fan event page 同一機制）。相關商品固定四張佔位卡，全部標「非本商品」。

Token usage

與 Fan event page 同一批前台 token（定義在 fan-shop.css 最前面的 .fep-shop { … }），第 4 段新增的類別沿用同一批、無新 token；與本站 _tokens.css 不混用。

Consumers

create-product.html（「開始販售」驗證通過後的全頁畫面，previewRender 呼叫 buildFanProductModel()）、design-system.html §4.218 就地渲染 demo（替身 api）。

4.130 Publish preview (D223, replaces §4.130 Lang switch)

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

D223 (2026-08-24) retired Lang switch (partials/lang-switch.js, D220's page-top content-language tabs) and moved translation review to after the publish click, right before the real submit: the four create/publish flows (create-product, create-event, create-project, publish-work) open this modal, the creator checks the rendered content in each language — or edits every field × language at once in a table — and only then confirms. Shell is the canonical .payout-modal / .payout-dialog--xwide (STYLE-DECISIONS Q27 — the fan-tier settings screen dropped into an overlay is the precedent for "a whole screen inside a dialog"). Language switching is the primary view ("which translation am I looking at") so it uses Tabs; Preview/List is a control-layer toggle on the same data, so it uses Segmented (Q8's split, applied to two different jobs in one component).

D223（2026-08-24）撤除 Lang switch（partials/lang-switch.js，D220 的表單頂部內容語言分頁），把翻譯檢視挪到按下發布之後、真正送出之前：四個建立／發布流程（create-product、create-event、create-project、publish-work）打開這一層，創作者先看渲染後的各語系內容，或切到表格一次改完「每個欄位 × 每個語系」，確認才真的送出。殼固定用 .payout-modal／.payout-dialog--xwide（STYLE-DECISIONS Q27——粉絲分級設定整畫面裝進浮層是「把一整個畫面塞進彈窗」的先例）。語言切換是「現在看哪一份」的主要檢視，所以用 Tabs；預覽／列表是同一份資料的控件層切換，所以用 Segmented（Q8 的分工，這裡同一個元件裡各司其職）。

2026-09-22 (D305 / D306): the preview pane for events is now the full fan-facing page (Fan event page, two views when the event has bundles), a five-currency Segmented sits beside the language tabs (two independent axes — language drives copy, currency drives prices; a control-layer toggle per Q8: it changes which currency the same price data is viewed in, unlike the language tabs which pick a different translation; five 3-letter codes fit one row, so no dropdown), and the list view becomes two tables — the translation table plus a price table (rows = ticket types / bundles, columns = five currencies; the base-currency column is read-only with a “Base” badge — and a lock when bookyay set the price — every other cell is a number input that shows the converted value until you type, then carries an “Overridden” badge and a “Reset to converted” ghost button). Price drafts live in the module like translations (Back to editing keeps them); changing the base price wipes that row’s overrides and reconverts (§7.15, mirroring §7.4 translation regeneration). mode:'save' (event detail › Preview & localization) swaps the title to “Preview & localization” and the primary to “Save”; onConfirm receives { translations, prices }. Conversion and formatting are delegated to js/events-store.js (fixed demo rates, ASSUMPTIONS PG-035 / UIA-165). create-product / create-project / publish-work keep calling it exactly as before — no currencies means no currency axis, no prices means only the translation table.

2026-09-22（D305／D306）：活動的預覽檢視改成粉絲視角完整頁（Fan event page，有組合包時兩個視圖），語言分頁旁多一組五幣別 Segmented（兩軸獨立——語言決定文案、幣別決定價格；照 Q8 它是控件層 toggle：切的是「同一份價格用哪個幣別看」，語言分頁切的是「看哪一份翻譯」；五個三字碼並排剛好一列，不用下拉），列表檢視由一張表改兩張——翻譯表＋價格表（列＝票種／組合包、欄＝五幣別；基準幣別欄唯讀並標「基準」、bookyay 決定的票價再多一把鎖；其餘每格是數字輸入框，沒改時顯示換算值、一輸入就標「已覆寫」並露出「重設為換算值」ghost 鈕）。價格草稿與翻譯草稿一樣住在模組裡（返回編輯不丟）；基準價一改，該列覆寫整個清空重算（§7.15，比照 §7.4 翻譯重生成）。mode:'save'（活動詳情 › 預覽與在地化）把標題換成「預覽與在地化」、主鈕換成「儲存」；onConfirm 收到 { translations, prices }。換算與格式化轉問 js/events-store.js（固定示範匯率，ASSUMPTIONS PG-035／UIA-165）。create-product／create-project／publish-work 的呼叫一字不改——沒給 currencies 就沒有幣別軸、沒給 prices 就只有翻譯表。

4.131 Login lang prompt (D225)

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

Asks, once, right after login: does the language you picked on the login screen become your account default? Lineage — a rewritten revival, not a straight comeback: 2026-08-24 had a ~~Lang mismatch dialog~~ (D221, partials/lang-mismatch-dialog.js), which compared two concepts — "display language" vs. "default language" — that existed for one day before D222 collapsed them back into a single value (window.ztorLang) and the old file was deleted outright. This module compares something entirely different: the site still has only one language value; what's being compared is "the language you just picked on the login screen" vs. "the language already saved as your account default" — same shell convention reused, semantics rebuilt from zero. Pure JS, no CSS of its own beyond the canonical .payout-modal / .payout-dialog--narrow shell (STYLE-DECISIONS Q27).

登入完成後問一次：登入畫面剛選的語言，要不要成為帳號預設語言？沿革——語意重寫的復活，不是原樣搬回：2026-08-24 曾有 ~~Lang mismatch dialog~~（D221，partials/lang-mismatch-dialog.js），比對的是「顯示語言」與「預設語言」兩個只存在一天的概念，D222 當天就把兩者收回單一概念（window.ztorLang），舊檔直接刪除。本檔比對的是完全不同的東西：站上依然只有一個語言值，比對的是「登入畫面剛選的語言」vs.「帳號已存的預設語言」——沿用同一種殼的寫法，語意從零重建。純 JS，除沿用正典 .payout-modal／.payout-dialog--narrow 殼外**無自帶 CSS**（STYLE-DECISIONS Q27）。

Rendered preview (demo only — bypasses the sessionStorage flags, see code below)

視覺展示 （僅示範，不走 sessionStorage 旗標判斷，見下方程式碼）

For developers — API · code給工程師 — API · 程式碼

State model.狀態模型。 login.html's language selector calls the new 的語言選擇器改呼叫新的 window.ztorLang.preview(lang) (in js/i18n.js) — applies display only, never writes （在 js/i18n.js）——只套用畫面顯示，never writes localStorage, never dispatches ztor:lang-changed從不寫 localStorage、從不廣播 ztor:lang-changed, and records the pick in sessionStorage ，並把選擇記進 sessionStorage ztor-r22-login-lang-pick. All three successful login paths (email / phone / third-party OAuth) write a one-time flag 。三條登入成功路徑（email／phone／第三方 OAuth）落地前都寫一次性旗標 ztor-r22-login-lang-pending before navigating away (see login.html's （見 markJustLoggedIn()).）。

On the landing shell page (落地 shell 頁載入時（index.html/creators.html):）：

1. no pending flag → zero DOM, zero cost.沒有 pending 旗標 → 零 DOM、零開銷。

2. pending but no pick (user never touched the selector on login.html) → clear the flag, don't ask.有 pending 但沒有 pick（登入畫面沒動過選擇器）→ 清旗標，不問。

3. pick equals the account default → clear both flags, don't ask.pick 等於帳號預設語言 → 清兩把旗標，不問。

4. pick differs → pick 不同 → window.ztorLang.preview(pick) re-applies the picked language to the page first (so the dialog opens on top of content already shown in that language), then opens the confirm dialog. 先把畫面套回登入時選的語言（讓確認框跳出時，背景內容已經是那個語言），再開確認框。

Two buttons兩顆按鈕：loginlangprompt.use ("Use {picked}"「改用 {picked}」) → window.ztorLang.set(pick) — becomes the new account default; the interface is already showing it, so nothing visibly changes. ——成為新的帳號預設語言；介面已經在該語言，畫面上什麼都不變。loginlangprompt.keep ("Keep {default}"「保留 {default}」) → window.ztorLang.preview(default) — account value untouched, interface switches back to the account default. ——帳號值不變，介面切回帳號預設語言。Esc / backdrop click is treated as "Keep {default}"Esc／點遮罩視同「保留 {default}」 (a presentation assumption — not actively choosing "use" is read as not wanting to change the account default; see ASSUMPTIONS.md). Any resolution — including Esc/backdrop — clears both sessionStorage flags, so the same login only ever asks once (page changes and reloads afterward don't re-trigger it).（呈現假設，見 ASSUMPTIONS.md）。任一種結束方式（含 Esc／遮罩）都會清掉兩把 sessionStorage 旗標，同一次登入只問一次，之後換頁或重整不會再跳。

partials/login-lang-prompt.js。i18n keys: brand-new i18n key：全新獨立的 loginlangprompt.*（title/body/use/keep，{picked}/{default} interpolate the language's readable name from {picked}/{default} 插值 window.ztorLang.list() — deliberately not reusing the cleared 的可讀名稱——刻意不沿用已清除的 langmismatch.*）。consumers: 消費頁：index.html、creators.html（the two login landing points兩條登入落點）。manual trigger for this demo: 本頁 demo 的手動觸發：window.ztorLoginLangPrompt.show(pickedLang, defaultLang)（bypasses the flags entirely完全不走旗標）。Tombstone: 墓碑：partials/lang-mismatch-dialog.js（deleted 2026-08-24, D2222026-08-24（D222）已刪除）。

4.134 Sparkline

🟢 atom

Purpose

用途

A number's footnote, not a chart. It answers "which way has this been going" and nothing else — no gridlines, no data points, no hover. Promoted 2026-08-28 from the dashboard KPI row. When a reader needs to pull a value off the curve, that is the Chart organism's job; enlarging this one is the wrong fix.

數字的附註，不是圖表。它只回答「最近是往上還往下」，不回答「哪一天是多少」——沒有格線、沒有資料點、沒有 hover。2026-08-28 自儀表板 KPI 列 promote。要能從曲線讀出某一點的值時該用 Chart organism，把這支放大是錯的解法。

Rendered preview

$25k$20k$15k

Anatomy

結構

  • .sparkline__plot > .sparkline__main — plot row: the plot column and the y-axis sit side by side (not stacked), so long tick labels take width from the plot instead of covering the line. The x-axis lives inside __main so it is exactly as wide as the canvas — put it one level up and the last tick lands under the y-axis labels rather than at the end of the line (fixed 2026-08-28).繪圖列：繪圖欄與縱軸並排（不是疊上去），刻度變長時是繪圖區讓寬度，不會蓋住折線。橫軸放在 __main 裡面，才會跟畫布同寬——放到上一層就會連縱軸那一欄一起撐開，最後一個刻度落在縱軸標籤底下而不是折線的終點（2026-08-28 修）。
  • .sparkline__axis-y / .sparkline__axis-x — optional. Two ticks each: max/min, start/end. Tick strings arrive with their units already attached ($25k, 12 wks ago) — the renderer never formats numbers, so currency and locale stay with the data.兩條軸都是選配，各只標兩個刻度：最大／最小、起點／終點。刻度字串自帶單位（$25k、12 週前）——渲染器不做數字格式化，幣別與語系寫法留在資料端。
  • --spark-ink — the one colour hook. Defaults to --muted-foreground and stays there across cards: colour belongs to the number and the delta pill, and a coloured line would imply one card outranks another (user directive 2026-08-28).唯一的顏色鉤子，預設 --muted-foreground 且各卡一致：顏色留給數字與 delta 膠囊，某一條線染色會暗示那張卡比較重要（2026-08-28 使用者裁示）。
  • .sparkline__grid / .sparkline__target — both dashed, separated by weight and lightness rather than colour: gridlines are the faintest layer, the target line one step firmer. Gridlines are drawn at the y-ticks that carry a value, so the curve lines up with the ticks instead of floating against them.兩者都是虛線，靠粗細與明度分階、不靠顏色：格線最淡，目標線稍實。格線畫在「有帶值」的縱軸刻度上，折線才跟刻度對得起來。
  • .sparkline__band + .sparkline__seg — a marked stretch: a shaded column behind, the same points redrawn on top. The band carries lightness only; the segment carries the meaning, via --up / --down — the same status colours as the delta pill, because what it marks is a growth rate, not a brand emphasis. Drawing the segment over the main line means the main line never has to be cut into pieces. Endpoint dots were dropped 2026-08-28: the band's own edges already state where the stretch begins and ends.標記區間兩件套：底下一塊直立色塊、上面把區間內那幾點重畫一次。色塊只承擔明度，語意由線段的 --up／--down 承擔——與 delta 膠囊同一套狀態色，因為它標的是成長率而不是品牌強調。線段疊在主線之上，所以主線不必被切成好幾段。端點圓點已於 2026-08-28 撤除：區間的起訖由色塊的左右邊界講清楚了。
  • .sparkline__mark — the band's readout (e.g. the week-over-week +12.6%), placed over the plot as HTML rather than SVG text — preserveAspectRatio="none" stretches x only, so text inside the SVG comes out squashed. Centred on the band, or right-aligned once the band's midpoint passes 60% so it cannot spill past the canvas.區間的數值標籤（例如上週到本週的 +12.6%），用 HTML 疊在繪圖區上而非 SVG 文字——preserveAspectRatio="none" 只拉伸 x，SVG 裡的文字會被壓扁。標籤對齊區間中點；中點超過 60% 時改靠右對齊，才不會溢出畫布。
  • .sparkline--detail — raises the plot to 76px. Four or five y-ticks collide inside 30px, and a dense series flattens into a band when the plot is too short. Use the bare .sparkline when direction is all that matters.把繪圖區加高到 76px。四五段縱軸刻度擠在 30px 裡會疊字，密集折線在太矮的區域裡也會糊成一條帶子。只要看方向時用裸的 .sparkline 就好。
  • aria-hidden — always. The exact value is already announced by .kpi__value; reading out twelve points again is noise. Magnitude and period are carried by the two tick strings.一律加。精確值 .kpi__value 已經唸過，再唸十二個點只是噪音；量級與期間由兩組刻度字串負責。

ds-components/sparkline.css

4.196 Canvas stage

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

The full-bleed backdrop of the one-screen presentation layout (index.html): one work, one piece of merch or one event filling the whole content area, with the left column of figures floating directly on top of it. It replaced a poster wall built earlier the same day — in the reference layout the image is not a panel, it is the ground the screen stands on, and the moment it becomes a grid of tiles the whole thing falls back to being one more card. Mapping to the reference: the building becomes the current item's key visual, the floor selector becomes the item switcher on the right edge, and the pinned faults become markers carrying this item's own facts and anything pending on it. Built 2026-08-31.

一屏不捲展示版（index.html）的滿版底圖：一件作品、一件商品或一場活動鋪滿整個內容區，左欄的數字直接浮在上面。它取代了同日稍早的海報牆——參考版型裡那張圖不是一個區塊，它是整個畫面的地；一旦變成一格一格的磚，畫面就退回「又一張卡」。對照參考版型：那棟樓＝當前這件的主視覺，樓層選擇器＝右緣的作品切換器，異常釘點＝浮在圖上的標記（這件自己的事實，以及它身上待處理的事）。2026-08-31 建。

Anatomy

結構

  • .canvas-stage__img — the artwork sits against the right edge at its own aspect (height:100%, width:auto; max-width only stops a landscape source from taking the whole screen). Stretching it edge to edge with object-fit: cover pulls a portrait key visual sideways and crops most of it away, and dimming the whole thing evenly leaves no bright half at all. Source is poster || cover, so a portrait version is used wherever one exists. Its left edge is dissolved by a mask, and the ramp runs to 58% of the image (2026-08-31, up from 26%, after the user reported a visible boundary): on an image 62% of the viewport wide, a 26% ramp is only 16% of the screen — short enough to read as "a picture starts here". Long, it reads as one image going from blurred to sharp, which is depth of field, not a seam. The mask only takes alpha, so the gradient is written with a token rather than #000.主視覺貼右緣、保留自己的比例（height:100%、width:auto；max-width 只用來擋橫式素材吃掉整個畫面）。用 object-fit: cover 拉滿版會把直式主視覺橫拉、上下裁掉大半，而整張均勻壓暗則會讓「亮的那一半」不存在。來源取 poster || cover，有直式版就用直式。左緣用遮罩溶掉，斜坡拉到圖寬的 58%（2026-08-31 由 26% 拉長，使用者回報「圖片邊界太明顯」）：一張佔視窗 62% 寬的圖，26% 的斜坡只有 16% 視窗寬，短到看得出「這裡開始有一張圖」。拉長之後讀起來是同一張圖從模糊走到清晰——那是景深，不是接縫。遮罩只吃 alpha，所以漸層色寫 token 不寫 #000。
  • .canvas-stage__scrim / .canvas-stage__bg — two gradients, heavy on the left and heavy at the bottom, rather than one flat wash: the left third is where every line of the rail lands and has to be dark, and a flat wash dark enough for that turns the photograph into grey paper. Under it lies the same image again, scaled up and blurred, so the dark half still carries this work's own colour instead of going black. Both were retuned on 2026-08-31 after the user reported "a black block in the middle": the blurred layer went from .6 to .85 opacity, and the scrim's curve moved down — full strength now ends by 16% instead of holding 88% out to 26%. The band that looked black was simply the strip where the sharp image had not faded in yet and the scrim had not let go yet; with a stronger backdrop under it, there is something to see there. The first 16% — where the rail's text sits — was not relaxed at all. A second report of "a black patch" the same day was a different shape: not a band but a cloud, and the cause was the blur being too gentle. At 48px the layer still holds a silhouette, so any dark area in the left half of the key visual (here a black jacket) reassembles into a recognisable dark blob behind the rail. This layer's job is to borrow the work's colour as ground, not to show the picture a second time — so it now goes to 90px with brightness(1.22) contrast(.85), which flattens it into a colour field and levels the dark areas into one even step. The scale went to 1.3 because the heavier the blur, the wider the ring of ground colour bleeding in at the edges.兩層漸層（橫向壓左、縱向壓下），不是一片半透明黑：左三分之一是左欄每一行字的落點、必須夠暗，而一片足夠暗的均勻遮罩會把照片壓成灰紙。它底下鋪的是同一張圖的放大模糊版，暗的那一半才仍帶著這件作品自己的顏色，不會變成純黑。兩層 2026-08-31 一起重調（使用者回報「中間有一塊黑黑的」）：模糊層的不透明度 .6 → .85，壓底的曲線整條往下移——「夠暗」的區間收在 0–16%，不再是 26% 都還有 88%。那條看起來發黑的直帶，其實就是「清晰那張還沒溶進來、壓底又還沒退掉」的一段；底層厚了，那一段就有東西可看。左邊 0–16%（左欄字的落點）一點都沒有放鬆。同一天第二次回報「有一塊黑黑的」講的是另一種形狀：不是直帶而是雲塊，原因是模糊下得太輕——48px 還留得住輪廓，主視覺左半只要有一塊深色（那次是一件黑外套），就會在左欄後面糊成一團看得出形狀的黑雲。這一層的工作是「借這件作品的顏色鋪底」，不是「重放一次這張圖」，所以改成 90px ＋ brightness(1.22) contrast(.85)：糊到只剩色場、再壓掉自身的明暗差，深色區就攤平成整面的一階暗。放大改到 1.3，因為模糊愈重、邊緣往內透底色的那一圈愈寬。
  • .canvas-stage__marker — a glass pill hanging in the air with a hairline dropping to a pulsing dot, the same grammar as the reference's fault pins: the pill says what, the dot says where. Only what needs acting on is tinted; progress and release dates stay neutral, because three red pills on one image read as "the whole work is on fire" (the Q77 reason again). At most two — the third stops pointing at anything and starts covering the picture.一顆玻璃膠囊掛在半空，一條細線垂到脈動的點，與參考版型的故障釘點是同一套文法：膠囊講「是什麼」，點講「在哪裡」。只有需要被處理的那一種染色，進度與上線日維持中性——一張圖上三顆紅膠囊會讀成「整件作品都在燒」（Q77 的同一條理由）。最多兩顆，第三顆開始就從「指出重點」變成「蓋住畫面」。
  • .canvas-stage__rail — the item switcher on the right edge, in the reference's floor-selector position and behaviour: switching an item swaps the whole backdrop, the way switching a floor swaps the whole section. It lists only the first few — it is a control for changing the backdrop, not a catalogue, and listing everything would make it as tall as the screen, which is the poster wall again. A rounded rectangle rather than a pill: stacked vertically, a pill clips a corner off the first and last item's hit area.右緣的作品切換器，行為對應參考版型的樓層選擇器：換一項＝換整張底圖，就像換一層樓＝換整棟樓的剖面。只列前幾件——它是「換底圖」的控制、不是完整目錄，全部列出來會變成一條和畫面一樣高的清單，那就退回海報牆了。位置接在模式切換下方（同一組控制，分散兩處要找兩次），沒有外框：框讓這一列讀成「一塊面板」，但它其實只是幾個選項。選中態走次要玻璃面，不是品牌橘——橘在站上代表主要動作，而切換看哪一件是狀態不是動作；也不用 .btn--outline 的 --control-raise，那個 4% 白是為卡片底設計的，躺在照片上與未選中幾乎同明度（實測）。沒有外框之後每一項直接躺在照片上，未選中的字吃恆定的 --on-media-muted 加一層 text-shadow。
  • .canvas-stage__pick — The rail is the first screen's third job: a timeline, from the nearest thing running to what starts next. It carries its own heading (.canvas-stage__rail-title, "Projects & events") at the same step as the left rail's block titles — without a name, six right-aligned lines on a photograph read as decoration rather than a list. Six rows, soonest first: a project raising funds or taking pre-orders (days to its deadline), an event on sale or happening today, a release still ahead of its date, an event still in preparation — everything converted to "days from now" and sorted together. Each row carries that number next to its type ("Film · Live in 12 days", "Event · 8 days left"), and picking one swaps the screen's backdrop to that item's artwork. Where the days come from: dated things are computed (a project's release date, an event's date); funding and pre-orders have no deadline field, only the sentence the store already writes ("20 days left"), so the number is read out of that sentence — and only if it reads as a countdown, since that segment sometimes says something else entirely (measured: "approved, in cinemas 11/07" was parsed as 11 days). One item per day: a live event's date in the store is always today, so without that rule the six slots fill with today (measured); listing the same day twice adds nothing here either. One row of the switcher: a switch button (type label + countdown + name) and a go arrow. The current row is what used to be the caption in the bottom-right corner — small type label above, the name enlarged, an arrow on the far right — after that block was removed on 2026-08-31 at the user's call. Writing the same thing twice on one screen means the second copy is only taking up space, and that block was taking the most intact corner of the photograph. Hovering any row puts on the same dress: that is a preview of what you would be looking at after switching. Two targets rather than one, because they do different things: the name switches the backdrop, the arrow opens that item's page. The name takes the whole row minus the arrow, so the main action is still a full row wide. No border anywhere and no surface on the idle rows (user's call): they lie straight on the photograph, so the text carries its own legibility — constant white (--on-media, not the theme-flipping --foreground) plus a shadow tinted with the scrim. Idle names sit at 88% white — a step back, not a fade: the step down is carried by size (12 vs 16) and by the three things only an open row has (type label, glass, arrow). Dim them as well and half the rail becomes unreadable over a dark image. Hovering gives a row the same glass as the current one, which cannot be confusing because only one row is ever open at a time. The current row keeps a glass surface (no border): hovering another row enlarges that one too, so with two rows large at once the glass is the only thing still saying which one you are actually looking at. Every work name ends on the same line as the clock in the top bar (measured: the clock and all six names at 1316px), and the action — "Open" plus the arrow — sits inside the glass (four calls on 2026-08-31 to land here: arrow jutting out, arrow tucked inside, names flush with the clock and the action sticking out, then the action back inside for good). What moves to make that line is the clock, not the rail: the glass already ends on the content edge, and pushing it further right runs it into the shell's overflow: hidden, so the top bar gives up a right padding equal to "the row's 10px plus the 60px reserved inside it". That 60px slot (arrow 22 + two gaps + "Open" at its widest) is reserved on every row, showing the action or not — reserve it only where the action shows and the other names run that much further out — and it is a fixed number rather than measured, or the whole column jumps when the language changes. The action sits level with the name rather than centred on the two-line block: centred, it floats between the type label and the name and looks like it is marking both lines. Hovering a row switches the backdrop outright, so "the current row" and "the row under the pointer" are the same row — which is exactly why "Open" shows on hover only (it was permanent on the current row for a while; the user's call: with them being the same row, a permanent action means the screen always has something waiting to be pressed, and this rail's job is to show what is coming, not to push you into it). It sits between the name and the arrow at two steps smaller — the verb belongs next to the arrow it acts on, and in front of the name it reads as part of the name. "Open" and the arrow are wrapped as one group (__pick-cta) and centred on each other by a single flex (user's call: "the two should be centred against each other") — the label is 17px tall and the arrow 22px, so aligning each to the baseline leaves their centres 2–3px apart and the arrow reads as having slipped down. The group is absolutely positioned inside the row rather than in flow: in flow its width would differ between an open row and an idle one, and the names would stop on two different edges. Only one row is enlarged at a time: as soon as the pointer enters the rail the current row folds back to its idle look and hands the enlargement to whatever the pointer is over; leaving the rail, it grows back on its own. Two large rows at once means the screen is pointing at two things.這一排就是第一屏的第三件事：一條時間線，從最近的進行中排到未來即將開始的。它自己帶一行標題（.canvas-stage__rail-title，「項目與活動」），字級與左欄那兩格的區塊標題同一階——沒有名字時，六行靠右的字讀起來像浮在圖上的裝飾，不像一份清單。六列、近的在上：正在募資或預購的項目（剩幾天截止）、正在賣票或今天正在舉行的活動、還沒到上線日的項目、還在準備中的活動——全部換算成「距今幾天」之後排在一起。每一列在類型後面接那個數字（「電影 · 12 天後上線」「活動 · 剩 8 天」），選一件就把整屏的地換成那一件的視覺。天數的來源：有日期的直接算（專案的上線日、活動的場次日）；募資與預購沒有截止日欄位，只有 store 自己寫好的那句「剩餘 20 天」，所以從那句話裡取數字——**而且只認倒數的句型**，因為那一段有時候寫的是別的事（實測「審核已過，11/07 上映」會被當成 11 天）。**同一天只留一件**：store 裡 live 活動的日期一律是今天，不擋的話六格會全部被今天塞滿（實測）；同一天在這個位置列兩次也不增加資訊。切換器的一列：切換鈕（類型小字＋倒數＋名稱）＋ 前往的箭頭。當前那一列就是原本右下角那塊作品說明——類型小字在上、名稱放大、最右邊一顆前往箭頭——2026-08-31 依使用者裁示把該塊移除之後搬過來的。同一件事在一個畫面上寫兩次，第二次就只是佔位置，而那一塊佔的還是照片最完整的一角。滑過任何一列都會換上同一套裝扮：那是「換過去之後會變成這樣」的預覽。兩個點擊目標而不是一個，因為它們做的事不同：名稱是「換底圖看這一件」，箭頭是「進到這一件的頁面」。名稱那一段吃掉整列扣掉箭頭的寬度，所以主要動作仍然是一整行可點的。一律不畫框，未選中的列也沒有面（使用者裁示）：它們直接躺在照片上，字自己扛可讀性——恆定的白 --on-media（不是會隨主題翻轉的 --foreground）＋一層貼著壓底色的陰影。未選中的字是 88% 的白（退一階，不是變灰）：降階的工作交給字級（12 vs 16）與那三樣只有展開才有的東西（類型小字、玻璃面、箭頭）；顏色再分一次階，這一排在暗的底圖上會有一半讀不出來。滑過的那一列與當前那一列有同一塊玻璃底，不會混淆——同一時間只有一列是展開的。當前那一列保留玻璃面（仍然不畫框）：滑鼠滑過別列時那一列也會放大，兩列同時是大的，玻璃是唯一還在說「你正在看的是這一件」的東西。作品名的右緣與頂列的時間收在同一條線上（實測時間與六個作品名皆為 1316px），而動作那一組——「前往」＋箭頭——站在玻璃面裡面（2026-08-31 四次裁示走到位：先「箭頭要往右邊凸出」，改成「箭頭要包在框框裡」，再「名稱的尾巴與上面時間切齊，前往和箭頭會凸出來」，最後定案「前往和箭頭要在框框裡面」）。**為那條線移動的是時間、不是切換器**：玻璃面的右緣已經抵著內容區的邊，再往右推就會撞上外殼的 overflow: hidden，所以由頂列讓出一段等於「玻璃面的右內距 10 ＋ 面內預留的 60」的右內距去接。那 60px（箭頭 22 ＋ 兩段間距 ＋「前往」約 24／英文 Open 約 27，以寬的為準）**每一列都留著**，不管當下有沒有顯示動作——只給展開的那一列預留，其餘幾列的名稱就會多伸出去那一段；而且寫死一個值、不跟著字長，否則換語言整排會跳一次。動作與名稱那一行齊平、不是整列垂直置中——置中會把它抬到類型小字與名稱之間，看起來像在標示那兩行而不是名稱。滑過任何一列就直接換底圖，因此「當前這一列」與「滑鼠底下那一列」是同一列——正因為如此，「前往」**只在滑鼠底下那一列出現**（中途曾讓已選的那一列固定掛著，使用者裁示改掉：兩者是同一列時，固定掛著等於畫面上永遠有一組動作在等人按，而這一排的工作是「看接下來有什麼」）。它站在名稱與箭頭之間、字級小兩階——動詞緊鄰它要作用的箭頭，放在名稱前面會先被讀成名稱的一部分。「前往」與箭頭包成一組（__pick-cta）、由同一個 flex 互相置中（使用者裁示「兩者要水平置中對齊」）：文字 17px、箭頭 22px，各自對齊底線時中線差 2–3px，讀起來像箭頭掉下去一點。整組在列內絕對定位、不排進流裡：排進去的話展開的那一列與其餘幾列寬度不同，名稱就會停在兩條線上。同一時間只有一列是放大的：滑鼠一進到這一排，當前那一列就先收回未選中的樣子，放大的名額交給滑鼠底下的那一列；滑鼠離開整排，它自己長回來。兩列同時是大的，等於畫面同時指著兩件事。

4.199 Split bar

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

One total plus what it is made of: a segmented bar and a legend. First used in the presentation layout's left rail for revenue mix and fan tiers. A horizontal bar rather than a donut because that rail is 300px wide — a donut costs a whole square while a large total is already competing for the same space, and what the reader actually needs here is "which slice is bigger, by how much", which the bar answers in one line. Built 2026-08-31.

一個總數，加上它是由哪幾塊組成的：一條分段長條 ＋ 一份圖例。首個消費情境是展示版左欄的收入分布與粉絲等級分布。用橫條不用圓餅：那條欄只有 300px 寬，圓餅要佔掉一個正方形，而它旁邊還有一個必須夠大的總數；而讀者在這裡真正要的是「哪一塊比較大、差多少」，橫條吃一行的高度就講完。2026-08-31 建。

Rendered preview

視覺展示

E-Shop sales電子商店銷售28%
Co-creation funding共創計畫20%
Event tickets活動票券14%
Other sources其他來源38%

Anatomy

結構

  • .split-bar__seg — segments are separated by a 2px gap, not a border: a border counts into the width and the proportions stop being true. Without any gap, two adjacent segments of similar lightness read as one. min-width keeps a tiny slice visible, otherwise the legend carries a row that points at nothing.分段之間用 2px 的 gap 隔開，不用邊框：邊框會算進寬度，各段的比例就不再準確；完全不留縫時，相鄰兩段若明度接近會讀成一整條。min-width 讓佔比極小的那一塊仍看得見，否則圖例上會有一列對不到條。
  • .split-bar__dot / .split-bar__label — solid 7px dots and white labels (2026-08-31, the user's call; the dot came down from 9px once it went solid — at the same diameter a filled dot carries much more weight than a ring, and a column of five gets read as five dots before five names, with the row gap tightened 8 → 6 to keep each dot attached to its label; both started the other way — hollow dots so the legend read as an index rather than a second set of quantities, and a muted label so the name sat below the figure). The reason for flipping is where this block actually lives: it lies on a photograph. A 9px hollow ring is two pixels of line, and its colour — the only thing tying that row to its segment on the bar — disappears against a busy image; a muted label goes the same way. The percentage on the right was already white, so the name matching it makes the row read as one thing rather than a grey half and a white half.實心點（7px）、白色標籤（2026-08-31 使用者裁示；改成實心後直徑由 9 收到 7——同樣的直徑，實心比空心圈重得多，一排五顆會先被看成五個點、再被看成五個名稱；列內間距同時 8 → 6，點愈小那段空白看起來就愈寬，色點會與它要標示的名稱脫鉤。兩者原本都是相反的做法——空心點是為了讓圖例讀成索引而不是第二組數量，灰標籤是為了讓名稱低於數字一階）。翻過來的理由是這一格實際上躺在哪裡：它躺在照片上。9px 的空心圈只剩一圈 2px 的線，而它的顏色正是這一列與條上那一段對應起來的唯一線索，在花的底圖上會直接消失；灰標籤同理。右邊的百分比本來就是白的，名稱跟著它同色，一列讀起來是一件事，不是「灰的一半」加「白的一半」。
  • Two columns only, no amount or headcount in the middle. Multiplying a percentage back by the total produces a figure that looks concrete but may mix periods — the revenue percentages come from the earnings overview while the total is this week's. Better one column short than one invented number.只有兩欄，中間沒有金額或人數。把佔比乘回總數會得到一個「看起來很具體」的數字，但那兩個數字未必來自同一個期間——收入的百分比取自收入總覽頁、總額是本週。寧可少一欄，不要多一個編出來的數字。

4.200 Donut mix

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

One total broken into parts, drawn as a ring with gaps between the arcs and the total in the middle. Built 2026-08-31 from a reference the user supplied; first used by the fan mix slide of the presentation rail. Three rings now coexist and none replaces another: .donut takes exactly two segments, .pie is a conic-gradient with no gaps and no round ends, and this one is multi-segment with both. The difference is not decoration — a pie reads as "a whole, cut up", while gaps make each arc a separate entry.

一個總數拆成幾塊，畫成弧與弧之間留縫的圓環，總數收在環心。2026-08-31 依使用者提供的參考圖建立，首個消費情境是展示版左欄的粉絲分布。站上現在有三支圓環、互不取代：.donut 只吃兩段，.pie 是沒有縫也沒有圓端的 conic-gradient，這一支是多段、有縫、有圓端。差別不在裝飾——圓餅讀的是「切開的整體」，有縫的環讓每一段成為獨立的一筆。

Anatomy

結構

  • .donut-mix__legend--stats — the legend row carries numbers too (sold · raised · share), so the 190px cap is lifted and the column takes the width it needs. Replaced a four-column .rank-bars--barline table in project detail on 2026-09-01 at the user's call: once the ring encodes the proportion, a bar under every row says the same thing twice. Numbers never shrink (flex: none, tabular figures) — only the plan name compresses. .donut-mix--stack folds ring and legend into a column below 767px.圖例列還要帶數字（售出／累積金額／佔比），所以解掉 190px 上限、讓這一欄吃它需要的寬度。2026-09-01 依使用者裁示取代項目詳情原本的四欄 .rank-bars--barline 表：環一旦承擔了比例，每列底下再放一條長條就是同一件事講兩遍。數字欄一律不縮（flex: none、等寬數字），只有方案名會被壓縮。.donut-mix--stack 在 767px 以下讓環與圖例上下疊。
  • Geometry is shared in js/donut.js (ZtorDonut.segsHTML / ringHTML), the same move as js/linechart.js. ⚠ donutMix() in js/components.js is still a second copy of the same arc maths — switch it to the shared file next round.幾何抽在 js/donut.js（ZtorDonut.segsHTML ／ ringHTML），與 js/linechart.js 同一個做法。⚠ js/components.js 的 donutMix() 仍是同一份弧長計算的第二份副本，下一輪要改成呼叫共用檔。
  • .donut-mix__seg — each arc is a stroke-dasharray circle with a round cap, and the gap subtracts one whole stroke width on top of its own size: a round cap adds half a stroke at each end, so without that subtraction the arcs touch and the gap disappears (measured: a 12px stroke eats a 12px gap whole). The SVG is rotated -90° so the first segment starts at twelve o\'clock, since SVG\'s own 0° is at three.每一段弧是一顆 stroke-dasharray 的圓，端點是圓的；縫除了自己的寬度還要多扣一整個線寬——圓端會在每一端各多畫半個線寬，不扣的話段與段會黏在一起、縫等於沒有（實測 12px 線寬把 12px 的縫整個吃掉）。整個 SVG 轉 -90°，第一段才從十二點鐘開始（SVG 自己的 0° 在三點鐘）。
  • Ring size and stroke環的大小與線寬 — 150px across with a 9px stroke (2026-08-31, up from 116 / 12 at the user's call). The stroke width is the same fact as W in donutMix(): the gap between segments subtracts a whole stroke width (each round cap eats half), so if the two drift apart the gaps come out uneven. The legend beside it is capped at 190px — its label is flex: 1, so the wider the column the further right the percentage is pushed, and four rows start reading as four unrelated sentences. The legend as a block sits flush with the section's right edge (justify-content: space-between), which makes the gap between ring and legend a consequence of how wide the block is rather than a hard-coded number, and puts the percentages on the same line as everything else right-aligned in that block — the two arrows in its heading (measured: both at 432px).環 150px、描邊 9px（2026-08-31 使用者裁示，原本 116 ／ 12）。描邊寬與 donutMix() 裡的 W 是同一件事：段間的縫要扣掉一整個描邊寬（兩個圓端各吃半個），兩邊對不上縫就會忽寬忽窄。旁邊的圖例收在 190px——名稱是 flex: 1 撐開的，欄位愈寬百分比被推得愈遠，四行會讀成四段各自為政的句子。圖例整組貼著整段的右緣（justify-content: space-between）：環與圖例之間的空白因此是「這一格有多寬」的結果，不是寫死的間距；百分比也與這一格其他靠右的東西（標題列的兩顆箭頭）收在同一條線上（實測皆 432px）。
  • .donut-mix__center — the total lives in the hole, so the slide does not also carry the big number above it: the same figure twice on one card says nothing new. It is smaller than the rail\'s 56px headline because it has to fit an 80px hole — enlarging it means enlarging the ring, and a bigger ring leaves no width for the legend beside it.總數住在環心，所以這一張不再另外排上方那個大數字——同一個數字在同一張卡上出現兩次不多講任何事。它比左欄那個 56px 的標題數字小，因為它要裝進 80px 的洞：放大就得把環放大，而環一大，旁邊的圖例就沒有寬度了。
  • The legend borrows .split-bar__legend and its rows: the same data has no reason to have two legend implementations. Ring versus bar is a trade of width for height — the ring folds the total into its middle and needs no separate headline row, the bar needs a row but almost no height.圖例借 .split-bar__legend 那一組列：同一份資料的圖例沒有理由有兩套寫法。環與長條的差別是「用寬度換高度」——環把總數收進中心、不必另排一行大數字，長條要那一行、但幾乎不吃高度。

4.201 Tier arc

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

Nested tiers, where every level is a subset of the one outside it. Built 2026-09-01 after the user spelled out what the fan tiers actually are — Fan ⊇ Ranked fans ⊇ Superfan ⊇ Inner Circle — and picked this shape (their own proposal) from four options in docs/fan-tiers-demo.html. It replaces .donut-mix in that slot. A ring of mutually exclusive slices assumes "one whole, cut up"; drawing containment that way reads as four unrelated groups standing side by side, when Inner Circle is in fact the small part of the same crowd that came closest. That is a wrong chart type, not a sizing or colour problem. What makes this one work is two encodings kept apart: the angle says how many people reached this level (cumulative share, 100% on the outside), the stroke width says which level it is (thickest outside, thinner inward). Look inward from any angle and the number of layers you can see is how far the people at that angle went — containment is drawn, not explained in a caption.

層層包含的分層：每一層都是外一層的子集。2026-09-01 建——使用者說明了粉絲分層真正的模型（Fan ⊇ Ranked fans ⊇ Superfan ⊇ Inner Circle），並從 docs/fan-tiers-demo.html 的四個方案裡選了這一支（形狀由使用者自己提）。它在那一格取代 .donut-mix。互斥四塊的圓環前提是「一個整體被切開」，把包含關係畫成那樣，會讀成四群並列的人——而 Inner Circle 其實是同一群人裡走得最近的一小撮。這是圖型用錯，不是尺寸或顏色的問題。這一支成立的關鍵是兩個維度分開編碼：角度是「這一層有多少人」（累積佔比，最外層 100%），線寬是「第幾層」（最外層最粗、往內遞減）。任何一個角度往中心看，看得到幾層就代表那個角度的人走到了第幾層——包含關係直接畫在圖上，不必靠圖例解釋。

Fan一般粉絲100%

Anatomy

結構

  • .tier-arc__seg — one layer. All four share the same radius and start at twelve o'clock (the SVG is rotated -90°, since SVG's own 0° is at three), so "shorter as you go inward" is compared from one starting line. Stroke width comes in as an inline attribute, not a CSS constant: it is part of the data (which level), not styling. Widths 26 / 20 / 15 / 11 at radius 60 — the outer edge lands at 73, inside the 150 canvas (radius cap 75); any thicker and a corner gets clipped. The user asked for the innermost to be fatter once (7 → 11), and the collar of the layer outside it narrows from 2.5px to 2px as a result — past that the collar stops reading as "which one is outside" and the chart is no longer nested.一層弧。四層同半徑、都從十二點鐘開始（整個 SVG 轉 -90°，SVG 自己的 0° 在三點鐘），「愈往內愈短」才在同一條起跑線上比得出來。線寬由行內屬性帶進來、不是 CSS 常數：它是資料的一部分（第幾層），不是樣式。半徑 60、線寬 26 / 20 / 15 / 11——最外緣落在 73，在 150 畫布內（半徑上限 75），再粗就會被裁一角。使用者曾裁示把最內層加粗（7 → 11），代價是外一層露出來的「衣領」由 2.5px 收到 2px；再往上加，衣領就細到看不出誰在外面，這張圖也就不再讀成巢狀。
  • Cumulative, not exclusive吃的是累積佔比、不是「只到這一層」 — the store holds 12 / 28 / 37 / 23 (they add to 100), which is the share that stops at each level. Containment needs the running total from the innermost out: 12 → 40 → 77 → 100. That is a re-reading, not new data (ASSUMPTIONS CANVAS-004). Rows are passed outside-in.store 那四個數字（12 / 28 / 37 / 23，加起來剛好 100）是「只到這一層」的佔比；包含關係要的是由最內層往外累加的 12 → 40 → 77 → 100。這是換一種讀法、不是新增資料（ASSUMPTIONS CANVAS-004）。`rows` 由外往內傳。
  • Colour comes from the tier ramp顏色吃分層色階 — --tier-1..4, not --chart-*. Categorical colours are for independent categories with no order; a ramp lets lightness itself carry the depth. The legend dot is sized from that layer's stroke width, so legend and chart share one encoding instead of four identical dots.--tier-1..4，不是 --chart-*。分類色是給彼此獨立、沒有順序的類別；色階讓明度本身承擔深度。圖例的圓點大小跟著該層的線寬走——圖例與圖共用同一個編碼，而不是四個一樣大的點。

4.197 KPI rotator

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

One slot that takes turns saying two things — revenue and fan mix — in the presentation layout's left rail, 8 seconds apart. Side by side would squash both numbers below the size that carries any weight, and weight is the one thing the presentation layout exists to keep. Cross-fade rather than slide: a slide implies a direction and therefore a page you could turn yourself, and there is nothing to turn here. Slides sit in one grid cell so the frame's height is the tallest slide and never jumps. Only one thing on a screen may move on its own — this rail and the dashboard's earnings ticker never appear together. Built 2026-08-31.

展示版左欄的一格，輪流講收入與粉絲組成，每 8 秒換一次。並排會把兩個數字都壓到讀不出份量，而份量正是展示版唯一要保住的東西。用淡入淡出不用滑動：滑動帶方向，方向會被讀成「還有下一頁、可以自己翻」，這裡沒有可翻的東西。所有張放在同一個 grid 格裡，外框高度取最高的那一張、換張時不會抖。一個畫面上只能有一個東西自己在動——這一格與儀表板的收入輪替不會同時出現。2026-08-31 建。

4.200 Live item

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

One thing that is currently running — a project raising funds, a pre-order taking orders, an event selling tickets — said in full beside a poster that takes most of the screen's height. The presentation page's second screen is a centred carousel: the current one in the middle, its neighbours peeking either side, a page button at each end. On a glass card, over its own poster: the screen's backdrop is the centred item's poster, blurred past recognition, and the card is what lifts the text off it. (The card was dropped for a while when the section had no backdrop, and came back with one at the user's call — blur is legitimate here under Q77's proviso: the layer underneath is a photograph.) Reach for it when the question is "how are the few things I have going doing"; when the question is "what do I have", the cover rail (work-card) answers that with a row of small covers. Built 2026-08-31.

一件正在跑的事——募資中的項目、正在收單的預購、正在賣票的活動——講在一張佔掉大半屏高度的海報旁邊。展示版第二屏是置中的輪播：中間那一件是現在在講的，左右各露出一截，翻頁鈕一左一右夾著它。玻璃卡面，躺在自己的海報上：這一屏的背景就是正中央那一件的海報、糊到認不出細節，卡面是把字從那張照片上撐起來的那一層。（中途曾拿掉卡面——那時這一屏還沒有背景圖；背景加上之後依使用者裁示把卡加回來。這裡的模糊合乎 Q77 的但書：下面真的是一張照片。）問題是「手上這幾件跑得怎麼樣」時用它；問題是「我有哪些作品」時，那是作品磚列（work-card）用一排小封面回答的事。2026-08-31 建。

Rendered preview

視覺展示

Funding募資 Album音樂專輯 LOVE RAGE HOPE $88,600 / $120,000 74% 20 days left剩餘 20 天 Open前往

Anatomy

結構

  • .live-rail__view + .live-rail — the view takes everything the two page buttons leave (one on the left, one on the right) and hides its overflow; the track inside is moved by transform, never scrolled. An item is sized by formula — (view − gap) ÷ 1.5 — so the centred item shows about a quarter of each neighbour at any window width (measured at 1440: view 1134, item 729, poster 379×569). Both edges fade rather than ending on a hard line, and the mask sits on the view, not on the track — a mask on the moving element travels with it. The view also carries 90px of vertical padding cancelled by an equal negative margin: a card's shadow is 0 24px 60px, reaching 84px past its own box, and with the view's box exactly as tall as a card the clip sliced that shadow into a hard horizontal edge on the backdrop (user-reported: "there's a strangely cut-off shadow behind this"). Left and right need no such room — the mask fades those sides anyway. The buttons sit in a three-column grid with both edge columns fixed and every child placed explicitly: the button at either end is hidden when there is nothing that way, the site-wide law makes that display: none !important, and with automatic placement everything shifts a column left (measured — the view collapsed to 40px). The fade mask lives on the view, never on the scroller: with a mask on the scrolling element, programmatic smooth scrolling dies — the animation moved 33px and stopped, so the page button did nothing (measured; the same rail scrolled fine the moment the mask came off).可視區吃掉兩顆翻頁鈕（一左一右）以外的全部寬度、並把溢出藏起來；裡面那條軌道靠 transform 位移，不捲動。一件的寬度用算的——（可視區 − 縫）÷ 1.5——所以置中那一件的左右各露出約四分之一件，任何視窗寬度都成立（1440 實測：可視區 1134、一件 729、海報 379×569）。兩緣都用漸消而不是硬邊收尾；遮罩掛在可視區、不掛在軌道上——掛在會動的東西上，遮罩會跟著一起動。可視區另外吃 90px 的上下內距、再用等量的負外距抵銷：卡的陰影是 0 24px 60px、往外伸 84px，而這一層的框剛好等於卡的高度，`overflow: hidden` 會把陰影切成一條硬邊落在背景上（使用者回報「這個後面有奇怪被切掉的陰影」）。左右不必補，那兩側本來就由遮罩漸消。兩顆鈕住在三欄格線的頭尾，兩側欄寬固定、而且每一個子元素都要指定欄位：到頭那顆會被設成 hidden，站上的全域規則讓它 display: none !important，靠自動配位的話後面的東西會整個往前遞補一格（實測可視區縮成 40px）。漸消的遮罩掛在可視區、絕不掛在捲動區身上：捲動區自己帶遮罩時，程式驅動的平滑捲動會死掉——動畫走了 33px 就停住，翻頁鈕按了完全沒反應（實測；同一支 rail 拿掉遮罩立刻正常）。
  • A centred, endless carousel置中的環狀輪播 — the middle item is the one being talked about, one turn at a time, and the list never ends: the renderer puts the last item first, so the item centred at the start is the first one and what peeks on the left is the last one. Turning is a transform, not a scroll: an endless list has no ends, native scrolling always has two, and faking the wrap means cloning nodes or jumping at the edges — both visible. After each transition the first item moves to the back (or the last to the front) and the transform resets, which is the turn. The base offset is (view − item) ÷ 2 − pitch, recomputed on resize, on language change and by a ResizeObserver, since it is a pixel value; clicks are ignored while a turn is running, or the base gets recomputed mid-flight and the row jumps. Two walls from the earlier native-scrolling version are worth remembering: a mask on the scrolling element kills programmatic smooth scrolling (the animation moved 33px and stopped), and scroll-snap-type: mandatory swallows a smooth page outright — the snap engine decides the nearest point is where it started and pulls it back (measured 0 → 26 → 0).中間那一件是現在在講的，一次轉一件，而且列沒有盡頭：渲染器把最後一件排在最前面，所以一開始置中的是第一件、左邊露出的是最後一件。轉動用 transform 不用捲動——環狀的列沒有端點，而原生捲動一定有兩個；要偽裝就得複製節點或在端點瞬間跳位，兩種都看得出來。每次動畫結束後把第一件搬到最後（往回就是把最後一件搬到最前）、位置歸零，那一步就是轉了一格。基準位移＝（可視區 − 一件）÷ 2 − 一件的間距，因為是像素值，所以改變視窗、換語言與 ResizeObserver 觸發時都要重算；動畫進行中不接受下一次點擊，否則會在半路上重算基準、跳一下。先前用原生捲動的那一版撞過兩面牆，值得記著：捲動區自己帶遮罩會讓程式驅動的平滑捲動死掉（動畫走 33px 就停），而 scroll-snap-type: mandatory 會把平滑翻頁整個吃掉——吸附引擎判定最近的吸附點是原地並把它拉回去（實測 0 → 26 → 0）。
  • .live-item__stage + __kind — the stage (Funding / Pre-order / On sale / Live) gets a pill, the work's own category stays a plain grey word. Two grey words side by side read as one string of labels; the pill says these are different kinds of fact — one is where this is in its life, the other is what it is. Every one of those words is an existing string from the dictionary (canvas.tab.*, status.*); the component invents no vocabulary of its own.階段（募資／預購／售票中／進行中）給一顆藥丸，作品自己的分類維持一個灰字。兩個灰字並排會讀成同一串標籤；藥丸說的是「這兩件事不同類」——一個是它現在走到哪，一個是它是什麼。這些詞全部沿用字典裡既有的字（canvas.tab.*、status.*），這支元件不自己造詞。
  • Identity at the top, status at the bottom身分在上、狀態在下 — the poster sets the height and the text column splits into two clusters with the gap between them left empty (margin-top: auto on __status). Glue them together and the screen turns back into a small card; separated, the eye reads "which one is this" first and "how is it doing" last, which is the order the question comes in. The name wraps to two lines rather than ellipsing — this column has 500px of height it is not using, so there is no reason to spend a name on saving width. The numerator is white and large, denominator and units small and grey, and the percentage sits at the right end of the bar because it is that bar's reading, not a separate fact. "Open" is a secondary button in the bottom-right corner (2026-08-31 at the user's call; it was a line of grey text before, reading at the same level as "9 days left" above it, so nothing said which line was the action) — a <span> carrying the button classes, not a link: the whole card already is that link, and a second one only adds a tab stop to the same destination. The poster's height is tied to the viewport (min(50vh, 520px)) rather than to the item's width, because this screen is exactly one screen tall and the air above and below is whatever the block does not take (measured: 130px each side).海報決定高度，文字欄分成兩堆、中間那段空白就留著（__status 吃 margin-top: auto）。黏在一起這一屏就變回一張小卡；分開之後，眼睛先讀「這是哪一件」、最後讀「跑得怎麼樣」，正是問題到來的順序。名稱換行到兩行、不用省略號——這一欄有 500px 的高度沒在用，沒有理由拿名字去省寬度。分子白且大、分母與單位小且灰；百分比貼在長條的右端，因為它是那條長條的讀數，不是另一件事。「前往」是右下角的二級按鈕（2026-08-31 使用者裁示；先前是一行灰字，與上面的「剩 9 天」同一階，讀者分不出哪一行是動作）——它是掛著按鈕樣式的 <span>、不是連結：整張卡本身就是那個連結，再放一個只是多一個 Tab 停留點、去同一個地方。海報的高度綁視窗（min(50vh, 520px)）而不是綁這一件的寬度：這一屏剛好一屏高，上下的呼吸就是這一塊沒吃掉的部分（實測各 130px）。
  • .live-bg — the screen's backdrop is the poster of whatever is centred, blurred to 16px and dimmed under a scrim: its job is to say "this is the one you are looking at" a second time, not to show the picture again — sharp, it would compete with the copy of it inside the card. It is fixed across the whole window and painted behind everything — the same move the first screen's backdrop makes: an image has to reach the window's edges before it reads as ground, and one that stops at the content column reads as a picture pasted inside it. That means the node lives next to the first screen's backdrop rather than inside this section: inside, it would fall within that section's own stacking context and cover the sidebar (measured). It is only lit while this screen covers the middle of the window, or it would replace the ground on the screens above and below too. Swapping it preloads the image and fades through opacity, since background-image has no in-between state to animate.這一屏的背景是正中央那一件的海報，糊到 16px 再壓一層暗紗：它的工作是把「你現在看的是這一件」再說一次，不是把那張圖再放一次——清楚的話會跟卡片裡那張互搶。它是 fixed、鋪滿整個視窗、畫在所有東西的最後面——與第一屏的底圖同一種做法：圖要滿到視窗邊才讀得出「這張圖是地」，只鋪內容欄的話會讀成「內容欄裡放了一張圖」。因此這個節點與第一屏的底圖放在一起、不放在這一屏裡面：放在裡面它會落在那一屏自己的 z-index 之內，把側欄蓋掉（實測）。它只在這一屏蓋住視窗中線時亮起來，否則上下兩屏的地也會一起被換掉。換圖時先預載再用 opacity 帶過去，因為 background-image 沒有中間狀態可以補間。
  • The exit follows whatever is centred出口跟著正中央那一件走 — a project in the middle makes the button say "More projects" and land on the project list; an event makes it "More events" and land on the event list. The test is where the item's own link goes (event-detail…), never a guess from its name. The label keeps its data-i18n so a language change is handled by i18n as usual, and the current language's string is written at the same time — otherwise the button would sit on the old wording until the next language apply.正中央是項目，按鈕就寫「查看更多項目」、落在項目清單；是活動就寫「查看更多活動」、落在活動清單。判準是那一件自己的落點（event-detail…），不從名稱猜。文字保留 data-i18n，換語言時照常由 i18n 接手；同時把當下語言的字寫上去，否則按鈕會停在上一次的說法，直到下一次語言套用。
  • Events here are only the ones on sale or running. The left rail's Events group also takes scheduled ones, because it asks "what is in this group"; this screen asks "how is it going", and a scheduled event has not opened sales, so its bar would be a row of zeros (measured: 31 items down to 22 once scheduled ones were dropped).這裡的活動只收售票中與進行中。左欄那一組還收「準備中」，因為它問的是「這一組裡有什麼」；這一屏問的是「跑得怎麼樣」，而準備中的活動連票都還沒開賣，進度條會是一整排的 0（實測 31 件降到 22 件）。

ds-components/live-item.css

4.198 Canvas home

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

The layout layer for index.html: a narrow left rail of three blocks beside one large canvas, with the whole page pinned to the viewport so nothing scrolls. It is a second page rather than a change to the dashboard because "does not scroll" is a hard constraint that forces out the depth a working tool needs — grouping, full lists, sections further down. Reached through the cheat code's Presentation demo group, next to Deck for Sony. Built 2026-08-31.

index.html 的版型層：窄的左欄三格，旁邊一大塊畫布，整頁釘在視窗高度、不捲。做成另一頁而不是改儀表板，是因為「不捲」是很強的限制，它會逼著砍掉工作台需要的深度（分組、完整清單、往下的區塊）。入口在 cheat code 的 Presentation demo 那一組，與 Deck for Sony 並列。2026-08-31 建。

Anatomy

結構

  • .canvas-home__stage — the backdrop is fixed across the whole viewport, not absolute inside the content area: absolute only reaches that one block, leaving the sidebar and top bar on the app's own background, which reads as "there is a picture in the right-hand cell" rather than "the picture is the ground". The sidebar keeps its own 4% film and is merely lifted above the image — the film is almost invisible but gives the navigation its own ground, without which a bright photo eats the labels.底圖用 fixed 鋪滿整個視窗，不是在內容區裡 absolute：absolute 只鋪得到那一塊，側欄與頂列會露出外殼自己的底色，讀起來就變成「右邊那一格放了張圖」，而不是「這張圖是地」。側欄保留它原本 4% 的薄膜、只被抬到圖之上——那層幾乎看不見，但讓導覽的字有自己的底，少了它圖一亮就吃字。
  • .canvas-hero__picks — the switcher hangs below the top bar but clears the same 56px of air the rail below it does (2026-08-31 at the user's call), so the two columns start on one line (measured: both at 161px). Hung straight off the bar, its first row lands inside that gap and reads as part of the top bar rather than as content.切換器掛在頂列底下，但要讓開與左欄同一段 56px 的呼吸（2026-08-31 使用者裁示），左右兩邊的內容才從同一條線開始（實測皆 161px）。直接貼著頂列時，它的第一項會落在那段間距裡，讀起來像頂列的附屬品而不是內容。
  • .canvas-home__overlay — the backdrop spans the viewport but the controls on it — mode switch, item switcher, the caption bottom-right — live in a separate layer pinned to the content block. Pin them to the window instead and they sit a page-padding further out than the rail, so the four corners of what reads as one block do not line up. The layer takes no pointer events and only its controls do; otherwise it covers the rail and nothing in the rail can be clicked. The rail's own padding is zeroed to match — measured 0px on all four corners.底圖鋪滿視窗，但圖上的控制——模式切換、作品切換器、右下的說明——住在另一層、貼齊內容區。貼視窗邊的話它們會比左欄多凸出頁面內距那一段，一塊讀起來是同一區的東西，四個角卻對不齊。這一層自己不吃指標事件、只有裡面的控制吃，否則它蓋在左欄上會讓左欄整個點不動。左欄的內距一併歸零，四角實測差 0px。
  • .work-row — ongoing items are horizontal rows: a 2:3 portrait thumbnail left, and three stacked segments right — name and category in muted grey, then one white key number, then a progress bar with a small line of remaining time. Only one thing in the row is white, and it is the answer that row exists to give: on the Release tab the countdown, elsewhere the amount raised or the units sold. Making the name white too has the two fight each other and the row has to be read twice. Square thumbnails crop the top and bottom off a poster; portrait covers laid out as a column in a 300px rail break the rhythm of the blocks above and below. Where there is a denominator it rides behind the number in the same small grey as the units — the numerator is the row's answer, the denominator is the scale you need to read it, and at equal size "18,400 / 20,000" reads as two numbers side by side rather than two halves of one fact. Only the number is white: the units around it (currency mark, "in", "days", "tickets") drop to grey at a smaller size, split in the renderer — read at the same size and colour, three of the four words in "12 days left" compete with the 12. The days remaining ride at the right end of the number's own line, baselines aligned: the two are two sides of one fact (how much sold / how long left), and stacking them reads as two facts and costs the row a line. Rows are all one height (78px, now set by the thumbnail rather than the text); let each group size itself and the block jumps up a notch every time you switch to releases. The release group carries no date any more — the countdown is the same date said another way.進行中項目是橫的一列一件：2:3 直式縮圖在左，右邊三段由上而下——灰字的名稱與類型、一個白字的關鍵數字、進度條加一行小字的剩餘時間。一列裡只有一個白字，那一個就是這一列存在的理由：上線頁是倒數，其餘是已募金額或已售數量。名稱也用白字時兩者互搶，一列要讀兩次。方形縮圖會把海報的上下裁掉；直式封面在 300px 的窄欄裡排成兩根柱子，又跟上下兩區的節奏對不起來。有分母的那幾組，分母接在數字後面、與單位同一階的灰小字——分子是這一列的答案，分母是讀懂它需要的尺度；同樣大小的話「18,400 / 20,000」會讀成兩個並列的數字，而它們是一件事的兩半。只有數字是白的：圍著它的單位（幣別符號、「還有」「天」「張票」）降成灰的小字，切分在渲染器裡做——同樣大小同樣白的話，「還有 12 天」四個字裡有三個在跟那個 12 搶。剩餘天數掛在數字那一行的右端、基線對齊：兩者是同一件事的兩面（賣了多少／還剩多久），排成上下兩行會讀成兩件事，也讓每一列多長一行。每一列等高（78px，現在由縮圖而不是文字決定）：讓每一組各自算高度的話，切到上線那一組整塊就會往上縮一截，四組輪流看就是畫面在跳。上線那一組不再有日期——倒數就是同一個日期的另一種說法。
  • .canvas-step — both blocks in the rail that hold more than they can show switch the same way: two arrows beside the heading, prev and next. The revenue block rotates two slides, the ongoing block cycles four groups (release, funding, pre-order, events); one control, defined once, used by both. The four groups used to be four tab labels — in a 300px rail that is four words that are always there and get pressed maybe one time in ten. The whole heading now changes with the group instead ("Ongoing releases", "Ongoing funding"…), which is the one clue saying who the rows belong to: the "type" on each row is the work's own category (film, MV), not the group. One sentence beats a heading plus a grey qualifier, and each language writes its own word order — Chinese puts the group first, English puts it last. Only the revenue block auto-advances — one screen may have only one thing moving by itself. The two arrows are 20px wide, not 24: a 24px box around a 16px icon leaves 4px on each side, so side by side there are 8px prising them apart and they read as two separate buttons rather than one prev/next pair. Height stays 24px, so the hit area does not shrink with them.左欄裡兩個「裝不下自己」的區塊用同一種切換：標題旁兩顆前後箭頭。收入那格輪兩張，進行中那格輪四組（上線／募資／預購／活動）；同一顆控制，只定義一次、兩處共用。四組原本是四個分頁標籤——在 300px 的窄欄裡，那是四個一直在那裡、卻九成時間不會被按的字。現在改成整句標題跟著組別換（「上線進行中」「募資進行中」…），它是這幾列在講誰的唯一線索：每一列上的「類型」講的是作品分類（電影／MV），不是這一組。一句話比「主標＋灰字限定詞」兩截好讀，而且兩個語言各照自己的語序寫（中文把組名放前面，英文放後面）。兩個區塊裡只有收入那格會自己輪播——一個畫面上只能有一個東西在自己動。兩顆箭頭寬 20px 不是 24px：24px 的方框裝 16px 的圖示，左右各留 4px，兩顆並排就有 8px 把它們推開，讀成兩顆分開的按鈕而不是一組前後。高度維持 24px，點擊面積不跟著縮。
  • Removed 2026-08-31 — .canvas-block__more / .issue-panel__more, the "view more" chevrons beside both headings, at the user's call. Worth knowing what went with them: the rail shows two ongoing items and three to-dos, and there is now no route from here to the rest. It holds up because neither heading claims a total any more — the to-do block dropped its count the same day, and the ongoing block is titled by group. A presentation screen is meant to be taken in at a glance, not searched.2026-08-31 撤除——.canvas-block__more／.issue-panel__more（兩區標題旁的「查看更多」箭頭），使用者裁示移除。取捨要知道：左欄只出兩件進行中與三則待辦，現在畫面上沒有一條路通往其餘的。之所以還過得去，是兩區的標題都不再宣稱總數——待辦同日已拿掉筆數，進行中寫的是組名。展示版的前提是一眼看完，不是查得完。
  • .canvas-hero / .canvas-below — the page is one screen then a second stretch (2026-08-31): the hero is exactly one viewport tall and below it come two more: the things currently running (this page's own live-cards) and Performance, which reuses the working dashboard's markup and data rather than keeping a second copy. The hero's height subtracts three gutters (shell 14 top and bottom, the main panel's 16 top margin, the page's own 24 top padding); miss any one and the first screen runs taller than the window and gets clipped. It also needs flex: none: .page is a flex column with min-height: 0, and without it the hero is squeezed to zero by the content below (measured — the second stretch landed on top of the first screen). Below the hero each stretch is its own screen (.canvas-sheet): first the live items — a centred, endless carousel with a page button at each end (this replaced the cover rail on 2026-08-31; a rail of covers answers "what do I have", and this screen has to answer "how are the few things I have going doing") — and "View more" under the row rather than beside the heading, because when a screen holds one thing the exit belongs after it. Performance stacks one block per row at about a third of the page wide, each with its label directly above its list and capped at five entries: the old full-width rows stretched the bars past 1000px, and a bar only has to be long enough to show a difference — stretched, first and fifth place sit half a screen apart and the eye has to travel. Five blocks stacked run 1379px, so this stretch is the one that scrolls. The hero's height is a minimum, not a maximum: when the to-do list has more items it grows and you keep scrolling inside the first stretch. The top bar and the right-hand switcher share one sticky wrapper (.canvas-hero__chrome) inside a container (.canvas-hero__stick) whose bottom edge is aligned to the rail's bottom, so the two leave together and leave at the right moment: a sticky element is released by its own container's bottom edge, and with the whole first screen as the container they stay pinned well past the point where the rail has scrolled away (the first screen runs longer than the rail). The rule the user set is "nothing at the top or the right moves until that block has scrolled off" — so the container ends where the rail ends. Its height is set once per layout change, with a negative bottom margin so the flow below sits exactly where it did — that margin has to add back the bar's own bottom margin, because a container with an explicit height no longer lets a child's bottom margin escape, and the 56px of air between the greeting and the first block vanished the first time round. It takes no pointer events since it now overhangs the content under it. Height only depends on layout, never on scroll position — computing it per frame is the jitter road. A ResizeObserver on the rail (not on the hero, which this code resizes) keeps it right as the first screen grows and shrinks. a sticky element is pushed out by its own container's bottom edge, and the moment depends on the element's height — 250px for the switcher against 46px for the bar means separate stickies can never be in step (measured: at scroll 860 the bar was still at 4 while the switcher had reached -139). Driving the switcher from a scroll listener instead was worse: JS lags the browser's scroll paint by a frame, so it jitters the whole way down. The backdrop takes pointer-events: none, or the wheel over it finds the viewport (locked) rather than the panel, and only the left column scrolls. Scrolling belongs to .main, not the window: the shell is a fixed-height glass frame and the panel scrolls inside it, so a scroll listener on window never fires. Past half a screen the backdrop fades out — it is fixed, so it does not leave on its own, and ordinary working content does not read over a face.這一頁是「一屏，然後還有第二段」（2026-08-31）：第一屏剛好一個視窗高，往下還有兩段：正在跑的那幾件（這一頁自己的 live-cards）與平台表現（沿用正式儀表板的標記與資料，不另做一套）。第一屏的高度要扣三段留白（外殼上下各 14、`.main` 的上外距 16、`.page` 的上內距 24），少扣一段第一屏就比視窗高、下緣被裁掉。它還必須寫 flex: none：.page 是 min-height: 0 的 flex column，不寫的話這一格會被下面的內容壓成 0（實測，第二段直接疊到第一屏上）。第一屏之後每一段各自佔一屏（.canvas-sheet）：先是進行中那一列——置中的環狀輪播，翻頁鈕一左一右（2026-08-31 取代原本的作品磚列：一排封面答的是「我有哪些作品」，而這一屏要答的是「手上這幾件跑得怎麼樣」）；「查看更多」放在卡片下方而不是標題旁邊，一屏只有一件事時出口該在讀完之後的位置。平台表現一塊約三分之一寬、由上而下一塊一行，標題在清單正上方，每一類只留前五名——先前長條被拉滿一整行（1000px 以上），而長條只需要夠長到看得出差距，拉滿之後第一名與第五名隔著半個螢幕。五塊疊起來 1379px，這一段因此是三段裡唯一要捲的。第一屏的高度是下限不是上限：待辦事項多了它就自己長高，往下捲仍在第一段裡。頂列與右緣的切換器包在同一塊 sticky（.canvas-hero__chrome）才會一起離開，而外面那層容器（.canvas-hero__stick）的下緣切齊左欄的下緣，它們才會在該走的時候走：sticky 的元素是被自己容器的下緣推走的，容器若是整個第一屏，它們會在左欄早就捲完之後還壓在畫面上（第一屏比左欄長，左欄結束之後還有一段空白）。使用者定的規則是「在左欄那一塊滑走之前，頂列與右側都不要動」，所以容器就結束在左欄結束的地方。高度在每次版面改變時算一次，並用負下外距把底下的內容擺回原位——那個負值必須把頂列自己的下外距加回來，因為容器一旦有了指定高度，子元素的下外距就不再穿透出來（第一版漏掉，問候與第一格之間 56px 的呼吸整段消失）。它會蓋到下面的內容上，所以自己不吃指標事件。高度只跟版面有關、與捲動位置無關——每一幀算位移正是會抖的那條老路。左欄掛一個 ResizeObserver（不是掛在第一屏上，那是這段程式自己會改的東西）讓第一屏長高變矮時跟著重算。sticky 的元素是被自己容器的下緣推走的，時機取決於元素自己的高度——切換器 250px、頂列 46px，各自 sticky 一定不同步（實測捲到 860 時頂列還在 4、切換器已到 -139）。中途改用捲動事件算位移更糟：JS 比瀏覽器的捲動繪製慢一幀，右側會一路抖。底圖要 pointer-events: none，否則滾輪落在它身上時找的是視窗（鎖住的），只有左欄捲得動。**捲動發生在 .main 身上、不是視窗**：外殼是固定高度的玻璃殼、內容在面板裡自己捲，監聽掛 window 永遠不會觸發。捲過半屏底圖就淡掉——它是 fixed 的、不會自己離開，而一般的工作內容躺在一張人臉上讀不乾淨。
  • .canvas-home-shell — sits on <body> and is the only switch that pins the shell to 100vh; .app is normally min-height, which grows with content. Scoped to the class so no other page is touched. Below 1024px it releases the lock and stacks the rail above the canvas — one screen with no scrolling is a premise for large displays, and forcing it onto a phone squeezes every block past reading.掛在 <body> 上，是把整個外殼釘成 100vh 的唯一開關；.app 原本是 min-height、內容多就往下長。用 class 圈住範圍，其他頁面完全不受影響。1024px 以下解除高度鎖、左欄改到畫布上方——一屏不捲是為大螢幕設的前提，硬套到手機上會把每一格壓到讀不出來。
  • .canvas-home__rail — three blocks; only the last (pending actions) takes the leftover height, because the first two hold fixed content — one KPI, two covers — while the third is a list, where extra height is worth something.三格，只有最後一格（待處理事項）吃掉剩下的高度：前兩格的內容是固定的（一張 KPI、兩張封面），第三格是清單，多出來的高度給它才有用。
  • .app.is-nav-rail — the sidebar collapses to icons only, site-wide: the button comes from sidebar.js so every page's rail has it, and the state persists in localStorage — a toggle that resets on every navigation is no toggle at all. Collapsed, it hides words but not routes: every icon keeps its place, sub-menus fold away entirely, and the wordmark swaps for a mark-only symbol, since roughly 48px of usable width would clip "ztor" to "zto". The button sits on the brand row — it controls the column, not a destination in it. Its icon has to be registered in js/icons.js first: the first attempt used names the registry does not know, so applyIcons left the <i> untouched and the button was an invisible empty 32×32 box. Two selector traps, both measured: the width rule needs html[data-nav-mode="sidebar"] .app.is-nav-rail #sidebar and must change flex-basis, because the real source is an id-bearing flex: 0 0 248px in shared.css and width alone does not size a flex row; and the wordmark's class is app-topbar__brand-logo — both shells share one logo — so app-sidebar__brand-logo matches nothing. Below 900px the whole thing stands down; the burger already owns collapsing there.側欄收合成只有 icon，全站生效：鈕由 sidebar.js 產出，所以每一頁的側欄都有；狀態存 localStorage，每點一次導覽就重新展開的話那顆鈕等於沒用。收起時只藏字不藏路：每個 icon 留在原位，子選單整段收起，字標換成只有記號的版本——扣掉內距只剩約 48px，硬縮會被切成「zto」。兩個選擇器的坑都是實測踩到的：欄寬要寫 html[data-nav-mode="sidebar"] .app.is-nav-rail #sidebar 並改 flex-basis（真正的來源是 shared.css 帶 id 的 flex: 0 0 248px，而 flex row 裡只改 width 不決定尺寸）；字標的 class 是 app-topbar__brand-logo（兩個外殼共用同一支標誌），寫成 app-sidebar__brand-logo 什麼都選不到。900px 以下整套退場，那裡本來就由 burger 接手。
  • .canvas-home__bar — page name left, clock and today's income right — the reference's time/weather/bell, translated. Weather means nothing to a creator; what came in today is what they wake up wanting to know. The clock ticks once a minute, not once a second: a seconds display on a presentation screen keeps pulling the eye for information nobody reads.左邊頁名，右邊時間與今日進帳——參考版型的時間／天氣／鈴鐺換算過來。天氣對創作者沒有意義，今日進帳才是他起床第一個想知道的事。時鐘每分鐘更新一次而不是每秒：展示畫面上一個跳秒的鐘會一直把目光拉過去，而它其實不帶任何要讀的資訊。

4.135 Issue panel

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

A directory of everything waiting on the creator, grouped by the module it came from and expandable one item at a time. Promoted 2026-08-28 when the dashboard's three outlets onto the same to-do data — a one-line strip, a "Pending actions" popup and a "View all" popup — were merged into one in-page panel. Grouping answers where do I go to fix this, the panel's single tally answers how many, and expanding one card answers what exactly is affected and what happens next. Reach for it when a page has to present a batch of open items that live in several places; a single standalone notice is still Alert's job.

把「還等著創作者處理的事」整批攤開的目錄：依來源模組分組，一次展開一則。2026-08-28 promote——當天把儀表板上同一份待辦資料的三個出口（一條摘要通知、「待處理事項」彈窗、「查看全部」彈窗）併成這一個頁內面板。分組回答「要去哪裡處理」，標題列那一個總數回答「有幾件」，展開一張卡回答「牽涉到哪些東西、下一步是什麼」。一頁要呈現散落在數個模組的一整批待辦時用它；單一則通知仍然是 Alert 的工作。

Anatomy

結構

  • .card.issue-panel — the panel is a page-level surface, so it wears the standard glass recipe straight from .card. It adds nothing but layout. Give it tabindex="-1" when something elsewhere on the page scrolls to it — the KPI count tile does, and a scroll with no focus move leaves the keyboard behind.面板是頁面級表面，玻璃四件套直接由 .card 提供，本層只補排版。頁面上有東西會捲到它時要給 tabindex="-1"——儀表板的計數 KPI 卡就是；只捲不移焦點的話，鍵盤使用者會被留在原地。
  • .issue-panel__toggle / .issue-card__toggle — both levels collapse through a native <button aria-expanded> that points at its own body with aria-controls; CSS only rotates the chevron, the hidden attribute does the hiding. The whole row is the button so the target is a row, not a 16px glyph, and nothing else competes with it: secondary controls moved out of the collapsed row entirely and now live in the expanded body's Next-step line — a button cannot contain a button, and a bare icon sitting beside the row could not say what it did anyway.兩層都用原生 <button aria-expanded>，以 aria-controls 指向自己的內容區；CSS 只負責 chevron 旋轉，顯示與否交給 hidden 屬性。整列就是那顆按鈕，點擊目標才是一列而不是一顆 16px 的圖示，而且沒有別的東西跟它搶：次要控制鈕已整個移出收合列、改放展開後的「下一步」那一行——按鈕不能包按鈕，而放在旁邊的純圖示鈕本來也說不清楚自己在做什麼。
  • .issue-group — the hover surface is the group, not the single row: one group is everything waiting inside one module, so lighting the whole block tells the reader which module they are standing in. Negative side margins let that tint reach the panel's content edge instead of hugging the text. The module name sits at the same size as an item title (--fs-14, no uppercase — that is micro-label vocabulary and reads as a competing heading once it is title-sized); the hierarchy is carried by colour instead, muted for the module, full --foreground for the item.滑過的回饋掛在整個群組上、不是單一列：一組＝一個模組底下等著處理的所有事，整塊一起亮，讀者才知道自己現在站在哪個模組裡。左右負邊距讓這片底色滿到面板的內容邊，而不是縮在文字寬度裡。模組名與事項標題同字級（--fs-14，不再全大寫——那是微標籤的語彙，字級升上來之後會變成第二個標題在搶第一眼）；層次改由顏色承擔，模組名 muted、事項標題 --foreground。
  • .issue-panel__n — the count lives inside the title sentence ("5 pending actions") rather than as a badge beside it, so the reader is not asked to join a number to a noun themselves. The number is its own span with tabular figures; the noun is translated, and each language keeps its own grammar — Chinese carries the measure word, English switches between singular and plural keys.筆數寫進標題那句話裡（「5 件待辦事項」），不是旁邊掛一顆徽章——徽章要讀者自己把數字跟名詞連起來。數字單獨一個 span、走等寬數字；名詞這半各自照自己的語法，中文帶量詞「件」，英文換單複數兩個鍵。
  • .issue-card — collapsed, the row has no frame at all: it is one scannable line, and drawing a box around it would announce "this is a card" five times over until the panel's own edge stops reading. The frame is saved for the two moments that need a boundary — hover (this line opens) and expanded (several lines that belong together) — and both are just --ztu-film, no backdrop blur, since a nested blur only samples its own parent. Severity never touches the fill: five red cards read as "the whole studio is on fire" when what is actually there is five routine jobs with five next steps.收合時完全無框：一則事項在收合狀態只是一列可掃視的文字，畫框等於把「這是一張卡」宣告五次，面板自己的邊界反而讀不出來。框留給真正需要界定範圍的兩個時刻——滑過（這一列可以點）與展開（好幾行內容要收在一起）——兩者都只上 --ztu-film、不上 backdrop 模糊（巢狀模糊只會取樣到自己的母面）。嚴重度絕不碰填色：五張紅底卡讀起來是「整個工作站在燒」，實際上那只是五件各自有下一步的例行事務。
  • .issue-card__sev — a 6px dot, the row's only colour: severity, tinted from the same --status-* tokens the badges use. It replaced a counting badge whose number (sub-items) collided with the title's own count and with the group tally — three numbers in one row and no way to tell them apart.6px 圓點，是這一列唯一的顏色：嚴重度，色票沿用徽章那組 --status-*。它取代了原本帶數字的徽章——那個數字是細項數，跟標題自己寫的數量、以及群組筆數撞成一列三個數字，讀者分不出誰是誰。
  • .issue-detail — one affected item, marked as subordinate by a hairline down its left edge rather than an indent plus a bullet. A bullet would add a second meaning (a list, a checklist); all this needs to say is "these belong to the row above".一個受影響的細項，用左緣一條細直線表示從屬，而不是縮排加項目符號。符號會多帶一層語意（清單／待勾選），而這裡要說的只有「這幾項屬於上面那一則」。
  • .issue-panel--compact — the presentation layout's rail carries three items, no grouping, and no card surface at all. It went through three versions in one day — framed card, then frameless frosted glass, then nothing — because the other two blocks in that rail are plain text sitting on the backdrop, and three lit panels in a dark area get read as three buttons before they get read as three tasks. It stays legible because the left third of the backdrop is under --scrim-media anyway, which is what lets the rail's text stand there in the first place; the boundary between items is carried by rhythm instead (row gap 8 → 16), and a film only appears on hover, as the answer to "this row is clickable". Each row is titled with the thing to do ("Add tax form"), not the situation ("Payouts on hold — tax form required") — the block is called To-do, so a row should read as a task. That wording is not new copy: it is the item's own CTA label, the same words as the button inside the popup. The module icon sits on a round film disc (2026-08-31): the earlier reason for no backing — the card is already a sheet of glass, do not stack a surface on a surface — stopped applying once the card surface went away; idle, the icon now lies straight on a photograph and a backing is what lets it hold. Round rather than square, because a square reads as a button, which is why the previous backing was removed; film rather than blurred glass, because on hover its parent is the card's own glass and blurring there only samples its own parent (the Q77 nesting rule). The coloured severity bar becomes a module icon, one mark carrying two things — shape says which module, colour says how severe (same __sev palette, no new tokens); in this form it is white throughout. The full panel on the dashboard keeps the bar, the grouping and the situational title, where group headings already name the module and the reader has to judge what happened before acting. In the presentation rail the panel also takes 12px of horizontal padding and cancels it with a negative margin: the panel is the last block in the rail and carries overflow: hidden (there to clip a list that grows too long, not to trim styling), while each card pushes its hover surface past the text with margin: 0 -12px — the two collide and 12px is sliced off each side of that surface, rounded corners included. With the padding in place the content has not moved and the overhang now happens inside the clip box. Hovering brings back a real glass panel with 8/12 padding — idle draws nothing on purpose, but the moment the pointer lands the row has to answer "this is a card you can open", and a 4% film does not register over a photograph. The row gap came back down to 8 once the padding did that work — the padding is drawing the boundary now, so the gap only has to keep two panels from touching; at 16 the third item was pushed out of the block (measured: clipped by 22px).展示版左欄的形態：三則、不分組，而且完全沒有卡面。一天之內走過三版（有框的卡 → 無框毛玻璃 → 連玻璃也交出去），因為這一欄的另外兩格本來就是直接壓在底圖上的字，三個亮塊排在暗處會先被讀成「三個方塊」、才被讀成三件待辦。讀得到是因為底圖左三分之一本來就壓著 --scrim-media，那層壓底正是為了讓左欄的字站得住；界線改由節奏承擔（列距 8 → 16），薄膜只在 hover 時出現，作為「這一列可以點」的回應。每一列的標題寫的是要做的事（「補交稅務表單」），不是狀況（「提款已暫停 — 需補稅務表單」）——這一格叫待辦事項，每一列就該讀成一件事情本身。這句不是新編的文案：它就是這一則本來的 CTA 標籤，與彈窗裡那顆按鈕上的字完全相同。模組 icon 坐在一塊圓形薄膜上（2026-08-31）：當天稍早不給底色的理由是「卡本身已經是一片玻璃、面上不該再疊面」，卡面退場之後那個理由就不成立了——閒置時 icon 直接躺在照片上，一層底反而讓它站得住。圓形不是方形（方框會讀成一顆按鈕，那正是上一版被拿掉的原因）；用薄膜不上模糊（滑過時它的母面就是卡片自己的玻璃，糊了只會取樣到自己的母面，Q77 巢狀層規則）。前面的嚴重度色條換成模組 icon，一個標記講兩件事——形狀說模組、顏色說嚴重度（同一組 __sev 色，沒有新 token），在這個形態下一律白色。儀表板上的完整版維持色條、分組與狀況標題：那裡有群組標題在講模組，讀者也要先判斷「發生了什麼」再決定動不動手。展示版的左欄裡，面板本身也要吃 12px 的左右內距、再用負外距抵銷回去：面板是左欄的最後一格、帶著 overflow: hidden（那是為了切掉過長的清單，不是為了裁樣式），而每一則卡片用 margin: 0 -12px 把 hover 的面撐到文字之外——兩者相撞，那塊面會被切掉左右各 12px、圓角一起削平。補上內距之後內容一格都沒動，外擴改在裁切邊之內發生。滑過時浮出的是一塊有厚度的玻璃面（內距 8/12）——閒置時什麼都不畫是刻意的，但滑鼠落下的那一刻，這一列必須答出「這是一張可以打開的卡」，而 4% 的薄膜在照片上根本看不見。內距接手之後列距由 16 收回 8——界線的事已經由內距在做，列距只要夠讓兩塊面不相黏；16 還會把第三則推出這一格（實測被切掉 22px）。
  • .todo-dialog__desc / [data-todo] — in the compact form a row opens a popup instead of expanding in place (2026-08-31), and its chevron points right rather than down — down promises "this opens below", right promises "this takes you somewhere". Expanding in place is not an option here: the block lives in a layout that never scrolls and has room for exactly three rows, so the third would be pushed off screen, and what the expansion holds (the situation, the affected items, an action each) is not three lines' worth. The popup reuses the site's own .payout-dialog (narrow), and it carries the situational title the row gave up — the row says what to do, the popup says why. Its footer holds no primary action: every affected item already carries the same action, and with only one item the two buttons would sit one above the other and read as two different destinations.compact 形態下，一列點開的是彈窗、不是就地展開（2026-08-31），箭頭因此向右不向下——向下承諾「在下面打開」，向右承諾「帶你去別的地方」。就地展開在這裡不可行：這一格住在一個永不捲動的版型裡、高度只夠三列，展開會把第三列推出畫面，而展開後要看的東西（狀況、受影響的項目、每一項自己的動作）也不是三行放得下的。彈窗沿用站上既有的 .payout-dialog（窄版），並接住那句被讓出來的狀況標題——列說「要做什麼」，彈窗說「為什麼要做」。底列不放主要動作：每一個受影響的項目自己就掛著同一個動作，只有一個細項時兩顆會上下相鄰、看起來像兩個不同的去處。
  • .issue-detail__action / .issue-card__foot — every affected item carries its own action instead of the card sharing one "next step" link: "Low stock · 3 items" is three separate jobs, and one shared link folds them back into one. Label and destination both come from the alert's existing cta / ctaHref — deliberately not a recommendation, because this product has no recommendation engine (ASSUMPTIONS ISSUE-001). The button drops onto its own line below the name once the panel narrows past a min-width floor, so a narrow bento column never squeezes a product name into three lines. What is left at the card's foot renders only when there is something to say: the snooze button, or the note that a blocking item cannot be dismissed.每個受影響的項目自己帶一顆動作鈕，而不是整張卡共用一條「下一步」：「庫存過低 · 3 項商品」實際上是三件各自要做的事，共用一條連結等於把它們併回一件。文案與去處都取自該則告警既有的 cta／ctaHref，刻意不是建議動作——站上沒有推薦引擎（ASSUMPTIONS ISSUE-001）。面板一旦窄過 min-width 門檻，鈕會掉到名稱下方自成一行，窄的 bento 欄因此不會把商品名擠成三行。卡底那一列只在真的有話要說時才出現：暫緩鈕，或「阻斷型無法暫緩」那句說明。
  • Counts exclude soft-closed (snoozed) items at every level, because the panel shares its title with the dashboard's Pending-actions KPI — one saying 4 and the other 5 leaves the reader guessing which one lies. A snoozed card still renders, dimmed and at the bottom of its group: it needs nothing today but must stay visible (spec 5.1.1 §F4).每一層的筆數都排除已軟關的項目——面板與儀表板那顆「待處理事項」KPI 掛的是同一個標題，一個說 4 一個說 5，讀者只能猜哪個在騙人。已軟關的卡照樣渲染，降階並沉到組底：它今天不需要處理，但仍要看得到（spec 5.1.1 §F4）。

ds-components/issue-panel.css

4.136 Work card

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

A rail of cover tiles under two tabs. Active holds the creator's works that are still moving (live, scheduled) — each tile says which piece this is and where it has got to. Recent holds the dashboard's system events (spec 5.1.1 §F5) — what just happened across Projects, Fans CRM, My IP, Earnings, E-Shop and Events. The two used to be sibling views of the same works, which double-told the story: “帥到分手 MV published” as an event and the same MV shown as a tile marked Published are one fact, not two. Split this way the rail reads cleanly — left tab, what I am working on; right tab, what just happened — and finished works are still one click away under More. Promoted 2026-08-28 and revised four times the same day. Reach for it when a set of things needs to be recognised at a glance; when the reader needs to compare numbers field by field, that is a table's job.

兩個分頁下的封面磚列。進行中放創作者還在跑的作品（上線中、準備中），每張磚回答「這是哪一件、進行到哪」；近期放儀表板的系統事件（規格 5.1.1 §F5），也就是 Projects、Fans CRM、My IP、Earnings、E-Shop、Events 各模組剛剛發生的事。兩者原本都是同一批作品的不同切片，等於同一件事講兩次——「帥到分手 MV 上線」這則事件，與同一支 MV 狀態標成「已上線」的磚，本來就是一件事。分成這樣之後磚列的敘事乾淨：左分頁是我在做什麼、右分頁是剛剛發生了什麼；已結束的作品仍在右上「更多」一鍵可達。2026-08-28 promote，同日改了四版。一批東西要一眼認出來時用它；讀者要一欄一欄比數字時，那是表格的工作。

The third tile shows the fallback: a source with no page to land on renders as a <div>, not a dead link.「近期」分頁——同一張磚裝 §F5 系統事件。眉標裂成兩端（事件類型 ↔ 來源模組），狀態列裝狀態與時間。第三張是退路示範：來源查不到落點頁時吐 <div>，不給一個會 404 的連結。
