Anatomy

結構

  • .work-rail__tabs — the heading is the filter. An earlier version had a neutral title plus a pill tab group on the right, but both were answering the same question: which set is showing. Merging them removes a component and a glance. The unselected word stays legible rather than fading out — it is an entry point, not a footnote, and nobody clicks what they cannot see. This group shares no class with the F6 table's tabs below, so clicking one never moves the other.標題本身就是篩選。前一版是中性標題＋右側一組膠囊分頁，但兩者在回答同一個問題——現在顯示的是哪一批。合而為一就少一個元件、也少一次視線往返。未選中的那個詞維持可讀而不是淡到看不見：它是入口不是註腳，看不見就沒人會點。這組與下方 F6 表格的分頁不共用任何 class，點其中一邊不會帶動另一邊。
  • .work-rail__more — the exit the pill group used to occupy. It is not a duplicate of the table below: the rail draws from the projects store (27 entries, 12 shown) while the F6 table shows its own set of six, so this is the only route from here to the full project list.膠囊分頁讓出來的位置改放出口。它不是下方表格的重複：磚列取自 projects store（27 筆、顯示 12），F6 表格看的是另一份 6 筆的資料，所以這是這一區唯一通往完整項目清單的路。
  • .work-cards__wrap + .work-cards__nav — page buttons are positioned against the wrapper, not the rail: inside the scroller they would scroll away. One click moves by one viewport width, never a fixed pixel amount — how many tiles a page holds depends on the window. Left button hides at the start, right at the end; both recompute on resize, on load (lazy images settle the width late), and after a tab switch.翻頁鈕定位在外層而不是捲動區——放進捲動區會跟著捲走。一次捲一個可視寬度而非固定像素：每頁放得下幾張取決於視窗。到頭收左鈕、到底收右鈕；resize、load（圖 lazy 載入，寬度定案得晚）與切換分頁後都重算。
  • .work-cards — a horizontal scroll-snap rail, not a wrapping grid; the half-tile at the right edge is the only affordance that more exist. No scrollbar is drawn — the native horizontal bar is invisible by default on macOS anyway.橫向 scroll-snap 捲動列，不是會換行的 grid；右緣露半張是「還有更多」的唯一提示。不畫捲軸，macOS 的原生橫捲軸預設本來就是隱形的。
  • .work-card__cover + __bg + __img — 2:3 portrait holding square artwork without cropping it. Square inside a 2:3 frame under object-fit: cover crops the sides, and it measurably ate the titles printed on the covers. Since that title is what the tile is for, cropping defeated the component. The real image is contain-fitted over a backdrop that is the same image scaled 1.25× and blurred; both <img> share one src, so it downloads once.2:3 直式，完整裝下正方素材、不裁切。正方放進 2:3 用 object-fit: cover 會切掉左右，實測把封面上印的作品名切斷了；而那個名字正是這張磚的用途，切掉等於元件失效。真正的圖 contain 置中，底下墊同一張圖放大 1.25 倍並模糊；兩個 <img> 共用一個 src，只下載一次。
  • The text block, top to bottom文字塊由上而下 — __kind / __name / __state / __bar. The order is the order the eye needs it. __kind (Song, Album, Movie…) is the faintest: the cover already half-says it — an album sleeve reads differently from a film poster — so this line only makes that hunch explicit. __name owns a line by itself and is the strongest landing point. __state puts the project mechanism (Pre-order / Co-create / Release) on the left and the single most actionable number on the right, justified apart rather than joined by a “·” — Chinese and English differ so much in length (預購 vs Pre-order) that joining them overflows in English, whereas justification lets the gap absorb the difference. __bar is drawn only when a percentage genuinely exists, so a tile without one leaves no empty track to be misread as zero progress.順序就是眼睛需要它的順序。__kind（音樂／專輯／電影…）最淡：封面其實已經講了一半——專輯封面與電影海報一眼可辨——這行只是把那個直覺變成明確的字。__name 獨佔一行，是整張磚最強的落點。__state 左邊放項目機制（預購／共創／上線）、右邊放最可行動的那一個值，兩端對齊而不用「·」串接——中英文長度差太大（預購 vs Pre-order），串接在英文會爆行，兩端對齊時中間的空白會自己吸收差額。__bar 只有真的有百分比時才畫，沒有的磚不會留下一條空軌道被讀成「進度是 0」。
  • .work-card__kind--split + __kind-text + __source — the two-ended eyebrow, used by the Recent tab's event tiles. Spec §F5 asks every entry to carry five things, and the tile takes them in this order: event type and source module at the two ends of the eyebrow, event name on its own line, status and time at the two ends of the state row. The eyebrow deliberately uses the same justification as the state row below it — two rows aligned the same way read as one block instead of four loose fragments. Event type is lifted from the first segment of the row's existing meta string; when that string has no separator the segment is left empty and only the source shows. No new taxonomy is invented to fill the slot.兩段式眉標，「近期」分頁的事件磚在用。規格 §F5 要求每一筆都帶五項，磚上的落位是：事件類型與來源模組在眉標兩端、事件名稱獨佔一行、狀態與時間在狀態列兩端。眉標刻意與下方狀態列用同一種兩端對齊——兩行同一種對齊會被讀成一組，不是四段各自為政。事件類型取自該筆既有 meta 字串的第一段；字串裡沒有分隔號時這一段就留空、只顯示來源。不為了填滿格子發明新的分類。
  • .work-card--static — a tile with nowhere to go is not a link. Work tiles land on project-detail; event tiles land on the page of the module that raised them, looked up in a table that lives with the data (Projects → projects.html, Fans CRM → fans-crm.html, and so on) rather than hard-coded in the component — where a source is routed is a product fact, not a drawing decision. A source with no entry renders as a <div>: no href, no place in the tab order, and the hover lift is switched off, since something that moves under the cursor promises a click.沒有落點的磚就不是連結。作品磚落在 project-detail，事件磚落在觸發它的模組頁；對照表放在資料端（Projects → projects.html、Fans CRM → fans-crm.html…）而不是寫死在元件裡——某個來源該連去哪，是產品的路由事實，不是磚要怎麼畫。查不到對照就吐 <div>：沒有 href、不進 Tab 鍵序，hover 的抬升也一併關掉，因為會跟著游標動的東西等於承諾了一次點擊。
  • The status dot was removed狀態點已撤除 — an earlier version put a coloured dot before the name. It failed the simplest test: the designer looked at it and asked what it was. Colour alone with no legend gives a sighted reader nothing, while only a screen reader got the actual word. It was also redundant — the rail's own Ongoing / Recent tabs already filter by status, and the value on the right (a date, days left, a percentage) states the situation far better than a hue. The status word survives as visually-hidden text.早一版在名稱前放了一顆彩色圓點。它沒通過最簡單的測試——設計師看著它問「這是什麼」。純顏色又沒有圖例，看得見的人得不到資訊，反而只有讀屏拿得到真正的狀態詞。它也是多餘的：磚列自己的「進行中／最近發生」分頁已經在篩狀態，而右側那個值（日期、剩餘天數、百分比）把處境講得比一個色相清楚得多。狀態詞以視覺隱藏文字保留。

ds-components/work-card.css

4.137 Earnings feed

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

The dashboard’s Recent earnings column, with one settled transaction per box. It is the narrow-column answer to the same data the earnings table shows wide: a table is built for reading a whole column at once and comparing line against line, which needs room the third column of the first screen does not have — 259px at 1440, 219px at 1280. Each box instead carries one small complete sentence, top to bottom: what this was, how much came in, where from and when. A timer swaps the visible window every ten seconds so the column reads as money still arriving; nothing new is invented — the same eight settled rows rotate. Reach for it when income needs to feel live in a column too narrow for a table; when the reader has come to compare and total, send them to Earnings.

儀表板第一屏右欄的「近期收入」，一筆已結算交易就是一個框。同一份資料在寬欄裡是表格，在窄欄裡則要換一種講法：表格是為「一次掃完一整欄、一列一列比」而生，而第一屏的第三欄只有 259px（1440）與 219px（1280），它要的寬度這裡給不起。改成逐筆成框之後，一個框就是一句完整的小敘述，由上而下：這是什麼、收了多少、從哪裡來、什麼時候。計時器每 10 秒換一批，讓這一欄讀起來像錢還在進來——但沒有編任何新交易，輪的是既有的八筆。窄欄裡要讓收入有即時感時用它；讀者是來比對與加總的，那就請他去 Earnings。

Anatomy

結構

  • .earnings-feed__item — a nested surface, so it takes the film, not the glass. Q77: --ztu-film (6% white) plus a 1px --nest-line, and deliberately no backdrop-filter — the parent card is already glass, and blurring a child of it only samples the parent. The face is never tinted: a positive or negative amount changes the text colour only. Five tinted boxes stacked in one column stop reading as five things and start reading as one block of colour.它是巢狀層，所以用薄膜、不用玻璃。照 Q77：--ztu-film（6% 白）⊕ 1px --nest-line，且刻意不上 backdrop-filter——母卡已經是玻璃，子層再模糊只會取樣到母卡自己。面永遠不染色：金額正負只換文字色。一欄疊五個染底的框，讀起來不再是五件事，而是一塊色塊。
  • Three lines, in this order三行，順序固定 — __name / __amount / __meta. The amount carries its weight through type (--fs-18, --font-numeric, tabular figures) and does not need the first line as well. Putting the name first means a whole column reads “what this was / what this was / …” from top to bottom, which is what scanning wants. Lead with the amount instead and five numbers fuse into a stripe while every name drops to a footnote.金額靠字面（--fs-18、--font-numeric、等寬數字）承擔權重，不必連第一行也一併拿走。名稱放最上面，一整欄由上而下就是「這是什麼／這是什麼／…」，正是掃視想要的。反過來把金額擺第一行，五個數字黏成一條帶，每個名稱都變成註腳。
  • .earnings-feed__meta — source and time share one line, justified apart rather than joined by a “·”: joined, English overflows (Story world licensing · Nov 20), justified, the gap absorbs the difference between the two languages. The time never truncates (flex: none + nowrap) — it is one or two words, and clipping it leaves nothing. Name and source may ellipsize; at 1280 the longer English sources do.來源與時間同一行兩端對齊，不用「·」串接：串接在英文會爆行（Story world licensing · Nov 20），兩端對齊時中間的空白自己吸收兩個語言的長度差。時間永遠不截斷（flex: none ⊕ nowrap）——它只有一兩個詞，截掉就什麼也不剩。名稱與來源可以 ellipsis；1280 下較長的英文來源確實會截。
  • Every line is single-line三行全部單行截斷 — wrapping would leave the boxes at different heights, and this column swaps its contents every ten seconds; a height that jumps makes the whole column twitch.折行會讓框高低不一，而這一欄每 10 秒換一次內容；高度一跳，整欄就在抖。
  • .earnings-feed__item--enter — only the box that has just arrived at the top gets it: 6px of downward travel and a fade, nothing else, so it reads as one row pushed in rather than the column repainting. Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the animation is off but the rotation continues — the swap is information, the movement was decoration.只給剛推到頂端的那一框：6px 向下位移加淡入，就這樣，讀起來才是「上面推進來一筆」而不是整欄重畫。prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 時動畫不播、輪替照跑——換內容是資訊，位移才是裝飾。
  • The ten-second swap invents nothing10 秒輪替不編新資料 — the same eight settled rows rotate through a window of five (offset steps back one each tick, so a “newer” row appears on top and the rest are pushed down). It is a prototype effect standing in for a live feed; the product has no push channel (ASSUMPTIONS FEED-001). The timer stops itself on visibilitychange and pagehide, and start() always calls stop() first, so no two intervals can ever coexist.既有的八筆已結算資料在一個五筆的視窗裡環狀輪替（offset 每次往回退一格，頂端因此出現「更新的一筆」、其餘往下推）。這是原型層的模擬，產品沒有即時推播（ASSUMPTIONS FEED-001）。計時器在 visibilitychange 與 pagehide 自己停，且 start() 一律先 stop()，永遠不可能同時存在兩個計時器。
  • It does not replace the transaction list它不取代 transaction list — Earnings still renders the same rows through transaction-list, which was left untouched. Two renderers, two premises: a table for comparing down a column, these boxes for one narrow column of complete little statements.Earnings 等頁仍然用 transaction-list 畫同一批列，那支一個位元組未改。兩支渲染、兩種前提：表格為了逐欄比對，這些框為了窄欄裡一筆一句完整的話。

ds-components/earnings-feed.css

05.1 · Pattern ▸ Cards

How components assemble.元件如何組合

Best-practice assembly recipes — how components combine to meet a creator's goal. Eleven cards across four categories (page-level and mid-level); each has trigger / must / should / must-not / edge-cases. Component sections demo the unit only — assembly rules live here.

最佳實務的組合配方 — 元件如何組合起來達成創作者的目標。四個類別共十一張卡（頁面級＋中間層），每張都列出 trigger / must / should / must-not / edge-cases。元件段只展示單元本身——組合規則一律寫在這裡（判準見 §4.0）。

Dashboard home · hero + KPI + alertshero + KPI + alerts
Tabbed section · tabs + one paneltabs + 單一面板
Filter + list · chips drive rowschips 驅動列表
Lifecycle states · empty / loading / error空白 / 載入中 / 錯誤
Multi-step wizard · stepper + sticky barstepper + 固定底欄
Form assembly · field → section → form欄位 → 區段 → 表單
Settings page · nav + row cards設定導覽 + 列卡
Modal shell · one dialog chrome單一 dialog 殼
Split preview · editor + live preview編輯 + 即時預覽
Detail + persistent rail · tabs + sticky meta rail分頁 + 常駐 meta 欄

Section order

Section 順序

Follow the product's life story (validated on create-product; other create flows reuse it and skip stages that don't apply): identity (what it is) → showcase (media) → deliverable (content file) → commercial terms (variations → price → discount → stock) → fulfilment (delivery / pickup) → purchase rules (limits) → discovery (tags, links) → assurance (checkout). Decisions best made while looking at the finished thing — like listing — sit under the preview card in the right column (see 5.1.9), outside the left-column story. A section's grey __sub appears only when it needs to persuade or explain a rule (media, delivery yes; price no)

5.1.6 Form assembly

Workflow

Trigger

觸發

Any create / edit form

任何建立／編輯表單

Must

必須

every field is a Field (label + hint + one atom control); group into Form sections (title + grey sub; sibling sections auto-divide, base gap 6 / field spacing 16); side-by-side via Form grid; save on a sticky action bar. Sectioned create sheets use --surface-page; visible outlined sections use --card / dark --muted fill (no border edge, Q14) and a --sp-24 gap across hidden conditional sections. Adopted by product, auction, bundle, event, project, IP registration, and Admin IP Entry flows. Field order: identity → content → settings → risk disclosures. One section = one decision (extracted from create-product, 2026-09-01): split sections by the decision a creator makes, not by field type — price and discount are two decisions, so two sections; the test is whether the section title answers "what is being decided here" in one line. Branches toggle visibility, never reorder: physical / digital / multi-variant branches show or hide whole sections via data-*-show; section order stays fixed and no second form is ever built. Four fixed levels inside a section: __head → __subhead (only when one decision holds two field groups) → form-grid / field → nest; skip unused levels, never invent a fifth. Route-changing actions (e.g. type switch) live at the right end of the first section's __head--actions

每個欄位都是 Field（label＋hint＋單一 atom 控件）；用 Form section 成組（標題＋灰副標；區段相接自動分隔線、基礎 gap 6／欄距 16）；並排用 Form grid；儲存放固定動作列。區塊式建立 sheet 使用 --surface-page；可見外框區塊以 --card／黑夜 --muted 填色（無邊框線，Q14）與跨越隱藏條件區塊的 --sp-24 間距組成。商品／拍賣／組合／活動／項目／IP 登錄／Admin IP Entry 均已採用。欄位順序：識別 → 內容 → 設定 → 風險揭露。一個 section＝一個決定（2026-09-01 自 create-product 抽取）：切區依創作者要做的決定、不依欄位型別——價格與折扣是兩個決定就是兩個 section；判別句：section 標題能不能一句話回答「這區在決定什麼」。條件分支控顯隱、不重排：實體／數位／多規格分支用 data-*-show 控整個 section 顯隱，順序恆定、絕不為分支建第二份表單。Section 內分層階梯固定四級：__head → __subhead（僅當同一決定下有兩群欄位）→ form-grid／field → nest；用不到就跳過，不得自創第五級。改變路由的動作（類型切換）放第一個 section 的 __head--actions 右端

Decisions best made while looking at the finished thing — like listing — sit under the preview card in the right column (see 5.1.9), outside the left-column story. A section's grey __sub appears only when it needs to persuade or explain a rule (media, delivery yes; price no)

Section order

Section 順序

Follow the product's life story (validated on create-product; other create flows reuse it and skip stages that don't apply): identity (what it is) → showcase (media) → deliverable (content file) → commercial terms (variations → price → discount → stock) → fulfilment (delivery / pickup) → purchase rules (limits) → discovery (tags, links) → assurance (checkout). Decisions best made while looking at the finished thing — like listing — sit under the preview card in the right column (see 5.1.9), outside the left-column story. A section's grey __sub appears only when it needs to persuade or explain a rule (media, delivery yes; price no)

照商品的生命敘事排（create-product 驗證序，其他建立流程沿用、跳過不適用的環節）：識別（它是什麼）→ 呈現（素材）→ 交付物（內容檔案）→ 售賣條件（規格 → 價格 → 折扣 → 庫存）→ 履約（交付／取貨）→ 購買規則（限購）→ 發現（標籤、關聯）→ 保障（結帳與保障）。「看著成品才做的決定」（如上架）放右欄預覽卡下方（見 5.1.9），不排進左欄敘事。__sub 灰副標只在需要說服或解釋規則時出現（素材、取貨有；價格不用）

5.1.10 Detail + persistent rail

Layout

Trigger

觸發

An entity page where editing is split across tabs but a few read-only facts must never leave view (product detail: stock, delivery, linked project)

編輯分散在多個分頁、但有幾項唯讀事實必須永遠看得到的實體頁（商品細節：庫存、交付、關聯項目）

Must

必須

wrap the page in .page.page--narrow (1056px — the default 1280px plus a 300px rail leaves the main column too wide), then the Detail rail shell: editable Tabs in .detail-main, sticky .detail-rail on the right holding read-only Form section cards built from KV list / Stock bar / KPI. The rail answers "what do I need to know before I change something", so it holds constraints and consequences (stock on hand, delivery method, what this item is attached to), never the fields being edited and never a primary action. Cap it at 3–4 cards — a rail that scrolls has stopped being persistent. Below 1100px it falls in under the main column, so nothing in it may be the only route to a task.

頁面外層用 .page.page--narrow（1056px——預設 1280px 再配 300px 右欄，主欄會太寬），內層用 Detail rail 殼：可編輯的 Tabs 放 .detail-main，右邊 sticky 的 .detail-rail 放唯讀的 Form section 卡，內容由 KV list／Stock bar／KPI 組成。右欄回答的是「改東西前我要先知道什麼」，所以放的是限制與後果（現有庫存、交付方式、這個項目掛在哪），不放正在編輯的欄位、也不放主要動作。卡片控制在 3–4 張——會捲動的右欄就不再是常駐。1100px 以下右欄會掉到主欄下方，所以裡面不能有任何「只有這條路」的任務入口。

5.1.11 Destructive confirm

Interaction

Trigger

觸發

An action that can't be taken back — voiding an order item, deleting a product / draft / event, disabling an account. Reversible actions (save draft, unlist, toggle visibility) just do it and show a toast.

一個按下去就收不回來的動作——作廢訂單明細、刪除商品／草稿／活動、停用帳號。可逆的動作（存草稿、下架、切換顯示）不走這張卡，做完給 toast 就好。

Must

必須

No new modal CSS — this is Modal shell plus .btn--destructive, which is why the rule lives here and not in Pillar 4. The entry point is a quiet .btn--ghost.btn--destructive (red text, never the loudest thing in the row); only the commit button in the dialog foot is a full .btn--destructive. Body order is fixed, four blocks: what is being acted on (name it and quantify it — never "this item") → prerequisite (what must already be done elsewhere, e.g. "refund the buyer in Stripe first") → what happens (one line per consequence: codes voided, stock restocked, who gets emailed) → no undo. Afterwards the toast says what actually happened, not "success".

沒有新的 modal CSS——它是 Modal shell 加上 .btn--destructive，所以規則寫在 Pattern、不寫成元件。入口是安靜的 .btn--ghost.btn--destructive（紅字，絕不是那一列裡最響的東西）；只有彈窗頁尾真正執行的那顆才是完整的 .btn--destructive。內容順序固定四段：動到哪一項（講出名稱與數量，不要只說「這個項目」）→ 前置條件（要先在別的地方做完什麼，例如「請先在 Stripe 完成人工退款」）→ 會發生什麼（一條後果一行：憑證失效、庫存回補、誰會收到信）→ 不可逆。事後的 toast 要說出實際發生了什麼，不是只說「成功」。

Should / must-not

建議／禁止

Keep a blocked entry point visible and disabled with a title saying why (already picked up, needs the Admin role) — a hidden button reads as "this feature doesn't exist". Never use the native confirm(); never replace the consequence list with a single vague "this cannot be undone"; never change the screen before the user confirms.

不能按的入口留在畫面上、停用並用 title 說明為什麼（已取貨、需要 Admin 角色）——藏起來的按鈕會被讀成「沒有這個功能」。不可用原生 confirm()；不可把後果縮成一句籠統的「此操作無法復原」；不可在使用者確認之前就先改畫面。

05.2 · Pattern ▸ Voice

Task-oriented and finance-honest.以任務為導向,對財務誠實

Talks to an independent creator running their own business: plain about money, royalties, splits, and verification; never hides a fee or a pending state. Sentence case throughout. Imperative for actions, plain present for states.

對象是經營自己事業的獨立創作者:把金錢、權利金、分潤與驗證講清楚;絕不隱藏任何費用或 pending 狀態。全篇用 sentence case。動作用祈使句,狀態用平直的現在式。

Is / Is-not

該有的語氣 / 不該有的語氣

Voice is語氣是Voice is not語氣不是
Plain about money — "You'll receive $842.10 after a 12% fee"把金錢講清楚 — 「You'll receive $842.10 after a 12% fee」Vague — "Earnings will be processed"含糊 — 「Earnings will be processed」
Specific about state — "Pending until 28 Jun"把狀態講具體 — 「Pending until 28 Jun」Falsely settled — "Paid"假裝已結清 — 「Paid」
Action-first — "Request payout"動作優先 — 「Request payout」Feature-first — "Payout management module"功能優先 — 「Payout management module」
Calm, second-person — "You can edit this until the event goes live"冷靜、用第二人稱 — 「You can edit this until the event goes live」Hype / urgency — "Don't miss out!"炒作 / 製造急迫感 — 「Don't miss out!」
Honest about limits — "Bundles aren't available in your region yet"對限制誠實 — 「Bundles aren't available in your region yet」Evasive — "Coming soon" with no reason迴避 — 只說「Coming soon」卻不給原因
Conservative on compliance — "Tax docs are estimates; confirm with your advisor"合規上保守 — 「Tax docs are estimates; confirm with your advisor」Over-promising — "We handle all your taxes"過度承諾 — 「We handle all your taxes」

05.3 · Pattern ▸ States & Interaction

Global interaction defaults.全域互動預設

  • Nav dropdown: hover-open with a 140ms close delay; click toggles; ESC-to-close. Panel bg uses --background.
  • Nav dropdown: hover 開啟,關閉延遲 140ms;點擊切換;按 ESC 關閉。面板背景用 --background。
  • Theme toggle: light / dark / system cycle, persisted; ?theme= one-time override.
  • Theme toggle: light / dark / system 循環,會記住;?theme= 可一次性覆寫。
  • Tabs: single active panel, URL-hash synced. Chips: single-select, result count updates on change. Switch: 150ms knob slide.
  • Tabs: 只有一個作用中面板,與 URL hash 同步。Chips: 單選,變動時更新結果數量。Switch: 150ms 滑鈕動畫。
  • Lifecycle: 404 keeps chrome + link to Dashboard; Empty stub for unbuilt routes; Error = inline Alert --row with retry, never blanks loaded data; never toast-only.
  • Lifecycle: 404 保留外框 + 提供回 Dashboard 的連結;尚未建好的路由用 Empty stub;Error = 行內 Alert --row 附重試,絕不清空已載入的資料;絕不只用 toast。
  • Motion: 150–240ms ease-out; entrance animations gated behind reduced-motion.
  • Motion: 150–240ms ease-out;進場動畫受 reduced-motion 控制。
05.4 · Pattern ▸ Data viz

Chart conventions.圖表慣例

Lives in chart.css (see §4.71). Line chart: default series --primary, comparison --muted-foreground dashed, area fill color-mix(--primary 18%). Source-breakdown palette: --primary → #000 → --status-success → --status-info → #999. Series rely on legend labels, not color alone.

放在 chart.css(見 §4.71)。折線圖:預設序列用 --primary,對照序列用 --muted-foreground 虛線,區域填色用 color-mix(--primary 18%)。來源拆解的配色:--primary → #000 → --status-success → --status-info → #999。序列靠圖例 label 區分,不只靠顏色。

Layout templates and page composition.版型模板與頁面組成

Structure assembles components + patterns into page skeletons.

Structure 把 components + patterns 組裝成頁面骨架。

6.0.1 Surface layers表面階層

From Figma 856:27798 (visualised in design-layers.html): L0 canvas solid → L1 card solid → L2 translucent film that brightens whatever it sits on, and can stack → L3 stops filling and keeps only a hairline.

模型出自 Figma 856:27798（design-layers.html 有可視化）：L0 畫布實色 → L1 卡片實色 → L2 半透明薄膜（疊在誰身上就跟著誰亮一階，可再疊）→ L3 不再疊填色、只留線框。

L1 cardL1 卡片

L2 grouped block — brighterL2 分組面 — 比卡亮

L3 — hairline onlyL3 — 只留線框
Brighter (stacked on top)往亮（疊上去的一層） --nest-surface + --nest-line. Consumers消費者: .nest, .card--muted, .bd-sec. Light mode has both layers white, so the hairline is what separates them.亮色兩層同為白，靠線框才分得出來。
Darker (a well cut into the surface)往暗（挖出來的凹槽） --muted. Consumers消費者: .segmented track軌道, media wells (image placeholders)媒體井（圖片佔位格）, progress bar troughs進度條底. Not in scope of the flip.不在翻向範圍。
Controls (buttons on a surface)控件（浮在表面上的按鈕） --control-raise (dark深色 rgba(222,223,233,.04) / light亮色 var(--card)). Consumer消費者: .btn--outline. Never an absolute surface colour — hardcoding --card made the same button read brighter on canvas, identical inside a card, and darker inside an L2 block (Q67).不要用絕對表面色——寫死 --card 時，同一顆按鈕在畫布上比底亮、在卡裡同色、在 L2 分組面裡反而更暗（Q67）。
Rule of thumb判斷句 Is this a layer stacked on the container, or a well cut into it? Former brightens, latter darkens.這塊東西是「疊在容器上的一層」還是「容器上挖出來的一個凹槽」？前者往亮，後者往暗。
.form-section--outlined Page-level grouping — never put it inside a card or dialog. It takes the absolute --surface-shell #1C1D1E, which reads correctly against the #0C0D0D canvas but is darker than --card #212223, so nesting it sinks a level. Use the brighter set instead.頁面層的分組——不要放進卡或彈窗。它吃絕對色 --surface-shell #1C1D1E，坐在畫布 #0C0D0D 上方向正確，但比 --card #212223 暗，一放進卡就往下沉一階。卡／彈窗內要分組請用上面往亮那組。

Rows with a kebab menu (--menu, 2026-08-20 · D212)

列尾是 kebab 選單的清單 （--menu，2026-08-20 · D212）

The wrapper's overflow-x:auto clips vertically too, so a row menu opening downward gets cut in half — always on the last row. .admin-table-wrap--menu lets the menu escape and drops the 840px min-width (that figure belongs to the much wider Admin IP Bank table); with overflow released the wrapper's radius no longer clips, so the head row and last row round their own corners. Same approach as variant-table-wrap--menu. Used by the size-guide and discount-code lists in Store settings.

外框的 overflow-x:auto 連縱向一起裁，列尾選單往下長出去就只剩半截（最後一列必中，2026-08-20 使用者回報）。.admin-table-wrap--menu 放行 overflow（外框與 .ztor-table 兩層都要——表格自己也是 overflow:hidden，只放行外框選單仍然出不來），並把 840px 最小寬歸零——那個寬度是給欄位多得多的 Admin IP 銀行表用的，三欄的清單硬留著只會逼出一條沒必要的橫捲。overflow 放行後外框圓角不再 clip 內容，所以首列表頭與末列自己補圓角貼齊內緣。做法沿用 variant-table-wrap--menu。消費頁：商店設定的尺寸指南與優惠碼兩張清單。
